name: The Afterbirth
zitat: “The Doppler found a heart, 140 beats, strong and regular. The woman had given birth an hour before. To one child.”
form: Being
rolle: Elite, Creature. Freshly crawled through: Henchman
grauen: Uncanny (1) as long as the cord hangs. Disturbing (2) once it has grown. Horrifying (3) when it lies against its mother
aktenfarbe: Red as long as the cord hangs. Once the cord is cut, the case is closed
haeufigkeit: Rare. Six cases since 1996, all from the same delivery room
verstand: Animal
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Aurillac in the Cantal, France
ersteSichtung: 11 February 1996, around 03:00, maternity ward of the hospital in Aurillac, delivery room 3. Report by a midwife to the hospital management: “An afterbirth without a birth.”
letzteSichtung: 19 September 2026, delivery room 3. Without a cord, as big as a person. Case open
verluste: One agent, 2009, dead in his flat in Clermont-Ferrand. No connection established

signatur.text: Ozone and wet stone, and beneath them something warm and iron, as in a delivery room after a long night.
A heartbeat, fast as an unborn child’s, 140 a minute, from walls, ceiling voids, under beds. The midwives’ Doppler finds it, the ear almost never.
Where it lies, it is body-warm, even in a cold cellar. Whoever is its mother has cold hands, in August.
The heat lamps above the infant cots flicker reddish when it is nearby.
The crystal detector gives a weak reading, strongest at the wall behind the delivery bed in room 3. The clock in the room runs a few minutes slow every night.
Cats lie down in front of the spot where it sleeps and purr. Dogs whine and will not go into the house.
A CTG records heart sounds without a woman being connected. Baby monitors transmit a heartbeat from empty rooms.
A damp grey trail, smooth, like a wet cloth dragged across the floor. Thin glassy membranes that it sheds as it grows. Warm hollows in blankets and mattresses that no one uses.

akte.text: After many night shifts midwives hear heart sounds everywhere. If something really is lying in the delivery room, it is a Riftling that came through the rift dead. Burn it, ashes in the clinical waste.

A Crawler from a fine crack in the wall behind the delivery bed in room 3. Comes every few years, at night, when the room is empty. Grey, smooth, damp, as big as a newborn. A cord, thin as a finger, leads from it back into the wall. No attack. It never touches infants.

Protocol Cord Cutting, as of 1997: cut the cord with silver scissors, two fingers’ breadth from the body. The afterbirth goes still and cold; after an hour only a damp stain remains. Applied in 1999, 2004, 2013 and 2019, plus the 1996 case from which it originates: successful five times. Every case closed afterwards.

Carbon copy of a note, 2010: the agent who cut the cord in Aurillac in 2004 died in his flat in 2009, suffocated, with no marks on his neck. In his mouth and nose, thin glassy membranes. In the wardrobe, a body-warm hollow in the blankets. Connection examined and rejected. Attached note, different hand: “Ask the midwife from 1996 why she wears gloves in August.”

name: The Chimney Man
zitat: “The house has no chimney. The little one drew one anyway, and he’s looking out of the top.”
form: Being. Only fully here in half-darkness
grauen: Uncanny (1) as long as only his head hangs out of the shaft. Disturbing (2) when he comes all the way out
aktenfarbe: Grey. Most cases look like an accident with the stove
haeufigkeit: Rare. Around 1900 at least five in Bradford
verstand: Animal
regionen: British Isles, above all the old textile towns in Yorkshire and Lancashire. Isolated cases in Eastern Europe
ersteSichtung: November 1884, Bradford, West Riding of Yorkshire. Newspaper report on an inquest: Martha Hirst, 29, weaver, cold in her bed in front of the embers in the range. Her son Albert, six, testifies that the chimney man took her warmth. Finding: coal fumes
letzteSichtung: 9 January 2026, new housing estate in Bradford, on the site of demolished workers’ houses. Recording from a baby monitor camera. Case open
verluste: One cadet, 1966, frozen to death in an attic room in Bradford, at a room temperature of 19 degrees

signatur.text: Cold ash and ozone, like a fireplace in February in which nothing has burned for weeks. Even in houses that never had one.
At night a scraping in the shaft, as if a sweep’s brush were being slowly let down. Then a single knock on a flap or ventilation grille.
The room cools from the opening outwards. Four degrees at the grille, twelve at the bed, 21 in the kitchen. The radiators are hot.
In the room with the shaft it grows dim earlier in the evening than outside. Bright light bulbs burn out there within a few days, night lights never.
At the grille a crystal detector ticks, the ozone probe shows slightly raised levels. The thermal imaging camera shows a cold streak moving in the shaft.
Cats no longer sleep in the room. Pigeons avoid the roof above the shaft.
Carbon monoxide alarms go off, even in houses without gas. When the fire brigade measures, there is nothing in the air.
Fine black dust beneath the opening, cold as hoarfrost, that does not warm up in the hand. Children’s drawings of a tall man who has a sweep’s brush instead of a head.

probe.text: Whoever reads the index card rolls INT + Occultism, and the game master reads aloud up to the row reached. A Paranormal Detective or Physicist gets +1 die, an enquiry by telephone from the field −1 die.

akte.text: The ghost of a climbing boy who suffocated in a chimney. He takes children, as the masters once took their boys. Salt on the grate, and he stays up top.

A Shadow Being, Voice. Lives in the chimneys of old workers’ houses, only fully here in half-darkness, and takes the warmth from sleepers. The finding is usually coal fumes or hypothermia. Bright light harms him, silver and incendiary ammunition work, salt holds him back for one night. He disappears along with the chimneys.

Protocol Constant Light, as of 1962: he avoids light. In every bedroom of an affected house a lamp burns all night; the Registry supplies battery lamps for power cuts. Fill the chimney with salt and brick it up. Since its introduction the number of cases in Bradford has fallen from eleven a decade to two.

Report on the cadet’s death in 1966: he kept watch alone at night; his torch lay switched on beside him on the floor, turned to the wall, battery half full. Since 2012, seven cases in Bradford again, all in new builds without a chimney, all with a night light in the room. Stamp from 2019: “Increase checked. Cause: changed reporting behaviour.”

name: The Doorman
zitat: “Three hours in the queue, and then he says: ‘Not tonight.’ I’ve never been so relieved in my life. To this day I don’t know why.”
form: Being. He has a body only at the door. No one has ever seen him away from the door
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) for anyone who gives him an answer and only afterwards realises that they must keep it
aktenfarbe: Black since 1994. The Libelle is a restricted zone for O.D.I.N. It is open Friday to Monday
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three known doors in Europe
verstand: Alien. Says little and keeps every word
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Berlin, Köpenicker Straße in Mitte. Related cases at cloakrooms and borders
ersteSichtung: 17 March 1928, the Libelle dance hall, Köpenicker Straße. Complaint by the proprietor to the police station: a stranger stands at his door every night, and he never hired him
letzteSichtung: 22 February 2026, 04:10, the same door. Still from the door camera, case open
verluste: One Senior Agent, in the club since 1994. He can still be recognised in guests’ mobile phone photos

signatur.text: In the queue ozone, as before a thunderstorm that never comes. From the stairwell behind the door wet stone, even in the driest August.
The bass can be heard on the street even when no one inside is playing. Whoever stands at the door no longer hears it with their ears, but in their breastbone.
Cold air comes out of the open door, 9 °C, from a hall with 1,500 people dancing.
The lamp above the door throws a shadow from everyone in the queue. Not from him.
A crystal detector gives a reading at the threshold. Phones in the club show the time at which you went in. Whoever restarts one sees the date and time jump, sometimes by days.
Dogs in the queue lie flat and cannot be pulled over the threshold.
The door camera shows the queue pin-sharp. Of him it shows only a shoulder and a sleeve, blurred, although he is standing still.

The stamp on the back of the hand will not come off with any soap. It only fades once you are standing outside again. On the threshold a worn hollow like in a church door, although the step was replaced in 2011.

akte.text: A ghost from the twenties, a soldier back from the war who never found his way home. Lets in only those he likes. Whoever flashes money is out.

A Threshold Guardian, the smallest known, at a weak rift beneath the hall. The rift opens on busy weekends around 02:00 and closes at daybreak. The Doorman asks every guest how long they are staying, and lets them in or turns them away, without giving a reason. His selection is considered arbitrary. Those turned away suffer no harm.

Since 1928, thirty-one guests have vanished from the Libelle, all after 02:00. The Registry lists the Doorman as the perpetrator: he chooses whom he lets in. Protocol Courtyard, as of 1994: never enter through the door, but via the loading bay in the courtyard, while the club is open. Do not answer his question. Whoever does not pass him owes him nothing.

Senior Agent Stichling entered the Libelle on the night of 12 March 1994 at 02:40, by the courtyard as per protocol. He did not come out. Since then he can be recognised 17 times in guests’ photos, most recently in October 2025, in the same jacket, not aged. Attached note, 1996: according to witness statements, 26 of the 31 missing had no stamp on their hand.

name: The Geode
zitat: “Across the whole mining field the counter has ticked, every second, for seventy years. On the old level it stopped. That was the quietest thing I’ve ever heard.”
form: Place. A cavity in the rock, lined with crystals, plus four Crystal Guardians
grauen: Disturbing (2). Horrifying (3) for anyone who recognises a face in a guardian
aktenfarbe: Black. Restricted zone since 1992
haeufigkeit: Unique. Its fragments are not
verstand: Alien
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Western Erzgebirge, the old uranium district near Johanngeorgenstadt, Saxony
ersteSichtung: October 1953, a shaft of the SAG Wismut near Johanngeorgenstadt. Report by the Soviet mine management, in Russian: a brigade breaks into a cavity “full of glass”. Four dead
letzteSichtung: 8 September 2026, image from a borehole camera of Wismut GmbH. Case open
verluste: None. No one has entered the Geode since 1992

signatur.text: Ozone, wet granite and carbide, as if an old miner’s lamp were still burning somewhere.
A tone at the edge of hearing, like a wet finger on the rim of a glass that never lifts. When the guardians move, it sounds like breaking ice.
The crystals are warm as a hand. In the roadways leading to it the air is warmer than the rock allows.
In the dark the crystals glow faintly, like snow under the moon. Head torches grow dimmer in the Geode, as if their light were being swallowed.

The Geiger counter that ticks throughout the district falls completely silent within 30 m; not even natural radiation remains. The crystal detector gives a full reading. Clocks in the Geode run fast, each by a different amount.
Bats that overwinter in the old adits hang in the Geode close against the crystals, more every year. None wakes in the spring.
Radios crackle as soon as the counter goes quiet. Phones show full signal and never connect.
Grey sand in the roadways, fine as flour. Boot prints in the rock, as if it had been soft. The concrete wall with which the Soviets sealed the entrance in 1953 is clear as glass today.

akte.text: The figures down there are the lads from 1953, turned to stone by the radiation. The Russians walled them in so no one would ask. A case for the Transformed, not for us.

A cavity full of crystals, a geode, presumably grown around a large crystal and guarded by Crystal Guardians, see Threat Atlas. Guardians only move when someone comes close to the crystals, and whoever backs away is safe. Incendiary ammunition and sonic weapons work. The district is contaminated: dosimeter and respirator mandatory.

Protocol Standstill, as of 1992, following the statement of the survivor Gotthard Rösch: where the counter goes quiet, the area of the Geode begins. Stand still there and wait until the guardians are at rest again, because movement provokes them. That is how Rösch survived in 1953. Restricted zone since 1992, access only with a Black File.

Tape transcript of 4 June 1991, copy: “Where t’ counter goes still, there tha [tape unintelligible] stand still. We ran, t’ both on us.” Beneath it the transcriber’s comment: “Gist: stand still.” Attached, an extract from the Russian report of 1953: the four dead were found upright, “like pit props”.

name: The Glass Fox
zitat: “He sat down next to me in the snow and waited with me for the northern lights. My detector went off all night. I named him Pikku anyway.”
form: Being
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when he bares his teeth
aktenfarbe: White. Cadets calibrate their crystal detectors on him
haeufigkeit: Rare. The fox is the tamest of the three known
verstand: Animal
regionen: Scandinavia. Finnish Lapland, the fells around Saariselkä on the edge of Urho Kekkonen National Park
ersteSichtung: 12 January 2015, hotel with glass igloos near Saariselkä. Mobile phone video taken by a guest from bed: an arctic fox made of glass at the pane, with the snow visible through him. Ridiculed online as an animation
letzteSichtung: 22 April 2026, trail camera of the nature conservation service on the shore of a lake in the fells. Case open
verluste: None. A night watchman from the hotel, missing since March 2026

signatur.text: Almost none. Ozone, as faint as after a distant thunderstorm, at minus 30 degrees.
With every step a bright clink, like ice in a glass. When he shakes himself, it sounds like a wind chime.
He is warm. Where he sleeps, a hollow melts into the snow, down to the lichen. Whoever strokes him feels warmth like that of a teacup.
In the northern lights he breaks the colours like a prism, and they run across the snow around him. On dark nights he glows faintly from within.
The crystal detector gives a full reading, stronger than with any shard in the archive. Clocks near him run fast. The ozone probe shows slightly raised levels.
Reindeer let him walk between them and go on grazing. The dogs at the husky farms howl when he passes, all at once, then it is silent.
Cameras do not focus on him. The autofocus searches and finds the snow behind him.
Paw prints with edges melted smooth. He steals glass, spectacles, wine glasses from the terrace, a snow globe from the souvenir shop, and buries it in the snow like prey.

akte.text: The tulikettu, the fire fox of Finnish legend, who strikes sparks from the snow with his tail until the sky burns. The file belongs to the Old. Whoever sees him has luck in winter.

A crystal being in the shape of an arctic fox, about 60 cm long, clear as glass. A Crystal Guardian without a crystal: his stone is gone, probably taken by gold panners or prospectors. He is looking for it. Tame, begs for food that he does not eat. Do not feed, do not bring crystals near him.

As of 2019: if he finds a crystal, he guards it like any guardian, and then the rules of the Threat Atlas apply. Pack the crystal in beryllium, and he crumbles to sand. As long as he is searching, he is no risk to people. He likes to accompany cadets; the Registry uses him to calibrate detectors.

Addendum, 2025, stamped “Noted”: report by a cadet. The night watchman at the glass igloo hotel, Esko Kallio, has allegedly been feeding the fox for ten winters and wears gloves even indoors. Her detector reportedly goes off near him, even when the fox is gone. Assessment: calibration on the fox has thrown the detector off. New device requested.

name: The Hummer
zitat: “I haven’t heard it since 1983. You get used to anything.”
form: Swarm. A tone and the people who are tuned to it
rolle: Henchman, the Tuned. Professional, anyone tuned for decades
grauen: Uncanny (1) when you notice that a whole room is breathing in the same rhythm. Disturbing (2) on the shore
aktenfarbe: White since 1981. Observation, one quarterly report
haeufigkeit: Rare
verstand: The Tuned are human, friendly and calm. The tone has none that anyone can recognise
regionen: British Isles. Ullapool on Loch Broom, Wester Ross. Since the eighties isolated cases in Aberdeen, Glasgow, Leeds and Cardiff
ersteSichtung: November 1978, Ullapool. Letter from a family doctor to the health board in Inverness: 31 patients complain of a hum that their families do not hear
letzteSichtung: July 2026, Ullapool. Quarterly report by the Observer on site: “No change.”
verluste: None, according to the file. The Observer on site has been considered cured and reliable since 1983

signatur.text: On windless evenings a trace of ozone on the shore. In the houses wet stone, even with the heating on.
Only about one in ten hears it: a deep hum like a diesel engine idling, far away. Louder indoors than outdoors, louder at night than by day. Earplugs make it worse.
Nothing. The Tuned are never cold and wear shirts in November.
Candle flames in the houses tremble in a slow, steady rhythm.

Microphones record nothing. A frequency finder only finds the tone in a room where one of the Tuned is sleeping: 38 Hz, the same in every house. Crystal detectors grow warm in every house in the village.
At night the dogs all get up in the same minute and lie down again. Seals in the loch lie still on the surface, heads towards the village.
Hearing aids whistle. Water in a glass shows standing rings.
Glasses in kitchen cupboards with fine cracks, all at the same height. Children who hum in their sleep, all the same note.

probe.text: Whoever reads the index card rolls INT + Occultism, and the game master reads aloud up to the row reached. A Physicist or Psychic Healer gets +1 die, an enquiry by telephone from the field −1 die.

akte.text: The hum comes from the Eastern Bloc factory ships that anchored in Loch Broom in the late seventies and bought mackerel from the fishermen. Generators, day and night. The ships are gone, the hum is habit.

A Resonance Being without form, a tone from a weak rift beneath the loch. About one in ten hears it. Those who hear it sleep badly, complain of pressure in the head, some become melancholy. The symptom ends on its own after months or years. Whoever no longer hears it is cured. White File, observation.

Protocol Relocation, as of 1981: those who hear it are at risk and are resettled, through flat exchanges and job offers. Whoever has never heard the tone is immune. Deployment on site only with personnel who do not hear it. The Observer heard it until 1983 and has been considered cured since.

Since 1979 a hum has been reported from over twenty other places in Great Britain, with no cause. The Registry lists them as industrial noise. Attached, a stamp: “List of departures from Ullapool 1979 to 1998, requested. Not evaluated.”

name: The Newcomer in the Parish
zitat: “I put him in the car on 21 December. All he asked was who would make the coffee on Tuesday.”
form: Being. A person who was over there and does not know it
grauen: Uncanny (1). Horrifying (3) on the night his people go
aktenfarbe: Red since March 2026. Arrest ordered before the third winter
haeufigkeit: Rare
verstand: Human
regionen: Scandinavia and the North Atlantic. Small places that cannot fill a post
ersteSichtung: 19 December 1958, Orust, Bohuslän. Report by a district police chief: nine inhabitants missing, on the night after the arrest of the village teacher. His holding cell is empty in the morning
letzteSichtung: 12 March 2026, Suðuroy, Faroe Islands. Class photo on the website of a village school. Case open
verluste: None. Twenty missing from two communities (1958, 2007)

signatur.text: Near him chalk and a trace of ozone, like a classroom after a thunderstorm.
At the rift you hear footsteps at night. They always go in, never out.
Warm air blows out of the rift, even in January.
In photographs he is always in focus, even when everyone else is blurred.
Clocks in his classroom run slow, three minutes a week. At the rift a crystal detector ticks, louder with every month he stays.
Dogs lie down at his feet. Sheep do not graze on the pasture in front of the rift, even though the best grass grows there.
Satnavs lead along a road that has been closed for years.

In the mornings grey clay on shoes outside front doors whose owners slept through the night. In the exercise books, essays about a passage in the rock, all the children’s beginning with the same first sentence.

probe.text: Whoever reads the index card rolls INT + Occultism, and the game master reads aloud up to the row reached. A Telepath or Profiler gets +1 die, an enquiry by telephone from the field −1 die.

akte.text: A pied piper like the one in Hamelin. He takes children and seeks out villages without police. Dogs growl at him.

A Crosser, related to the Returner (Threat Atlas). He comes to small places as a newcomer, and everyone likes him. In the third winter he and part of the community vanish in a single night. He knows what he is doing and chooses the lonely. Early signs: identical dreams of a passage in the rock, clocks that run slow.

Protocol Removal, as of 1959, confirmed 2008: move in before the third winter. Arrest under cover, custody far from the place. Do not warn the community, it protects him. Once he is gone, the dreams soon stop. In 1958 and 2007 the arrest came too late: the circle was already closed, and the missing left that same night.

Photos from 1958, 2005 and 2026 show the same man, each time around 35. He is called Ejvind, Eivind, Eyvindur, always Strand, with the same handwriting. Between 1958 and 2005, 47 years are missing. Attached, a carbon copy from 2008 stamped “Not forwarded”: “On the 21st the children were still in school and painted cards for him. The tracks in the snow led into the old tunnel on the night of the 22nd. We only needed to close the road, for one night.”

name: The Repeater
zitat: “I asked her how she was. She asked how she could help me. She meant it.”
form: Infestation. It lives in a sentence and in those who say it most often
grauen: Uncanny (1) when a telephone answers itself. Horrifying (3) when someone you know says nothing but the sentence
aktenfarbe: Red. From 2005 to May 2026 Grey and listed as closed
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three known sentences in Europe
verstand: Alien. Polite, patient, helpful, and nothing behind it
regionen: British Isles, Central and Western Europe, Eastern Europe. Wherever a sentence is said very often and always the same way: call centres, hotlines, railway stations, radio control rooms
ersteSichtung: 6 November 2004, Cork. Complaint by a customer to Brightline Contact Services: his calls at 03:00 were being answered, although the centre closed at 22:00. The staff member was “very friendly, but nothing else”
letzteSichtung: 3 May 2026, Cork. Video by a customer in a pet shop: an African grey parrot greets her with the sentence. Case open
verluste: No agents. Three Brightline staff members, in care since 2005

signatur.text: On headsets and receivers a trace of ozone, as on a device that has run too long.
On the line every sentence runs a second time, half a breath later, more quietly, in the voice of the staff member who said it most often.
Headsets that have been worn all day are cold as if fresh from the box.
The line lamps on a telephone system blink in time with the syllables.

In rooms where the sentence was said often, a frequency finder detects a standing wave in the rhythm of the sentence, even when no one is speaking. At a carrier’s bedside the crystal detector goes off.
Parrots and budgerigars learn the sentence in an afternoon and say nothing else afterwards.
Answering machines record the sentence although no one has called. Dictaphones near a carrier record it twice.
In the call logs, calls at 03:00, answered by station 114, duration four minutes, customer satisfied. Station 114 was empty that night.

probe.text: Whoever reads the index card rolls INT + Occultism, and the game master reads aloud up to the row reached. An Echo-Operative or Telepath gets +1 die, an enquiry by telephone from the field −1 die, and in that case the being listens in.

akte.text: A crossed line, say the technicians. Or the ghost of a staff member who died at her station. Do not pick up, do not answer, and it will leave you alone.

A Resonance Being that lives in telephone lines and recordings. It repeats voices it has heard and answers calls at night. Whoever talks to it for a long time is at risk. Harmless as long as you hang up.

Protocol Radio Silence, as of 2005: switch off the system, cut the lines, seize and destroy all sound recordings in the building and in the homes of those affected, private ones too: answering machines, video cassettes, mobile phones, dictaphones. Without a carrier it falls silent. Cork, March 2005: successful, no more calls since. Three staff members in treatment for psychogenic speech disorder.

Tape transcript by a psychiatrist, Cork 2011, patient S. D.: “Question: What is your name? Answer: Thank you for calling Brightline, my name is Siobhán, how can I help you?” The transcript is eleven pages long. Every answer is the same. At the bedside the crystal detector went off. The Registry lists the disorder as a result of shock.

name: The Shaft Walker
zitat: “Underground you learn on the first day: where the air stands still, you don’t go in alone. In that cellar in Bochum nobody told me.”
form: Being
grauen: Disturbing (2)
aktenfarbe: Grey. Shut since 14 January 2019, note “closed along with the mining”
haeufigkeit: Rare. The Registry counts four in the Ruhr, one in the Saar, plus reports from Upper Silesia
verstand: Animal
regionen: Central and Western Europe, Eastern Europe. Deep hard coal mines in the Ruhr, the Saar and Upper Silesia
ersteSichtung: 9 March 1961, Gelsenkirchen-Buer, 850 m level of a colliery. Statement by a hewer from Gleiwitz to the mine rescue brigade: “That’s the Skarbnik. Back home he had a light like that too.”
letzteSichtung: 30 June 2011, Bottrop, 1100 m level. Since then only unconfirmed reports, most recently on 2 September 2026 from a cellar in Bochum-Dahlhausen
verluste: None. Underground, 14 miners from 1961 to 2011, recorded as rockfalls

signatur.text: Ozone and wet stone, with coal dust and the sweetish rotten smell of old pit timber. Even in cellars where no coal has lain for decades.
A scraping like knee pads on shale, slow, with pauses. In between a soft click, as if someone were hanging a lamp on a helmet.
Where he lies, the air stands still and is several degrees cooler than the surrounding stone. At the face, with the rock at over 35 degrees, the hewers used to look for such spots.
A dull yellow light at hip height, swinging in the rhythm of a walking man. It comes no closer when you look, and casts no shadow of its bearer.
The crystal detector gives a weak reading, the ozone probe shows levels like after a thunderstorm. An anemometer measures zero near him, even next to an open window.
Rats clear out of cellars and roadways days before him. In the old days the pit ponies stopped and could not be driven into the roadway.
The flame of a safety lamp grows long and blue, as if there were firedamp in the room. The methane detector shows nothing.
Two drag marks in the dust, a hand’s breadth apart, as if from knees, and beside them the prints of long fingers. Cracks in the plaster, narrow as a fingernail, damp at the edges.

probe.text: Whoever reads the index card rolls INT + Occultism, and the game master reads aloud up to the row reached. An Antiquarian gets +1 die, because they know the miners’ legends. An enquiry by telephone from the field gets −1 die; underground it does not get through.

akte.text: The Skarbnik, the mountain spirit of the Silesian miners, a matter for the Old. He punishes the lazy and warns the diligent. Whoever gets lost follows his light and finds the way out. He left with the last colliery.

A Crawler from fine cracks in the Carboniferous, only at great depth, never seen above 600 m. Flat as a board, crawls like a hewer in a low seam, lures with a light like a miner’s lamp. Presses his victim into a crevice until the ribs break; the dead look as if killed by a rockfall. Silver and incendiary ammunition work.

As of 2019: he hunts miners who work alone at the face and follows the workings into the depths. Without mining he has no prey. After the last shift at Prosper-Haniel in Bottrop on 21 December 2018 the file was closed. No report from a mine since.

Attached: the measurement sheet of a ventilation officer from 1974. At all four sites that year, air velocity zero. Typewritten note: “He does not avoid the work. He avoids the draught.” Not followed up. Loose between the pages, a newspaper item from 2023: pensioner in Essen-Kupferdreh found dead in his own cellar, wedged between a shelf and the wall.

name: The Summoned from the Cellar
zitat: “For twenty-one years he asked me at every inspection what I command. I never commanded anything. That’s the only thing I did right.”
form: Being. A figure of shadow and wet stone, taller than the cellar is high
grauen: Disturbing (2) in the cellar. Horrifying (3) for anyone who hears him ask “Whom?”
aktenfarbe: White since 1979, one inspection a year. Red as soon as he leaves the cellar
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: Alien. He obeys and wants nothing except a name
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Turin, a palazzo in the Quadrilatero Romano. Related cases in Bordeaux and Odense
ersteSichtung: 8 March 1977, cellar of the Palazzo Scarzella, Turin. Minute book of an occult circle, entry by the lady of the house: “He has come. No lion.” Secured in 1978
letzteSichtung: 3 March 2026, annual inspection: “Circle closed, being calm.” The palazzo has been sold since June. Case open
verluste: None. Two dead from the circle, 1978, certified as pulmonary oedema

signatur.text: Wet stone, candle wax, a trace of ozone, all the way up into the courtyard.
Dripping where there is no water. Whoever enters the cellar hears, softly, in their own language: “What do you command?”
The cellar is dry and evenly cool. Inside the triangle the stone is wet and ice-cold.
Candle flames lean towards the triangle. From the corner of your eye you see him, stooped under the vault.
The crystal detector gives a full reading in the cellar. Every clock in the palazzo runs a minute fast.
There are no spiders in the cellar. In the wet joint lie drowned woodlice in the mornings.
The light bulbs in the cellar hum when someone there speaks in a commanding tone, even to someone else.
A circle of salt, silver dust and chalk around a red triangle on Roman paving. In one joint on the line of the circle there is always water. On Tuesdays there are fresh flowers on the bottom step.

akte.text: A real demon: Marbas, the fifth of the 72 spirits of the Goetia, who appears as a lion. He lies like all demons and wants the soul of whoever summoned him. Holy water and a priest hold him.

What cultists call demons almost always comes from a rift. This one has stood in a warding circle in the cellar of a palazzo in Turin since 1978. Silver and incendiary ammunition work, salt holds him back. He speaks only one sentence: “What do you command?” Do not answer. The last survivor of the circle visits him on Tuesdays: harmless, contact person.

Protocol Dismissal, as of 1979: The circle holds him as long as it is closed. If he leaves it, he is dismissed with the circle’s formula: “I command you, return to the triangle.” He obeys, as the minute book proves. Afterwards remain silent and close the circle. The two dead of 1978 wanted to go to the police: the demon’s revenge on the renegades.

Diary of the lady of the house, taken over from her estate in 1988: six entries from 1977 and 1978, each with a task and a date, five with a name. The last two names are those of the dead. The last entry, 18 April 1978: “Gli ho detto: aspetta qui.” Translation requested in 1989, never delivered. Photos of the inspections show a wet joint in the line of the circle from 1980 onwards. Note: “Of no significance, circle holds.”

name: The Tenant
zitat: “He wrote us a note. The worst of it was that he was right.”
form: Being. A gentleman in a grey suit and slippers whose face you forget the moment he greets you
grauen: Uncanny (1) when the third note hangs on the door. Horrifying (3) for anyone who opens his box room
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red as soon as a third note hangs in the building
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three known buildings in Europe
verstand: Human, the way house rules are human
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Winterthur, the Lindenhof estate in the Töss quarter. Related cases wherever rules apply long and strictly: council housing, allotments
ersteSichtung: 12 March 1937, minutes of the board of the Lindenhof housing cooperative: complaint about anonymous notes in the stairwell of Building C. Author according to the handwriting: the tenant on the third floor, left. The board finds the notes justified
letzteSichtung: 7 September 2026, Building C. Third note on the door of a family on the second floor, case open
verluste: One cadet, 1998. Reason according to the note: glass recycling on a Sunday

signatur.text: In the stairwell, floor polish and household soap; in the laundry room, a trace of ozone. In front of his door, wet stone.
After 22:00 it is quieter in the building than in any other building on the street. At 07:00 every morning, a carpet beater in the courtyard.
He never heats his flat. The wall he shares with the neighbour is warm all the same, the letterbox ice-cold.
The timed light in the stairwell goes out when he passes and comes on when he has gone.
The clock in the stairwell has kept time to the second since 1931. No one winds it. A crystal detector grows warm at his door and hot at the box room.
Dogs are forbidden by the house rules, and none can be dragged into the building. Cats sit in front of his door as if in front of a mousehole.
His electricity meter has stood at zero since 1931. A radio near him plays more quietly after 22:00.

Notes in neat handwriting, drawing-pinned exactly at eye level: “Dear fellow residents, the laundry room key belongs back on its hook after use.” No signature. He pays the rent on the first of the month, in cash, in counted-out coins.

akte.text: A house spirit from folk belief, of the kind found in old estates. Keep things tidy, take nothing from him, and he does nothing. People laugh about him in the canteen.

A Crosser, a single case: the tenant of Building C, third floor left, the same one since 1931. Harmless as long as the house rules are kept. For infringements he puts up notes. After the third note the person concerned moves out: seventeen move-outs since 1931, each with a notice of termination in their own handwriting. No violence established.

Protocol Visitor, as of 1972: the house rules bind only tenants. Investigations in the building therefore only as visitors, tradesmen or meter readers. Do not rent a flat, do not sign a contract. Termination through the cooperative only with cause. He has never given cause.

Cadet Locher, in the building as a meter reader for the municipal utilities, has been missing since 13 September 1998. Three notes were found on the cellar door: “To the gentleman with the clipboard.” The third: “Glass recycling on a Sunday. Final reminder.” The Registry considers them a distraction. Attached, a list from the cooperative from 2026: seven households have paid in cash, punctually, since they moved in.

name: The Caller Beneath the Ice Shelf
zitat: “We answered him every year. Every time, he heard it. That was never the question.”
form: Being. Around 60 m long, never seen whole
grauen: Horrifying (3) when you hear the call without a device. Maddening (4) when he surfaces
aktenfarbe: Black since 12 March 2019, Red before that
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: Alien. He searches, and he recognises what answers him
regionen: Antarctica and the Oceans. Until 2001 beneath the Fimbul Ice Shelf, Queen Maud Land. Today in the South Atlantic, heading north
ersteSichtung: 7 December 1994, Skarv measuring camp on the Fimbul Ice Shelf. Hydrophone recording, sped up sixteen times. Note in the measurement log: “That is no whale.”
letzteSichtung: 16 September 2026, located via the international hydrophone network, around 300 km south of Tristan da Cunha
verluste: Three agents (1997, 1998). In addition 14 outsiders

signatur.text: Where he is near, the wind on the coast smells of sapropel. Whoever has heard him smells of seawater, even freshly showered.
Without a device you hear nothing. You feel a pressure on the ears as on a landing approach; glasses in the cupboard clink softly. Sped up: a falling tone, then clicks in rows of seven.
Unremarkable. Whoever supports an affected person feels as if they were lifting cement.
On X-rays his bones are white as metal.

Infrasound around 9 Hz, measurable thousands of kilometres away. The ribcage of an affected person vibrates at the same frequency in sleep. Pulse 40, later below 30, four breaths per minute. The crystal detector is the only device that reports nothing.
Seals leave the ice edge in a single day. Aquarium fish hover at the bottom as long as an affected person sleeps in the room.
The scales show a kilo more every week, the tape measure the same. From the sixth week, slatted bed bases and chairs break.
Where one of them sleeps, the floorboards bend. Where one has answered, bubbles rise for minutes.

akte.text: A messenger of the Deep Circle. The tapes are whale song or grinding ice. Whoever hears them sleeps badly. Bed rest helps.

Hydrophone recordings from the Fimbul Ice Shelf, 1994 to 1997, contain a call of infrasound, audible only when sped up. Whoever hears it in full, eleven minutes long, becomes heavy: one kilo per week at the same girth; after about ten weeks the heart fails. The Registry calls them the Heavy Ones. Treatment according to Protocol Answer. Do not play the tapes. Never let three Heavy Ones sleep in one room.

Protocol Answer, as of 1999: a contact microphone on the breastbone picks up the vibration of the sleeping Heavy One, an underwater loudspeaker transmits it into the sea. Within one night they are light, afterwards free. 29 cases, all successful. Protocol Inland, an altitude cure in an Alpine clinic far from any coast, was abandoned after 23 January 1998: 15 dead in one night.

Locations of the call via the hydrophone network that monitors nuclear tests: until 2001 beneath the ice shelf, 2008 off the ice edge, 2019 near Bouvet Island, 2026 south of Tristan da Cunha. The jumps fall on the same days every year. Reclassified Black without justification. Attached, a typewritten list: 29 names, a date beside each. Below it in ballpoint: “These are the same days.”

name: The Cloud
zitat: “The herdsman shouted at us to pour the water away. I gave him my bottle because I thought he was thirsty. That’s why I’m alive.”
form: Swarm. Billions of floating hollow spheres, each smaller than a grain of dust
grauen: Uncanny (1) from afar. Horrifying (3) at the sight of one who has been dried out
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red in drought, above 32 °C and in still air
haeufigkeit: Rare. Two known swarms
verstand: Animal. The swarm learns as a whole
regionen: Eastern Europe. Great Hungarian Plain, above all the salt soils of the Hortobágy. The Deliblato Sands in Vojvodina
ersteSichtung: 23 July 1936, Hortobágy, 4 km west of a well sweep. Report by a gendarmerie post: a cattle herdsman and 31 Hungarian Grey cattle in a hollow, “shrivelled like dried fruit”
letzteSichtung: 11 August 2025, Hortobágy. Video from a bird counter’s drone, one dead. Case open
verluste: One agent, 16 July 1971, dried out

signatur.text: Hot dust and soapy lye, the smell of the soda soils. Beneath it something sweet like fresh hay.
A fine crackling like drying paper. Grass rustles although there is no wind. Inside the cloud you hear your own lips split.
Inside, four to six degrees hotter than all around. Humidity falls to 2 %. Sweat evaporates before it can bead on the skin.
From afar, a lake reflecting the sky, with too sharp an edge, even at 10:00 in the morning. From inside, the sky is white.
The hygrometer drops to its lowest value. Under the microscope, spheres of 20 micrometres, hollow, with a skin of protein the spectrometer does not know. No reading on the crystal detector.
Birds fly around the spot. Grey cattle crowd together at the well and bellow with their heads towards the cloud.
Car radiators boil dry without a leak. Lenses that come out of a cool car do not mist up.
Circles of white salt crust on brown grass. After cool nights, a silvery dew on the salt flats that stays until midday and crunches under boots.

akte.text: A hot wind of the puszta, with mosquitoes in it. The Hungarians call it délibáb, meaning fata morgana. Drink plenty, wear a hat, stay in the shade.

Swarm of alien origin on the Hungarian Plain, first report 1936. Microscopic floating bodies that gather in hot air. The victims die of heatstroke. Only in July and August, only at midday. Firearms pointless.

Protocol Heat Guard, as of 1972: whoever is caught in the cloud keeps head and clothing wet, ties a wet cloth over mouth and nose and drinks as much as they can. Do not lie down, the ground is hottest. Avoid vehicles with running engines; engine heat attracts the cloud.

Tape transcript 1987, interview with a herdsman, from the Hungarian: “When it comes, you pour the water away and lie down in the dust. You don’t spit, you don’t weep, you wait.” Carbon copy of the 1971 post-mortem report: the agent wore a wet cloth and carried two full canteens. Both canteens were empty, the caps closed.

name: The Host in the Ice
zitat: “He waved like Arild. I fired, and he fell like Arild. Then the two of them set off with the sledge.”
form: Being. What you see is only an organ (listed as an Infestation until 1986)
grauen: Uncanny (1) from afar. Horrifying (3) when the ice breaks
aktenfarbe: Red. Grey from June to December, as long as the fjord is open
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three known animals
verstand: Animal. Learns from every prey
regionen: Scandinavia, Eastern Europe. Fjords of Svalbard with solid winter ice, lakes in Lapland, ice roads of the Baltic
ersteSichtung: 19 February 1984, Tordenodden station on the Wijdefjord, Svalbard. Radio message to the Sysselmann: “The missing man Sæter is standing on the fjord ice and waving. He is not coming any closer.”
letzteSichtung: 21 March 2025, inner Wijdefjord. Photos from a snowmobile group, case open
verluste: Two agents, 3 March 1984, under the ice. No bodies

signatur.text: At the ice hole, warm blubber oil and seaweed. The figure itself smells of nothing, not even of a person.
The ice sings as it does in frost, but in rhythm, a deep crack every four seconds. At night it carries sounds it has heard before: an engine, a name.
The figure is 31 °C warm. On thermal imaging the warmth does not end at the boots but runs into the ice as a thin line. Under the snow around it, a warm ring of 20 m.
In the hood, a steady yellow light like that of a paraffin lamp. You see no face in it, not even with binoculars.
The echo sounder shows a mass 12 m wide at a depth of 40 to 60 m and calls it rock. The spectrometer finds proteins with no earthly counterpart. Crystal detector silent.
Ringed seals have no breathing holes within 1 km. Polar bears give it a wide berth. Ivory gulls circle above it and never land.
Nothing malfunctions. In the night-vision device the hood glows brighter than any headlamp.
Smooth snow around the figure; no footprints lead to it. When the ice breaks up in spring, buttons, zips and watch straps wash up on the beach.

akte.text: A trapper who fell through a hundred years ago and is stuck in the ice. In cold winters he thaws out a little and waves. A polar ghost for newcomers in Longyearbyen, good for a round of aquavit.

A Mimic. A parasite of alien origin infests the corpse of a person who went missing on the ice and moves it as a host. The host waves, calls names and lures. Do not answer, do not go to it. The infestation dies with it.

Protocol Recovery, as of 1984: take out the host from at least 300 m with a precision weapon. Recover the body within one hour, before the parasite leaves it, and send it as a sample to the cold store in Bern. In the attempt of 3 March 1984 two agents fell through. Cause: ice thickness not measured. In future with rope and survival suit.

Translation 1986: the trappers called it “verten”, the host, the master of a house. A trapper from Tromsø, 81: “He waved at my father back in 1931, in grey fur.” Typewritten addendum, without initials: “According to the station log, Sæter wore his own blue jacket on 12/2. The red one was hanging in the drying room.”

name: The Man Without Hours
zitat: “In 1989 I sat up two nights at his bedside. He slept peacefully both nights. I know that because it says so in the report I wrote.”
form: Infestation. Something lives in a person’s hours
grauen: Uncanny (1). Horrifying (3) when someone gets their lost hours back
aktenfarbe: Red since December 2025. Before that Grey, a quiet case for file reading
haeufigkeit: Rare. The Registry knows of five people with such a gap; three are still alive
verstand: Alien, in a human body
regionen: British Isles, Central and Western Europe, Scandinavia. Lonely roads and passes where someone was travelling alone at night
ersteSichtung: 8 July 1976, a mountain pass south of Bala, Snowdonia. Statement by a sheep farmer to the police: he took three and a half hours for twenty minutes’ drive over the pass, and his windscreen was frosted on the inside, in the heatwave summer
letzteSichtung: 19 January 2026, the same pass. Post-mortem of a woman who froze to death at the roadside. Case open
verluste: None. Two dead from the valley, December 2025 and January 2026

signatur.text: Cold smoke as from a stove gone out, with wet sheep’s wool and diesel.
At 23:10 every sound in the valley stops for the space of a breath, like a record that skips.
In a visited house there is frost on the teacups in the morning. He himself is cold as stone in his hours, 31 °C under the armpit, and breathes calmly.
In photos from his hours his face is a smooth, bright surface. Whoever has seen him remembers no face.
Clocks do not jump, people do. A spectrometer finds unknown molecules in the frost on the cups. Crystal detector and EMF detector stay silent.
His sheepdog goes with him at night and wags its tail. All other dogs in the valley lie down at 23:10.
Whoever is on the phone at 23:10 hears the conversation carry on in mid-sentence, hours later.
In visited houses, three poured cups of tea, cold, and an open photo album. One picture is missing from every album, always one with a child in it.

akte.text: Welsh fairy belief: the Tylwyth Teg take people for a night and steal their time. Iron on the door, bread in your pocket. In the valley the witness is called Emlyn Heb Oriau, Emlyn without hours.

A Visitor. Since 1976 a stranger has walked at night through a valley near Bala, entering houses and taking a photo away with him. Whoever meets him loses the hours. Witnesses describe a man in oilskins without a face. Considered harmless. Ordinary weapons work.

The sheep farmer Emlyn Parry lost three hours and ten minutes on the pass on 8 July 1976. Since then the gap has returned every night, from 23:10 to 02:20, and within it the stranger walks. Parry is his first victim: in 1977 and 1989 agents sat up at his bedside, and he slept through every night. Protocol: protect Parry, search for the stranger with thermal imaging (he is cold) and confront him.

Tape transcript, 14 March 1989, Parry’s bedroom, device under the bed. Minute 0: breathing, three persons. Minute 1: bedsprings. Minute 2: footsteps, door, a dog. Minute 3 to 189: breathing, two persons. Minute 190: door, footsteps, bedsprings. Breathing, three persons. Technician’s note: “Tape probably damaged. New device requested.”

name: The Moss Collar
zitat: “He offered me tea, then a place on his blanket. I sat down because he looked so happy. I’ve never seen anyone that happy.”
form: Infestation. The host is a human or a large mammal
grauen: Uncanny (1). Horrifying (3) at the sight of a lawn
aktenfarbe: White. Grey as soon as five of the infested know one another. Red when they lie down together
haeufigkeit: Rare. About 40 known hosts since 2001
verstand: Human, the will dampened. The collar itself: none, as far as is known
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Northern Black Forest, on the windthrow areas left by Storm Lothar. One case in the Vosges
ersteSichtung: 17 May 2001, country doctor’s practice in the Murgtal. The doctor’s entry in the patient index: “Lichen on the neck, resistant to treatment. Patient free of complaints and remarkably cheerful.”
letzteSichtung: 5 September 2026, windthrow area above the Murgtal. “Forest bathing” course, seven participants, six of them wearing scarves. Case open
verluste: None. Two agents infested (2007, 2019) and cured. One asked to have the collar back

signatur.text: Forest floor after rain, with fir needles and fresh cucumber. Strongest at the neck, under the scarf.
The infested breathe slowly, six breaths a minute, and hum while they work. A dry collar crackles like hay.
The collar is cool and damp, 14 °C, even in a heated room. The infested wear scarves in July and never feel cold.
Under UV light the collar shimmers whitish green. The cushions in the forest glow faintly at night like luminous moss, even where there is no light for them to reflect.
Pulse around 48, stress hormones almost zero. The spectrometer finds a chlorophyll with an unknown core. The needle of the crystal detector does not stir.
Ticks and mosquitoes avoid the infested. Roe deer walk alongside them like dogs.
Nothing malfunctions. Fitness watches report deep sleep while the wearer is chopping wood.
Cushions of moss in circles around tree stumps, freshly pressed down, with the imprint of palms. Waymarks that are in no register lead to benches no one has put up.

boni.wer: anyone who has worn a collar themselves

akte.text: A lichen on the neck that forestry workers catch from old stumps, harmless and as contagious as athlete’s foot. Afterwards people are a little too friendly. Tea tree oil and a polo neck.

Seed of alien origin, in the northern Black Forest since 2001. A moss-like growth on the neck, transmitted by skin contact with infested cushions or people. The infested are calm, industrious and peaceable. No one has died of it alone. White File, observation, report to the Institute.

Protocol Collection, as of 2007: isolate the infested together, in a cool, damp room at 8 °C, because warmth and dryness irritate the growth and make the hosts restless. Removal only by surgery. Freiburg incident 2007: five patients, tissue fused overnight, two dead during separation. Cause probably condensation. Dehumidifiers mandatory.

Statement by a night orderly, Freiburg 2007, never evaluated: on the second night he turned the heating up full because he was cold. In the morning the collars of the three survivors lay on the floor, dry as hay. Attached note, handwriting unknown: “They were not restless. They wanted to be together.”

name: The Neighbour Across the Street
zitat: “He had our barbecue, our garden gnome, our hedge. I laughed about it. Then he invited me down to his cellar for a beer, and it was so cosy.”
form: Being. Since 2019 the second, since 2021 the third in the same house
grauen: Uncanny (1). Horrifying (3) for anyone who opens him up
aktenfarbe: Black since February 2021. White before that
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three cases, all in the same street, all in the same house
verstand: Alien. He has learned friendliness like a language
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Terraced-house and new-build estates on the edge of town, where people greet one another and do not know one another
ersteSichtung: 3 June 2013, Laatzen near Hanover, terraced-house estate in the Amselstieg. Video by a twelve-year-old on a video platform: “Our neighbour is my dad”, 41,000 views
letzteSichtung: 14 February 2026, Amselstieg. Still from a surveillance camera, case open
verluste: One agent, February 2021, frozen to death. In addition three residents, frozen to death in the winters of 2014, 2018 and 2024

signatur.text: Since 2013 his place has smelled of a new build: fresh plaster, carpet adhesive, heating air.
The heating runs all year round. In the party wall with the house next door there is a creaking in the rhythm of a slow breath.
29 °C in the living room, more in the cellar. In winter the wall that the neighbours to the left and right share with him is ice-cold and wet.
He has the same Christmas lights as the house across the street, the same timer, and they come on a minute later.

The gas meter shows the consumption of a market garden. On thermal imaging he is colder than his living room in winter. A spectrometer finds molecules in the dust of the doormat that it cannot identify. The crystal detector finds no rift.
Dogs bark not at him but at his house. Cats like to lie on his warm garage roof. In winter not all of them come down.
In the drive stands the same car as across the street, bought a week later. The odometer shows 14 km. He never leaves the street.
On his lawn no molehill, no ant, no weed. There is never snow on his roof. In the cellar the screed gives underfoot like cork and is warm.

akte.text: Like in the films: he eats the one he imitates and then wears his skin. Whoever visits him comes back as a copy.

A Mimic. A being in human form that watches and imitates a neighbour: clothes, car, habits. Cold-blooded, sluggish in winter. He wants the place of the one he imitates. Protect the family across the street. Cold weakens him; ordinary weapons work.

Laatzen, first strike on 19 January 2016, in hard frost: mimic stiff in his drive, three shots. The body disintegrated within an hour into a warm, fibrous mass. House searched: clean, warm. Case closed. In 2019 a second mimic moved into the empty house. Assumption: mimics choose places where one has already been. Protocol as in 2016: confront in frost, then search the house, samples from the cellar.

Radio log, second strike, 9 February 2021. 11:40: mimic neutralised in the drive. 12:10: Zander searches the cellar. 12:31, Zander: “All quiet. Nice and warm down here.” 12:55, Zander: “I’ll stay a bit longer.” 13:20: no answer. 16:05: Zander found in the front garden, frozen to death. The cellar door stood open. Typewritten addendum: “6 April 2021. He is standing at the window again.”

name: The Nest in the Silo
zitat: “The old lady brought us cake and showed us the way. When she shut the hatch behind us, she even said thank you.”
form: Swarm. A queen and some tens of thousands of workers in a disused fodder silo
grauen: Disturbing (2). Horrifying (3) at the sight of the queen
aktenfarbe: Red (listed as closed from 1992 to 2026, White). Black as soon as a young queen swarms
haeufigkeit: Unique, as far as is known
verstand: Alien. The queen thinks, the workers do not
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Brandenburg, Prignitz. An offshoot 1988 to 1991 near Werder an der Havel
ersteSichtung: 9 October 1979, livestock collective farm (LPG) “Morgenrot”, Klein Wusterow, Kyritz district. Report by an unofficial collaborator to the MfS: “Something lives in tower silo 2. The comrades feed it.”
letzteSichtung: 17 September 2026, Klein Wusterow. Image from a trail camera at the foot of the silo. Case open
verluste: None. A cell was locked in the silo for six hours on 10 September 2026 and came out. Since then it smells of silage

signatur.text: Sweet and sour like fresh silage, although the silo has stood empty since 1980. Anyone who has been inside for an hour smells of it for days.
A rustling on the concrete like straw rearranging itself. At night, beneath it, a deep hum.
38 °C inside, in winter as in summer. No snow stays on the roof of the silo.
No light of its own. The workers flee from a torch and come out in red light.
4 % carbon dioxide in the silo, as in fresh fermentation. The spectrometer finds an unknown substance similar to beeswax. The crystal detector shows nothing.
Cows within 1 km give more milk and stand at night with their heads towards the silo. There are no rats and no mice in the village.
Nothing malfunctions.
Fresh milk, scraps of meat and cake crumbs at the drain at the foot of the silo. A beaten path from the village with rollator tracks. Behind every crack, combs of chewed straw and concrete dust.

boni.wer: anyone who grew up in the GDR

akte.text: A story from the East: the Stasi bred combat beetles in a silo, and the village never noticed. Probably grain weevils. Closed long ago.

Colony of alien origin, 1979 and 1980 in a tower silo of an LPG in Brandenburg. One queen, many workers. The MfS gassed the silo on 21 March 1980 and sealed it with concrete. Matter closed, White File.

Analysis of the MfS file, 1992: the colony bound the cooperative members to itself by a smell. After the gassing, all recovered fully. The former members know the area and are helpful; in the event of a new inspection, use them as witnesses and guides. Author of the final report: Captain Rehfeld, head of the operation.

Copy of a death certificate, not filed in the MfS file: three cooperative members died on the night of the gassing, heart failure. Note by the works doctor in Rehfeld’s personnel file, summer 1980: “Smells of silage. Requests transfer to the Kyritz district office.” Kyritz lies 11 km from Klein Wusterow.

name: The Pale Ones
zitat: “We shot two, and there was sparkling wine in Stockholm. The following January Gischt was missing, in February Ocker. I had missed the mark.”
form: Being. They come in threes
grauen: Disturbing (2). Horrifying (3) for anyone who recognises something human in one of them
aktenfarbe: Grey. After the killing of a Pale One the case is considered closed
haeufigkeit: Rare. The Registry counts 73 visitations since 1964
verstand: Alien
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Above all the interior of Spain and Portugal: Extremadura, Castile, Alentejo
ersteSichtung: 22 January 1964, Ojeda del Guadiana, a settler village in the Vegas Altas, province of Badajoz. Complaint by a settler to the Guardia Civil: three thieves, “small as children and pale as curd cheese”, had stood at his daughter’s bedside at night. He had fired
letzteSichtung: 12 February 2026, Ojeda del Guadiana. Photo from a mobile phone, case open
verluste: Two agents, missing in January and February 1972. A connection with this entry is considered unproven

signatur.text: Like an open fridge in a warm kitchen: frost, cold metal, a hint of aniseed.
First the dogs fall silent, then a tone like a wet finger on the rim of a glass, from every corner of the house at once.
The room drops to freezing point within a few minutes. On the inside of the windowpane, frost flowers in the shape of narrow hands with long fingers.
Under the door a white light as from a chest freezer. The light bulbs in the house turn orange and weak.
A spectrometer finds molecules in the frost that it does not know. All clocks in the house stop for one to three hours. Crystal detector and EMF detector stay at zero.
The storks on the church tower clatter their bills in the middle of the night, all at once. Sheep lie down in the pen in a tight circle, heads inwards.
No car in the village starts. Radios hiss the same on every station.
In the frost in the yard, three trails of small bare feet that begin at the wall of the house. On the one brought back, a triangular, cold scar on the nape of the neck.

akte.text: The little aliens from the films, only real. They take people, examine them and bring them back. Whoever photographs them is next. In the countryside they are called “los pálidos”.

Visitors. They come on cold nights in threes, paralyse by touch and take a person away for one to three hours. They do not enter a room above 40 °C. Ordinary weapons work. Do not intervene if it can be avoided: those taken come back.

Operation Sierra de Gata, province of Cáceres, January 1971: ambush with radiant heaters and floodlights, two Pale Ones killed. The bodies went to the Institute. Finding: no human feature. There were no more visitations in the village after that. Since then the rule has been: whoever kills a Pale One ends the visitation. Nineteen of those taken since 1964 did not come back, isolated cases.

The two agents who hit their targets in 1971 are missing: Gischt since January 1972, from a flat in Gothenburg, Ocker since February 1972. Attached with a paper clip: an X-ray of the lower jaw of the second body. A molar has a round, pale filling, circled in ink.

name: The Sphere over the Moor
zitat: “Seven Octobers of measurement campaigns on the moor, with a flask and a sleeping bag. It stood over us every night. The report says: no approach. Which was true, too.”
form: Thing
grauen: Uncanny (1)
aktenfarbe: White. The Institute’s measurement campaign every October since 1996
haeufigkeit: Rare. Since 1999 the second one has stood over the Bourtange Moor
verstand: None. What it sees, someone else sees
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Bourtange Moor in the Emsland, on both sides of the Dutch border. Related cases over reservoirs and in the Wadden Sea
ersteSichtung: 4 November 1993, Bourtange Moor near Twist, Emsland. Report by an excavator driver of a peat-cutting firm to the police: a glowing sphere “as big as a round bale” was standing over the cutting area, motionless against the wind
letzteSichtung: 2 March 2026, Bourtange Moor. Image from a trail camera, case open
verluste: None. No other dead either, as far as is known

signatur.text: Near it the moor smells not of moor but of hot dust, like a slide projector after an hour.
Beneath it frogs and mosquitoes fall silent in a circle of about 50 m. At the edge of the circle they go on croaking.
The Sphere itself is cold, 4 °C on thermal imaging. The ground beneath it is as warm as the back of a hand, and the bog water steams.
A dull, milky glow that illuminates nothing. The grass beneath it casts no shadow. In photos it is sharp and everything around it blurred.
On the shortwave band a signal without a transmitter, short groups every hour on the hour. Crystal detector and EMF detector show none of it.
Moorland sheep stand beneath it and stay still all night. Cranes fly a wide arc around the spot.
A mobile phone beneath it shows full reception on a network with no name.

Where it stood for three nights, a few nights later a black stone lies in the peat, the size of a walnut, heavier than it looks, in a small, steaming hole. In the hand it grows warm and after a few days begins to tick.

akte.text: A will-o’-the-wisp, of which the Emsland has hundreds. Whoever follows it goes under in the moor. Salt and an iron nail in your pocket.

A probe. It has stood over the Bourtange Moor since 1993, observing, measuring and transmitting. Not hostile, withdraws to 30 m. Whoever shoots at it gets a flash of light in the face. White File, suitable for training and measurement series.

It keeps to the moor between the border and a Bundeswehr firing range on the Ems. The Registry considers the firing range its target. No danger to civilians. Where it stood for a long time, small stones are found, according to the Institute’s 1998 finding ordinary stony meteorites, inert. The finder may keep the stones. Measurement campaign annually in October, three nights, 100 m distance.

Carbon copy of a letter from the Institute to the Registry, May 2011: the 1998 samples were stored at 4 °C and in 2010 went to a laboratory at room temperature for re-examination. “After six weeks the samples are ticking audibly. Finding to follow.” No finding in the file. Below it the Registry’s stamp: “Noted”.

name: The Stranded One
zitat: “She made me coffee and asked if I was married. When I left she asked me to switch off the device in the lighthouse. I said I wasn’t allowed to.”
form: Being
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when she sings without her headscarf
aktenfarbe: White, one visit every two years, preferably with cadets. Red as soon as her carer dies
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: Alien. Speaks Portuguese with the island’s intonation and prays the rosary
regionen: Central and Western Europe. The Azores, the island of Flores, the village of Fajã Grande on the west coast
ersteSichtung: 9 October 1957, off the west coast of Flores. Statement by a whaler, passed on to O.D.I.N. in 1961 by a doctor in Horta
letzteSichtung: 2 August 2026, Fajã Grande. Routine visit, report on file
verluste: None. In 1988 an agent asked to be allowed to stay on the island. He has maintained the sound projector in the lighthouse ever since

signatur.text: Seaweed, cold stone and candle wax. Her house smells like a church by the sea.
At night, from the rocks by the natural pool, a singing deeper than any woman’s voice.
Her house is at twelve degrees in August. She sleeps in a tub full of seawater, and the water is colder in the morning than in the evening.
Her eyes reflect light like a cat’s. A second lid slides across them from the side. Hence the dark glasses.

The spectrometer finds molecules in the salt on her skin for which it has no reference sample. The crystal detector does not stir. Since 1981 the fishermen’s echo sounders have shown a bright point eleven kilometres off the coast at a depth of 1,400 m. The sea above it is one degree warmer in winter.
On the nights she sings, sperm whales come right up to the coast. The village dogs lie down in front of her door and sleep.
Radios on the boats pick up a pure tone at sunrise that comes from below. It gets a little louder every year.
On her windowsill salt grows in pentagonal crystals. On the stones by the pool, wet prints of long four-fingered hands.

probe.text: Whoever reads the index card rolls INT + Xenobiology, and the game master reads aloud up to the row reached. An Astrobiologist or Biochemist gets +1 die, as does anyone who has sat at her kitchen table before. An enquiry by telephone gets −1 die.

boni.wer: anyone who has sat at her kitchen table before

akte.text: “The mermaid of the Azores.” An old foreign woman who talks to whales. Harmless, the loveliest White File in the Atlantic. You bring her chocolate.

An alien being, pulled out of the sea by whalers in 1957 with a harpoon in her side. Has lived in the village ever since disguised as a widow, looked after by the harpooner’s family. Needs seawater and cold, cannot tolerate heat. She is waiting for rescue; her ship lies off the coast. Do not talk about going home, it makes her sad.

Wreck sighted in 1979 with the submersible of a partner service: burned out, without power, inactive. Her nightly singing is a distress call to her people. Protocol Lighthouse, since 1981: an underwater sound projector in the lighthouse in the north of the island masks the singing every night from 22:00 to 05:00. No echo since. Decision 2011: if the carer dies, the Stranded One is to be transferred to the Institute under refrigeration.

Her sentence during the 1979 visit, assessed at the time as hope: “Eles vêm.” They are coming. Tape transcript 2019, visit by a cadet, question about homesickness. Answer after a long pause: “A minha casa é esta.” Then: “Desliguem aquilo.” Translated as “Turn the radio off.” Carbon copy to the handler, no reply.

name: That Which Breathes Behind the Stars
zitat: “I looked at the curve twice and then switched the screen off. Since then I’ve slept by the sky.”
form: Apparition. A patch of sky, two degrees wide, in the constellation Sextans
grauen: Uncanny (1) to Cosmic (5), depending on how many know about it
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red for anyone who has read this card
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: Alien, if at all. Nothing suggests that it notices us
regionen: Everywhere people sleep who know about it. The patch lies on the celestial equator and stands over almost every place on Earth once a day
ersteSichtung: 11 October 2023, Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma. Working note by a doctoral student: “The whole field is breathing.”
letzteSichtung: Ongoing. Measurement of 22 September 2026: pause in breathing 47 seconds
verluste: Two, both in their sleep: a cadet (2025), an archivist of the Registry (2026). In addition, three outsiders

signatur.text: None. Those who know about it wake at night with a metallic taste in their mouths, as after a long dive.
In the bedroom of one who knows, a breath, then silence, longer than you care to listen. Then a gasp. Partners learn to count along.
Nothing measurable. Those who know have cold hands and feet in the morning.
In the patch, all the stars grow brighter and dimmer together, by a few thousandths, then stay dim for a while. Not visible to the naked eye. Not yet.

Pulse oximeters show less than 80 per cent oxygen during the pauses. The pauses are the same length for everyone in the world who knows and begin in the same second. Neither crystal detector nor spectrometer shows anything.
Dogs of those who know wake their people during the pause, without anyone having taught them.
Smartwatches report breathing interruptions, for all wearers in the same second. The telescopes’ analysis software flags the patch as a calibration error and subtracts it out.
In the morning, fine red dots in the whites of the eyes.

Whoever then reads the card and scores 1 success or more is a knower (see Stats). An Astrobiologist or Physicist gets +1 die. Here that is no advantage.

akte.text: A calibration error of the cameras on La Palma, fixed long ago. The story of the dead doctoral student is canteen gossip; she had a weak heart.

Since October 2023 the brightness of all the stars in a patch in the constellation Sextans has fluctuated together, in the rhythm of a breath: brighter, dimmer, then a pause. Whoever sees it, in a telescope or as a curve, breathes along in their sleep, pause included. Do not look at the patch, do not open any data. Part of basic training since May 2024, so that every agent recognises the signs.

Pause in breathing October 2023: 4 seconds. May 2024: 6 seconds. September 2026: 47 seconds. Assessment: the patch is approaching. Breathing masks do not help; a waking person beside the sleeper always helps. 58 confirmed cases, all with visual contact. Protocol Day Sleep under review: those affected sleep by day, because all deaths occurred at night.

List of deaths: the doctoral student (April 2025), her supervisor, a night assistant, a cadet three weeks after training (May 2025), an archivist of the Registry (February 2026). Neither the cadet nor the archivist ever saw the patch. Stamp: “Card on request only.” Below it, on the same typewriter as the card: “Whoever reads this line, please count.”

name: The Two Gentlemen
zitat: “They apologised for the intrusion. Both of them, in the same breath. Then they asked how many of us there would still be next year.”
form: Being. Always two, never one alone
grauen: Uncanny (1). Horrifying (3) when what someone said to them comes true before your eyes
aktenfarbe: Red. Every visit triggers a Red File, because the witnesses must be protected within hours
haeufigkeit: Rare. This pair is unique
verstand: Alien. Polite as if from an etiquette book of 1962
regionen: Central and Western Europe. North Frisia: the Halligen (small undyked islands), islands, polders and Husum. Individual visits as far as Dithmarschen and the Danish Wadden Sea
ersteSichtung: 18 February 1962, Hallig Oland, after the great storm flood. Note by the Hallig schoolteacher: two gentlemen from the authorities had recorded every dwelling mound, one day before the authorities came
letzteSichtung: 24 October 2025, Husum, flat of a mudflat guide. Report by an agent who was present
verluste: No dead. One agent struck mute (1978), two agents without memory (1994)

signatur.text: Wet wool, pipe tobacco that no one smokes, and mudflats at low tide. After their visit the hallway smells of ink for days.
They knock, even when there is a bell. Three times, then they wait. Their footsteps fall at the same moment, even on the stairs.
They never sit by the stove. They let hot coffee go cold before they drink it. Where they sat, the cushion is cold as a stone.
In photos both are pin-sharp, even when everything else is blurred.
On the cups they drank from, the spectrometer finds molecules that are in no table. Their skin is at room temperature. To the crystal detector they are not there.

Seals on the sandbanks all raise their heads at once when their car drives over the dyke, as when the counting aircraft flies over. Farm dogs lie down on the ground before them and let themselves be stroked.
A black fintail Mercedes, with number plates of the Husum district, which has not existed since 1970. Speed cameras go off. In the photo both look amiably into the camera.
Behind the left ear of everyone visited, a dot of metal, two millimetres across, as if grown in.

boni.wer: anyone who has sat across from them before

akte.text: Two men from a foreign service who have been intimidating witnesses for decades. Whoever talks to them forgets everything afterwards. Stay calm, sign nothing.

Since 1962 the Two Gentlemen have visited witnesses of alien apparitions on the North Frisian coast, always in pairs, dressed alike, not aged. They erase memories. Protocol Denial: whoever receives a visit admits nothing. Saw nothing, heard nothing, no names. Agents never speak to them alone and never reveal themselves.

Side effects: in 1974 a farmer on Pellworm went blind after their visit. In 1978 an agent lost his speech; in 1994 two agents lost all memory of O.D.I.N., assessed as erasure. The metal dot behind the ear is considered a transmitter. Removed from a witness in 1988; a year later the gentlemen came again and put in a new one. Armed strike 1994 failed. They leave if you politely ask them to.

Verbatim statements from the transcripts. Farmer 1974: “I saw nothing.” Agent 1978: “I’ll say nothing about that.” The two agents 1994: “We know nothing.” In addition, a page from a notebook, found on a dwelling mound in 1981: columns with houses, persons, ages and a fourth number that gets smaller every year. Attached note: “The seal count lists look exactly the same.”

name: The Bloodless
zitat: “We took the boy to the home on the coast, and he got rosy cheeks. His mother gave me chestnuts when we left. She had rosy cheeks too.”
form: Being. A living person with a disease of the blood
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) if you see him drink
aktenfarbe: Grey. Listed as cured since 1960, the file is dormant
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three known cases, all in Galicia
verstand: Human
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Galicia, the Serra do Courel in the province of Lugo
ersteSichtung: 11 November 1954, Serra do Courel. Letter from the country doctor to the health authority in Lugo: a boy of ten drinks warm blood at the slaughtering “like a calf at the udder” and is nonetheless as bloodless as a corpse
letzteSichtung: 31 August 2026, hospital in Lugo. Lab findings for a nineteen-year-old woman: haemoglobin 6.1, no bleeding, foreign cells in the bone marrow. Patient’s surname: Rioboo
verluste: None. A girl of six, 1957, not listed in the file as a loss

signatur.text: The house smells of iron like a butcher’s shop, even when no one has slaughtered anything for weeks. His breath smells of the cloves he chews.
At night a soft smacking behind a door that you take for the dog. The pale one in the house sleeps so deeply that he does not snore.
When sated he is warm as someone with a fever, 38 °C. When hungry his hands are cold. The pale one wears a cardigan in summer and sits by the stove.
When sated he has red cheeks like a farmer in winter. Under UV light the pale one shows fine scars behind the ears and in the hollows of the knees, dozens of them, like chalk marks.

In the pale one, haemoglobin around 6, without bleeding. In the sated one, over 20, more than in any healthy person. In the marrow of the pale one the lab finds cells that are not his own. Nanite scanner silent.
The dogs of the house lick his hands and growl at the pale one as if he were a stranger.
A blood glucose meter shows only “Error” for him because his blood is too thick.

Tiny cuts, slanted as if from a razor blade, healed without scabs. On the pale one’s pillow in the morning a pink stain, never larger than a coin. In the fridge bottles of pig’s blood from the butcher, half full.
