akte.text: The Meiga chuchona of Galician legend, a witch who sucks the blood of children at night. Or a Strigoi. Garlic, a cross over the door, filed under the Old.

The Hungry are Transformed, not revenants: living people whose blood does not sustain them. The Bloodless barely makes blood of his own and must drink the blood of others. Recognisable by pallor, cold hands and thirst at night. Not transmissible. Crosses, garlic and sun mean nothing to him.

Courel case, 1956: Andrés Rioboo, twelve, pale, drinks blood at the slaughtering. A year and a half in a children’s home on the coast near A Coruña, liver, iron, no blood: haemoglobin from 6 to 13. Cured. Relapse in 1958 after returning home, explained by the damp house. Protocol since then: take the pale one out of the house, give iron and animal blood, reassure the family. His sister Carmiña died of leukaemia in 1957, unrelated according to the country doctor.

Transcript of an interview, March 1958, Andrés, fourteen, in Galician, translated: “At the home I never dreamed. Since I’ve been back, I dream again that Mama combs my hair at night. Behind the ears. She did that with Carmiña too.” Note: “Childish longing. Of no relevance.”

name: The Cellar Bloom
zitat: “I wrote in the report that she lives in the house. It was the other way round.”
form: Infestation. The landlady sits in the cellar, the fungus is in the whole house
grauen: Disturbing (2). Horrifying (3) when she stands up and the house cracks above everyone’s heads
aktenfarbe: Grey. Restriction note since 1999 because of the spore hazard in a listed conservation area: no action without clearance from Stockholm
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three known hosts since 1996
verstand: Human. The fungus: none, as far as is known
regionen: Eastern Europe. Brno, a town house in the old town near the Cabbage Market. Related cases in Karviná and Bratislava
ersteSichtung: 12 November 1996, Brno. Report by the building control authority: ceiling beams on the ground floor “completely crumbled into cubes”, the house without any subsidence. Note by the structural engineer: “Inexplicable. Second report requested.”
letzteSichtung: 28 August 2026, Brno. Phone video by a prospective buyer during a viewing of the house, deleted the same evening. Case open
verluste: None

signatur.text: Mushrooms and wet wood, beneath it something sweet like windfall fruit. Stronger in the stairwell than in the cellar.
The house creaks in the rhythm of slow breathing, ten times a minute. Inside the walls there is a soft ticking, like rain on newspaper.
In the cellar 11 °C, summer and winter. Her hands are cold and damp.
Under UV light the mortar joints glow white where the strands run, right up under the roof.
Humidity in the cellar 96 %. Plaster tell-tales over the cracks in the stairwell break and close by a millimetre, depending on whether she is awake.
No mice, no woodworm, no pigeons under the roof. In the cellar no woodlouse, no spider.
Electrical wiring corrodes within a few months, the fuses blow when it rains. The record player behind the bar has been running without fault since 1994.

Rust-brown dust on every surface, fine as cinnamon. White, cotton-wool-like coatings behind furniture. Grey strands, thick as a pencil, run upwards through the joints. On the walls flat fruiting bodies with white rims, with drops standing on them.

akte.text: Dry rot, as in every other old building in the East. The landlady drinks and has a cellar cough. Touch nothing, do not sit down, do not stay overnight.

Infestation by a fungus related to true dry rot. The landlady, Jarmila Machalová, has run a wine bar in the vaulted cellar since 1991 and has not left it since 1997. The fungus grows out of her into the floor and walls. The spores are highly infectious. Her regulars are infested and do what she wants. Enter only with respiratory protection.

Protocol Remediation, as of 1999, tested in Karviná: sedate the host, cut the strands with a gas torch, recover the host, fumigate the cellar with fungicide. In Karviná the fungus died within one night. The house was demolished the same year because of mining subsidence. For Brno there is no clearance: too many regulars, and above the cellar live fourteen people who would first have to be rehoused.

Carbon copy of a report, 2004, engineering firm in Brno, commissioned through a front company: “The timber beams in this house have not borne any load for years. Something else is bearing the load. We urgently advise removing nothing.” Registry stamp: “Not our responsibility. Forward to building department.” The building department has no record of receipt.

name: The City Foxes
zitat: “I lay down on the park bench to see what would happen. After four minutes five of them were sitting around me. I got up again very quickly.”
form: Being. Packs of three to six red foxes
rolle: Henchman, Creature. As a pack, in squads
grauen: Uncanny (1) when a fox presses down the door handle. Disturbing (2) when a pack circles a person lying down
aktenfarbe: White since March 2024, after the cull. Observation until 2027
haeufigkeit: Common. The Registry counts three altered animals, two of them dead
verstand: Animal. Cleverer than a dog, more patient than a cat
regionen: British Isles. South London: Camberwell, Peckham, Brixton. Since 2025 along the Overground to the north and west
ersteSichtung: 7 March 2022, Camberwell. Complaint to the borough’s pest control: a fox opened the fridge, took the butter and pushed the door shut again
letzteSichtung: 24 February 2026, 03:52, trail camera in the back yard of a house in Peckham: three foxes open a back door. Case dormant
verluste: None. A borough pest controller, bitten in 2024, has resigned

signatur.text: Sharp fox smell on door frames and handles, at knee height and above.
At night soft chattering outside the back door, like a conversation. The vixen’s scream always comes from the garden whose door is open.
In winter they lie on car bonnets that are still warm.
In torchlight pairs of eyes glow green, in a row, still. Motion sensors no longer set them off.
The blood and tissue of most foxes are ordinary. Only two animals in the samples had a brain a fifth heavier.
There are no hedgehogs left in the gardens. Dogs whine at the door instead of barking.
Foxes look briefly into doorbell cameras and then look for the blind spot. They avoid white vans.
Muddy paw prints on door handles at a height of 1 m. Cat flaps, gnawed wider. Open wheelie bin lids. Under hedges, shoes laid out in a circle.

probe.text: Whoever reads the index card rolls INT + Biology, and the game master reads aloud up to the row reached. A Profiler gets +1 die. An enquiry by telephone gets −1 die.

akte.text: City foxes are city foxes, and the tabloids blow up every bite. Do not feed, secure the rubbish, cat flap shut at night.

Altered Animals. Some red foxes in South London are cleverer than their kind: they open doors, hunt in packs and recognise individual people. Cause presumably a medicine from an abandoned study in the rubbish. No danger to adults, they flee from anyone standing up.

Cull in the winter of 2023/24 by a pest controller commissioned by the borough, 37 foxes. Brain sections at the Institute: two altered, 35 ordinary. The change is neither transmissible nor hereditary. With the death of the animals the case ends. A third altered animal, an old vixen, escaped.
Attached note from a biologist at the Institute: “The 35 ordinary foxes opened the same doors as the other two. Who showed them?” Below in ballpoint: “See blue tits and milk bottles.” No initials.

name: The Crystal Bride
zitat: “I held my detector to her cheek. It stayed mute. Under the stone lay lace, as fine as on the first day.”
form: Being
grauen: Disturbing (2). Horrifying (3) when a fresh wound turns to stone before your eyes
aktenfarbe: Red since November 2025, seizure ordered. Grey from 1968 to 2025, listed as a Glass Man
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three known cases, each with a different rock
verstand: Human
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Beira Baixa, the Panasqueira mining district in the uplands west of Covilhã and Fundão. Related cases in Carrara and Wieliczka
ersteSichtung: 3 February 1966, letter from the mine doctor to a colleague in Coimbra: a young woman has healed at the temple “with rock crystal instead of a scar”
letzteSichtung: 4 August 2026, Barroca Grande. Home visit by an agent posing as a nurse from the health centre. Case open
verluste: No dead. An agent lost his right hand in 1971

signatur.text: Camphor and lavender from the linen cupboard. When she moves, it smells like two pebbles knocked together.
A fine grinding like sugar in a mortar when she tilts her head. She can only tilt it to the left.
Her stone is cold like any quartz, even in the August heat. Nexus crystals are always slightly warmer than their surroundings.
Against the light you can see a veil of lace in the quartz at her left temple, every thread. When stone rubs against stone, an orange flash shows in the dark.
Crystal detector, ozone probe and nanite scanner stay mute. The X-ray shows healthy bones and quartz in the soft tissue, each block at an old wound. She weighs 97 kg at 1.52 m.
The chickens in the yard follow her and peck up the crumbs that fall from her.
No device malfunctions. In the house there is no knife, no pair of scissors, no needle. The table edges are padded.
Quartz crumbs in the bedsheet. In the bin, cotton wool with blood and tiny clear points. A rosary whose beads have grown into her left hand.

probe.text: Whoever reads the index card rolls INT + Medicine, and the game master reads aloud up to the row reached. A Biochemist gets +1 die, a Thaumaturge none, although the file lies with the Arcane Branch. An enquiry by telephone gets −1 die.

akte.text: The Noiva, the bride of the Panasqueira. Injured herself on her wedding day on a Nexus shard from the mine and has been turning to glass ever since. Whoever touches her gets glass fingers. Wear gloves.

A Glass Man (see Threat Atlas). Maria do Rosário Esteves, born 1947, struck by a rock splinter on 29 August 1965. The transformation began at the temple and advances with every injury. The triggering crystal has been in beryllium in the archive since 1968. It is exhausted, which is why the detector stays mute.

Procedure on 14 April 1971 in a private clinic in Lisbon: 2.4 kg of crystal mass removed from neck and shoulder, operation successful. Relapse within three days, caused by a remnant deep down. An assistant lost his right hand, accident with the bone saw. Recommendation: complete removal including the core, under general anaesthesia. Ordered since November 2025, as her crystals are turning up at mineral fairs.

Stamp “Not pursued”, 1972: letter from the assistant, written with his left hand. “It wasn’t the saw. I had my hand on the wound when it grew shut.” Below, in different ink, two figures from the operating theatre log: removed 2.4 kg, regrown by the third day 5.1 kg.

name: The Healer
zitat: “He laid his hand on my shoulder. The next morning the bullet was lying on the pillow, and the wound had closed. I owe him my life. That’s the problem.”
form: Being. His nanites live in everyone he has healed
grauen: Uncanny (1) when he heals. Disturbing (2) when he takes
aktenfarbe: Black since May 2025. The Council wants him alive and unharmed
haeufigkeit: Unique. Of the eleven participants in a study, only he is still alive
verstand: Human
regionen: Scandinavia. Copenhagen, above all Nørrebro and Nordvest, plus the trains across the Øresund to Malmö
ersteSichtung: 14 March 2023, Bispebjerg Hospital. Complaint by a ward physician: a hospital porter lays his hand on patients on the way to X-ray, and afterwards two findings are “no longer reproducible”
letzteSichtung: 6 September 2026, Assistens Cemetery, Nørrebro. Surveillance photo with a telephoto lens. Case open
verluste: None. Two agents healed (2025). Among the people he has touched, an estimated 40 to 70 dead since 2023

signatur.text: Disinfectant and rye bread, because he eats constantly. His hands smell of nothing.
Whoever has his hand on their skin hears a soft trickling in the ear, like sand in an hourglass.
His hands are warm as a hot-water bottle. He himself measures 37.8 °C every day, as with an infection that never breaks out.
Under UV light his palm shows a fine grey mesh that moves. On the skin of the healed, a shimmering print remains where he touched them.

The nanite scanner reacts fully to him and weakly to every healed person. Whoever stood close to him on the metro is exhausted in the evening as if after a night shift, and their heart beats more weakly. He leaves the crystal detector cold.
Dogs pull on the lead towards him and lie down on his feet. Afterwards they are tired as if after a long day.
After his touch, a diabetic woman’s glucose sensor reported healthy values for three days. They were correct.
On his bench in the cemetery lie offerings: flowers, children’s drawings, crutches no one needs any more.

akte.text: A miracle healer from Copenhagen, laying on of hands in a cemetery. Placebo and press, a case for the Humans. Or an undiscovered Psychic Healer.

A nanite being, related to the Nanite Wildling (see Threat Atlas). Asger Juhl, born 1971, hospital porter, participant in a study against pancreatic cancer in 2021 and 2022. His nanites pass over on touch and heal tumours, fractures, gunshot wounds. The healing costs him strength: he sleeps a lot, eats a lot and takes no money.

As of May 2025, after the healing of two agents: the transferred nanites break down within weeks, the healing remains. Juhl must not heal more than three people a day, otherwise there is a risk of collapse as with another participant, Malmö 2023. Capture: EMP grenade from 20 m, then transport, because with his nanites running he cannot be held. No danger to bystanders.

Attached, without sender: a table from the Danish cause of death register. People over 75 in postcodes 2200 and 2400, 2023 to 2025, against the average of the five years before; the curve rises every year. Margin note: “No connection discernible.” Below it, the blood values of the two healed agents from June 2026: nanites, thirteen months after the healing.

name: The Moonsick
zitat: “He looked into the searchlight like a child looking at a Christmas tree. I thought it was working.”
form: Being. A man with a rabies that does not kill
grauen: Disturbing (2). Horrifying (3) when he brings down a roe deer with his teeth
aktenfarbe: Red. Full Moon Protocol since 1986: three nights a month under supervision, the rest free
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three known cases since 1900, one alive
verstand: Human. Animal during a fit
regionen: Central and Western Europe. The Belgian Ardennes, the forest of Saint-Hubert in the province of Luxembourg
ersteSichtung: 13 October 1984, Saint-Hubert gendarmerie. Complaint by a wife: on the night of the full moon her husband tore open the rabbit hutch and ate the animals raw, fur and all
letzteSichtung: 17 February 2026, 23:20, security camera at the village hall of a village near Saint-Hubert. Registry note: “New moon. Presumably mistaken identity.”
verluste: One agent, 17 October 1986. A second bitten, vaccinated, remained in service

signatur.text: By day chainsaw oil and resin. During a fit fever sweat, wet leaves and a sweetish smell of saliva.
He does not swallow. You hear the saliva. During a fit a hoarse, even panting, no growling, no howling.
During a fit a fever of 40.5 °C. Where he has lain in the hoarfrost, a black outline remains in the white.
During a fit his pupils are so wide that his eyes look black. He turns towards every bright lamp like a plant.
Between fits a healthy man of 66. Rabies antibodies higher than in any other human being. During a fit pulse 160. Nanite scanner and EMF detector silent.
Dogs lie flat and fall silent when he walks past. The game in his district is shyer than anywhere else in the Ardennes.
If a motion sensor with white light switches on, he stops and looks into it. After that it gets worse.

Roe deer brought down with the bite of a human jaw, liver and heart missing. Boot prints in the frost, 40 km long, almost straight, right through thorns and fences. At streams they end and resume at the next bridge.

akte.text: A loup-garou, a werewolf of the Ardennes as the grandmothers know it. Silver bullets help against it, and the stole of Saint Hubert, with which the bitten used to be blessed in Saint-Hubert.

Not a Werewolf of Legend and no transformation. One of the Hungry: Luc Wathelet, forestry worker, bitten by a rabid fox in June 1984, one of the very few people to have survived full-blown rabies. The virus sleeps in him and wakes with the full moon, for three nights: fever, hunger for raw meat, strength without restraint. During a fit infectious through bites. New moon safe.

Full Moon Protocol, as of 1986: three nights in a windowless room in the old forester’s lodge that O.D.I.N. leases for the purpose, camera, two guards. In the event of a breakout, dazzle him with a handheld searchlight. The light paralyses him, he stands still and stares into it until the tranquilliser dart is in. Incident of 17 October 1986: one agent killed because the searchlight went out too early. Always two since then.

Carbon copy, February 1987, physician of the Institute: “The fits are stronger in the room than outside. The room is bright all night because of the camera. I ask that it be checked whether it is the light.” Handwritten below: “The camera needs light.”

name: The Night Runner
zitat: “In the afternoon he explained the way to the bus to me, very politely. At half past three he had one eye shut, and I thought: now he’s half asleep. That’s what it said in the file.”
form: Being. A human, conceived and raised in a laboratory
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) if you see him run
aktenfarbe: Red. Between two sightings the file lies grey, often for years
haeufigkeit: Rare. Six conceived, four grew up, three known
verstand: Human. Without words in the second half of the night
regionen: Eastern Europe, Russia and Belarus. Imereti in western Georgia, the karst mountains around the spa town of Tskaltubo. One case on the coast near Batumi, one near Sochi
ersteSichtung: 21 November 1987, country road from Tskaltubo to Kutaisi. Report by a bus driver to the militia: a child in pyjamas ran alongside his bus for two kilometres uphill, barefoot, one eye shut
letzteSichtung: 9 August 2026, an empty sanatorium on the outskirts of Tskaltubo. Thermal image from the building site camera, one dead. Case open
verluste: One agent, 22 April 2004, Tskaltubo. One outsider, 2026

signatur.text: Lime dust and bat droppings, sharp as sal ammoniac. By day household soap and lime blossom tea.
Almost silent in trainers. He rarely breathes: one deep breath, then nothing for up to half a minute. Farm dogs bark one after another up the valley, at the speed of a moped.
The sleeping half of the body is cooler. On the forehead you measure a difference of up to 2 °C between left and right.
The pupil of the open eye stays wide, even in a searchlight. The closed one twitches under the lid as if dreaming.
In the EEG one half of the brain sleeps deeply while the other is awake. Resting pulse 40, three breaths a minute. Blood count, nanite scanner and crystal detector unremarkable.
Bats fly out earlier when he is in their cave.
Motion sensors trigger one after another, over kilometres. Trail cameras show only a blur.
Trainer prints, strides of over 2 m, only the toes pressed in. At cave entrances chalk marks: a circle with a dot. That was how the children at the institute drew “I was here”.

akte.text: A Soviet super soldier, half man, half wolf, from a secret laboratory. Nocturnal and shuns light. Can be driven off with searchlights and a flare gun.

Lab breed, programme “Afalina”, Russian for the bottlenose dolphin, 1981 to 1991 in a military sanatorium in Tskaltubo. Goal: soldiers who never sleep. Six children, born 1982. They never sleep fully and run up to 80 km at night. Ended in December 1991, all test subjects are presumed dead.

Protocol Seizure, as of 2004: seize only in the second half of the night. The target then closes one eye, one half of the brain sleeps, reactions are halved. Approach from the front, calmly, address him by name. Sedation by dart. Operation of 22 April 2004: dart hit, target escaped, one agent dead. Conclusion: the metabolism breaks the drug down too quickly. In future a double dose, two darts within one minute.

Interview with a nurse from the institute, 1996, translated from Russian: “By day they were children like any others. At night we locked up. When one of them ran with his right eye shut, none of us was allowed to run, or he’d hunt. We sang. The doctors never sang.” Name of the nurse blacked out. Attached, a page from an anaesthesia record from 1983: two children, the same line twice, “respiratory arrest after induction”.

name: Patient Zero
zitat: “The boy recited his locker number to me, his wife’s phone number and his grandchildren’s names. He’s nineteen. The grandchildren are another man’s.”
form: Infestation. Living cells of one man that migrate into other people and turn them into him
rolle: Professional (a carrier in the late stage)
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when a stranger speaks with his voice
aktenfarbe: Black since 2 June 2026. Grey before that
haeufigkeit: Unique. One source, 17 known carriers
verstand: Human. The further the infestation advances, the more they are the same person
regionen: Central and Western Europe. The port of Rotterdam, the container terminals on the Maasvlakte, the town of Rozenburg. One early carrier in Groningen
ersteSichtung: 14 September 2024, Rotterdam. Note by a fingerprint examiner at the Nederlands Forensisch Instituut: two men after a fight outside a snack bar, two names, the same prints on seven of ten fingers
letzteSichtung: 20 September 2026, 02:17, Rozenburg. Doorbell camera of the Verhoef family: a man of 19 with a key in his hand
verluste: None. In July 2026 an agent accepted a hand-rolled cigarette. She is under observation

signatur.text: Medium-strength rolling tobacco, coffee with three sugars, diesel and harbour water. All carriers smell like this, even those who have never been to the port.
Waiting, they all whistle the same song, off-key at the same spot. Before every sentence they clear their throat twice.
Cold, clammy hands on every one of them. He always had them.
Under UV light the lining of the mouth shows pale patches that look like maps. In photos they all stand the same way: weight on the left, right shoulder lower, an old injury from 1991.
Saliva and skin samples show two genomes, their own and his. His share grows by about 8 % a month. After around a year the blood group changes. The crystal detector reports nothing.
The Verhoef family’s old Labrador greets every carrier at the door like his master.
Phones no longer recognise their owners’ fingerprints. His old phone unlocks for four of them.
Butts of hand-rolled cigarettes, the end folded over twice, the way he does it. Every morning they lie outside the garden gate in Rozenburg.

akte.text: A clique from the port imitating an old colleague. Or fraud: men passing themselves off as someone else to get his pension. A matter for the police.

Plague Carriers. The source is Kees Verhoef, born 1963, lasher on the Maasvlakte, Patient Zero. Transmission through saliva, almost always via cigarettes he has rolled. Only smokers fall ill. Carriers first take on his habits, then fingerprints and voice, finally his memories. They are peaceable and devoted, as he is.

As of May 2026: the cells come from a lung tumour that disappeared without treatment in 2023. In the lab, carrier cells die within three days when deprived of Verhoef’s serum. In 2024 a carrier moved to Groningen, without contact with the source. After six months the infestation could no longer be detected. Conclusion: the cells need the source. Recommendation to the Council: eliminate the source. Until then do not detain carriers, they are calm near him.

Tape transcript, Tineke Verhoef, 2024: “He didn’t want chemo. He said he’d rather die as all of Kees than as half. Now seven men at my door say that.” Attached, a lab slip without initials: “Carrier cells under cytostatics: dead after six hours. Groningen: request medical records?” Never requested.

name: The Radiation Shepherd
zitat: “He introduced me to his sheep, all two hundred and twelve, each one by name. At every name my counter clicked.”
form: Being. Plus a herd that can only be measured
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when the herd comes at his whistle
aktenfarbe: White. Others guard the exclusion zone. Red as soon as he leaves it
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three known shepherds, one still alive
verstand: Human
regionen: Russia and Belarus. Polesia, the Radioecological Reserve in the south of Belarus between Khoiniki and the Ukrainian border. Related cases in the Southern Urals and in Andalusia
ersteSichtung: 12 June 1994, measuring point near Rudnya. Record by a radioecologist of the reserve: the hotspot she has been measuring since 1989 is gone. Three days later it lies 800 m further on in a pasture, next to a man with sheep
letzteSichtung: 12 September 2026, video from a reserve drone over the pastures of Rudnya. Case open
verluste: None. A measurement technician of the reserve, 2004, heart failure according to the death certificate

signatur.text: Wet wool, birch smoke, mushrooms drying on strings. Whoever stands in the middle of the herd tastes metal.
The Geiger counter clicks in waves, like hooves on a dirt track: denser, louder, quieter again. In the evening the shepherd whistles twice, and the clicking draws in from all sides towards the hut.
Nothing. You do not feel the herd, not even when you stand in the middle of it.
On phone videos and drone images it snows where there is nothing: white dots that move across the meadow in groups and drift to the barn in the evening.

Patches of about 2 m, a hundred to a thousand times above the surrounding land, moving at walking pace, at night packed tight in the old collective farm barn. On the shepherd himself the counter measures no more than in Minsk. Crystal detector and nanite scanner stay mute.
Wolves run alongside at the edge of the forest and never take one of his twelve living sheep. His dog Sharyk herds where the counter clicks.
Dosimeters beep in rhythm when an animal passes. The reserve’s drone loses control over the barn.
Round, withered patches in the grass, each as large as a lying sheep. Around the barn stand pines with rust-red needles, as in the Red Forest near Pripyat in 1986.

akte.text: An old farmer in the zone who eats mushrooms, distils samahon and will live to a hundred. Radiation makes you tough if you start early. Whoever visits him drinks with him; the schnapps flushes out the caesium.

A mutant. Lyavon Hrynevich, born 1946, shepherd of the Rudnya collective farm, survived a lethal dose in April 1986. Since then patches of radiation wander around him. Friendly, never leaves the zone. No skin contact, he himself is the strongest source in the area. Dosimeter and respiratory protection.

Report by the Science Branch, 1999: the shepherd draws radionuclides out of the soil and binds them to his body. The pastures around Rudnya show a tenth of the contamination of 1989. If he dies, the corpse is highly radioactive waste. Addendum 2019: recovery within 24 hours of death, lead coffin, permanent repository. No burial in the village.

Series of measurements from 2011, initials of a cadet: on the shepherd’s body only background, no caesium, no strontium. Registry assessment: device faulty. Attached, a list in Cyrillic handwriting, 212 names. Below it the cadet: “These are the collective farm’s sheep. They were shot in May 1986.”

name: The Shell Man
zitat: “In 1979 all I did was breathe the smoke. In 1991 in Marseille a bullet hit me that would have killed anyone else. Since then I’ve been lying here counting the rings.”
form: Infestation. A bracket fungus that builds a shell for the dying and does not let them die
grauen: Uncanny (1). Horrifying (3) in the alley of the Recumbent Ones
aktenfarbe: White since 1979. Observation of an old man, one visit a year
haeufigkeit: Rare. One carrier who walks. 15 known Recumbent Ones
verstand: Human. The Recumbent Ones are awake too
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Western Sicily, the Belice valley, the ruins of old Poggioreale
ersteSichtung: 2 November 1974, shanty settlement near Poggioreale. Letter from a municipal doctor to Trapani: a woman of 81 has been dying for weeks, her back has “grown into the mattress, grey and hard as bracket fungus”
letzteSichtung: 30 July 2026, hospital in Castelvetrano. Grey dust on the pillow of a dying man who has not died since. Case open
verluste: No dead. An agent who should have died in 1991 has been in care ever since

signatur.text: Old oak and sour wine, as if from empty barrels. The Recumbent Ones smell of nothing.
The shell creaks when he walks like the hull of a boat. The Recumbent Ones whisper, audible only with an ear to the shell.
The shell is cool as stone, beneath it 34 °C.
In cross-section, growth rings, a pale one for every summer. Under UV light the youngest glow yellow.
Pulse of the Recumbent Ones 6 to 10 per minute, no sign of decay. The crystal detector does not react.
Lizards sun themselves on the shells. Flies never land.
An ECG reports cardiac arrest, one beat, arrest again.
A broad drag mark in the dust. On hospital pillows grey dust, fine as ash.

akte.text: A hermit in the ruins of Poggioreale whom people call u Babbaluci, the snail. Hunchback and skin disease. Harmless, begs for bread.

Fungal infestation since the Belice valley earthquake of 1968. A bracket fungus forms a hard shell on the dying, in which they dry out like mummies. The carrier, an old man, spreads the dust in hospitals.

Protocol Burn, as of 1979: the shell burns well. Burn infested corpses on site with petrol. Confront the carrier with fire, he backs away. Operation near Poggioreale in 1979: three corpses burned, the carrier fled. Smoke harmless.

Medical findings, November 1991: the agent deployed at the fire in 1979 was fatally wounded in Marseille, shot in the chest. He is alive. For three weeks a grey shell has been growing over his back. Attached is the operation report from 1979, with a note in the margin in another hand: “One of the corpses coughed.”

name: The Wanderers
zitat: “I walked alongside them until my feet bled. The woman at the front handed me a loaf without stopping. She had a fever herself and was the only one who knew what to do.”
form: Infestation. A disease that makes people walk
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) if you hold one of them
aktenfarbe: Red since September 2026. Before that White, listed as extinct since 1953
haeufigkeit: Rare. Four known outbreaks: 1924, 1953, 1979, 2026
verstand: Human. The hosts are lucid, tired and cannot do otherwise
regionen: Eastern Europe. Mariovo in the south of North Macedonia, the highlands along the Crna between Prilep and the Greek border
ersteSichtung: 11 May 1924, Mariovo, Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes. Report by a gendarmerie post: 23 farmers from three hamlets have been walking about for nine days, “without rest, without sleep, without reason”
letzteSichtung: 14 September 2026, country road from Mariovo to Prilep. Photo by a bus driver: six Wanderers, among them a priest. Case open, the squad is still walking
verluste: None. The 22 dead of 1953 are down to the Yugoslav authorities. In 1954 the Registry made their procedure its protocol

signatur.text: Warm dust, sweat, sheep’s wool. Beneath it something sweet like fermenting fruit: the fever.
Even footsteps, on gravel like a slow clock, day and night. They talk little, mostly about the weather.
While walking 38.5 °C, always. If one of them stops, it rises to 40 °C within hours. On cold nights they steam.
Eyes half shut: they sleep as they walk, without stumbling. In a searchlight they do not blink.
Pulse 110, unchanged for days. A blood sample does not settle in the tube: the cells circle slowly as long as it is warm. A crystal detector finds nothing on the Wanderers.
Farm dogs silently run along for a stretch and turn back. Sheep crowd against the fence and bleat after them.
Pedometers show over 60,000 steps a day.
Worn-through shoes at the roadside. On stones at crossroads, bread with a pinch of salt. Everyone in the valley knows the custom, no one any longer knows the reason.

akte.text: Pilgrims from the mountains or a mass hysteria like the dancing mania of the Middle Ages. Harmless, they stop when they are tired.

Plague in the south of Macedonia, presumably from the positions of the First World War. The infected walk without a break, in groups, until they die of exhaustion, usually after two to three weeks. Infectious by touch, wear gloves. They knock down whoever stands in their way.

Protocol Cordon, as of 1954: stop the Wanderers and isolate them in a solid building, tie them up if necessary. Sedatives so that they sleep. Guards in rubber aprons. After 48 hours the outbreak is over. Evidence: Prilep 1953, not a single case outside the schoolhouse. Burn the corpses. No survivors are known.

Letter from a country doctor from Prilep, 1979, received 1983, never evaluated: the villages “walked” 17 Wanderers, taking turns, for 41 days, in great loops across the highlands. Ten lived. The dead died on the way, and whoever was with them set off walking two days later. In the margin, in the same handwriting: “Whoever leads does not fall ill. Whoever stops them does.”

name: The Wire Woman
zitat: “She wished me good evening and pulled the cartridges out of my magazine, one after the other, through the holster. She smiled while she did it. Only her eyes didn’t.”
form: Being
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when wire grows from her fingertips
aktenfarbe: Grey since 2016, observation: the daughter feeds her. Red as soon as the copper stops
haeufigkeit: Rare. 17 clients of a Milan practice, three of them known to be changed
verstand: Human, but locked in. What acts is habit
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Milan, the district around Sant’Ambrogio and the railway yards in the east of the city. Isolated cases in Rome and Brescia
ersteSichtung: 21 October 2014, around 23:00, railway tracks near Lambrate. Record by the railway police: a lady of about seventy in a fur coat sits in the ballast, both hands on the signal cable, 11 m of copper in her handbag. No charges
letzteSichtung: 18 September 2026, 07:31, security camera of a pasticceria on Corso Magenta. Case open
verluste: One agent, 7 May 2016, on an estate in the Lomellina

signatur.text: Heavy perfume from another era, beneath it verdigris and warm cables.
When she smiles, something creaks softly like wire being bent. When she stands up, something crackles under her coat.
Her hands are cold and dry. Copper near her grows warm: coins in a purse, the boiler of the espresso machine.
Against the light a fine mesh shows under the skin of her neck, like veins of gold. Her towels turn verdigris blue.

Nanite scanner: full reaction. A metal detector reacts all over her body, most strongly at the face. The crystal detector, on the other hand: nothing. Her face has not had a new wrinkle since March 2013.
Dogs do not bark at her. They growl at her handbag.
When she enters a room, the light flickers. Charging cables she touches are empty afterwards: the sheath intact, the copper gone.
Copper polenta pots are missing from kitchens all over the district. Empty cable sheaths, clean as if skinned. A doorbell panel in the stairwell that no longer rings.

akte.text: A rich widow with a quirk: she steals copper. Kleptomania, a case for the Carabinieri. Whoever catches her gets a tip.

A nanite being. Ornella Brambilla, born 1944, had her face lifted with threads at a practice in Via della Spiga on 12 March 2013. The threads carried nanites from a manufacturer that no longer exists. They build a network of copper wire inside her. The nanites multiply with every gram of copper and pass to others via the wire. Gloves, distance.

Order Abstinence, as of 2016: copper deprivation. Bring the person into a room without metal, tiled walls, plastic furniture. Without supplies the nanites stop building, and the network goes slack. Guarded around the clock, two armed guards. After an EMP she speaks for a few seconds in a different voice and asks for help: an attempt at deception, do not respond. Attempt aborted in 2016, one agent dead, cause unexplained.

Handwritten statement by the surviving guard, May 2016: “On the ninth day she raised her hand. The wire came out of her fingers, very thin, and went into Klemme’s vest. He had a spare magazine in his breast pocket.” Stamp: “Evaluated. No change to the order.” Attached, a DIY store receipt, July 2026, paid by the daughter: 4 kg copper wire, 1.5 mm.

name: The Alp
zitat: “The woman with the breakfast asked if she could borrow my salt. I gave her the whole tub. Since then I’ve woken up every morning with alpine grass between my toes.”
form: Apparition. A weight without a body that presses on sleepers and rides them. Behind it stands a living person
grauen: Disturbing (2) when a sleeper with open eyes walks barefoot uphill, bent under nothing
aktenfarbe: Red since 9 September 2026. From 1990 White, closed
haeufigkeit: Rare
verstand: None discernible
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Tyrol, the Kaunertal in the Oberland, the hamlet of Gsallen. Related cases in the Westerwald and in eastern Styria
ersteSichtung: 17 August 1984, gendarmerie post in the Kaunertal. A holiday guest from Ulm is found barefoot at 05:00 at the abandoned Gsallhof, 600 metres higher than his guesthouse, his hair matted into plaits. He says he was ridden
letzteSichtung: 9 September 2026, 04:10, still image from a panorama camera above the Kaunertal: a woman in pyjamas on the path up to the Gsallhof. Case open

signatur.text: In the morning the guest room smells of horse sweat and hay.
The keyhole whistles, as if someone were blowing through it. Then the bed creaks under a weight that cannot be seen.
In the morning the ridden one glows as if after a long mountain hike.
The ridden take no lamp. They walk the path in the dark, more surely than by day.
A bathroom scale under the foot of the bed shows a good 3 kg more during the pressing. The one pressed swears it was fifty.
In the morning horses stand drenched in sweat in the stable, their manes braided into hard little plaits.
A phone by the bed records a woman’s voice: “I baptise you in the name of the Father and of the Son …” Then nothing more.
The hair of the ridden is matted into plaits that have to be cut off, the elf-locks. Bloody soles. Sometimes a straw in the fist.

akte.text: Nightmares, plus sleepwalking after schnapps and mountain air. The locals call it the Trud and paint pentagrams on their doors.

An Alp, called the Trud in Tyrol: the soul of a living person that goes out at night, presses on sleepers and rides them. The person behind it often knows nothing of it. A pentagram on door or bed keeps it away. Do not wake the ridden on the path; whoever wakes up there falls.

Identified in 1987: Kreszenz Walch, 78, former midwife. Protocol Loan: at night the one pressed says, “Trud, come tomorrow, I’ll lend you something.” Whoever comes first in the morning wanting to borrow something is the Trud. You give it to her, then she is bound and rides no more. Walch came in the morning and wanted a candle. No rides since 1988. Walch died in 1990 in a care home in Landeck. Case closed.

Transcript of a tape, interview with Walch, 1987: “I didn’t finish sayin’ it. The child screamed, and I thought it was dyin’.” Margin note: “Confession.” Addendum of 4 September 2026: rides since July. Cadet Almrausch reports Protocol Loan carried out: the landlady came first and wanted salt, given. Assessment: a successor to Walch, now bound.

name: The Banshee
zitat: “I asked the neighbour to ring the son in Glasgow so he could say goodbye. That’s what the recommendation said. He said goodbye.”
form: Being. Often heard, rarely seen
rolle: Henchman, Creature. She is not the danger
grauen: Disturbing (2) for anyone who hears her keening. Horrifying (3) for anyone who understands her words
aktenfarbe: Grey as soon as she keens. In between, the file rests, sometimes for twenty years
haeufigkeit: Rare. Only old families have one
verstand: Human. She speaks only in her keening, in an Irish from before 1850
regionen: British Isles. The west of Donegal, above all the Rosses around Dungloe. Related cases in Mayo and on the Hebrides
ersteSichtung: January 1847, near Dungloe. School copybook of 1938 for the Irish Folklore Commission: a grandmother tells how the banshee keened for her mother’s brother
letzteSichtung: 23 September 2026, around 02:00, the Boyle family’s farm near Dungloe. Mobile phone video taken by the daughter from the window. The third night followed on 24 September
verluste: None. Since 1994, three relatives who travelled home to say goodbye

signatur.text: Peat smoke, even when no hearth is burning. Wet wool.
The keening of a single woman, breaking off, starting again, often for an hour. It carries 2 km. On recordings it sounds like a barn owl.
The nights on which she keens are windless.
With the yard lamp switched on, the wall by the gate is empty. In the dark a woman sits there.
No readings. Salt on the windowsill turns damp overnight.
The family’s dogs lie by the door for the three nights. Other dogs notice nothing.
Nothing malfunctions. On these nights the family waits for the telephone.
Long grey hairs on the wall by the gate. Sometimes a bone comb at the roadside that nobody in the village picks up.

akte.text: A barn owl and a lot of whiskey. Or an old woman keening according to old custom. Where the banshee keens, she brings death.

A herald of death from Irish legend, the bean sí. She keens three nights before a death, only for the old families. She does not kill, and the death cannot be prevented. Her keening has no words. Do not pick up a comb from the road.

Registry statistics for the Boyles of the Rosses, as of 2020: 38 keenings since 1847, the early ones inferred from school copybook and death register. 29 dead within seven days of the third night, nine false alarms, almost all before 1960, presumably owls. Recommendation since 1994: inform relatives abroad in good time so that they can say goodbye.

Addendum: in three cases since 1994 it was not the sick person who died but a relative who travelled home to say goodbye (1996 from Boston, 2008 from London, 2019 from Glasgow). Note: the banshee occasionally mistakes the person. Attached, the translation from the school copybook of 1938: “She keened three nights for Micí, my mother’s brother. They held the wake for him, and in the morning he went to Derry for the ship. He never wrote. He wasn’t allowed to.” Below it: “Custom.”

name: The Bony One in the Woods
zitat: “She asked whether I was looking for work or running from it. I said: first the sauna, then the food, then the questions. She laughed, in English: at last, someone with manners.”
form: Being. An old woman with one leg of bone, in a hut on two tree stumps, behind a fence of bones
grauen: Disturbing (2) at the fence. Horrifying (3) when the hut stands up and turns
aktenfarbe: Black since 1956
haeufigkeit: Unique. There is only ever one
verstand: Human. Beneath it, something very old
regionen: Scandinavia, and Russia and Belarus. The forests of Karelia on both sides of the Finnish-Russian border. The hut always stands on the border
ersteSichtung: 19 February 1938, Ilomantsi, North Karelia. Statement of a refugee, 16, to the Finnish Border Guard: his sister had stayed with an old woman in the forest who gave her a leg. Taken over by the Registry in 1951
letzteSichtung: 25 August 2026, border zone east of Ilomantsi. Image from a trail camera: a man in a parka from 1979 carries two buckets of water. Case open
verluste: Two escorts, missing: Birkhahn (1956), Lotblei (1979)

signatur.text: Smoke from a smoke sauna, birch leaves and hot stone.
A creaking like a tree that walks. At night, a pestle in a mortar, for hours.
Around the hut it is warm as in the changing room of a sauna.
On the fence posts sit skulls in whose eyes a yellow light burns as if from pine splints. They glow only for whoever is just arriving.
Every day the GPS puts the hut on the border line, each time at a different spot. In winter the phone clock jumps between Finnish and Moscow time with every step. Salt on her threshold turns grey.
Ravens sit on the posts. Dogs stop at the fence and lie down.
In the hut a radio without power plays American dance music of the thirties.
In the snow a boot print and beside it a small round hole, always alternating. Hanging on the fence among the bones, rusty belt buckles with a red star.

akte.text: The witch from the Russian fairy tales who eats children, with chicken legs under the hut and skulls on the fence. Do not go.

An ancient keeper in the border forest. She eats whoever insults her and helps whoever knows the rules. To her question whether you are looking for work or running from it, do not answer but demand: first sauna, food and drink, then questions. Then she obeys until morning. To the hut you say: “Stand with your back to the forest and your door to me.”

The hut is a crossing over the border. Whoever passes three nights leaves it by the back door on the other side. Protocol Escort, as of 1956: an agent brings defectors from the Soviet Union to the hut with bread, salt and the formula. Until 1979, fourteen defectors safely in Finland. Two escorts missing, presumably caught by Soviet border troops. Suspended since 1979.

Attached, the trail camera image of 25 August 2026: the man at the fence is Lotblei, missing since 1979, not a day older. Below it the directive of 9 September: retrieval according to Protocol Escort.

name: The Changeling
zitat: “The mother said it was her son. The father said it wasn’t his son. Both were right, and the child laughed like an old man.”
form: Being. A child that is not one
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when it shows its own face
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red from the sixth year after the exchange
haeufigkeit: Rare. Eleven cases since 1894, eight of them on the Isle of Man
verstand: Human, but very old
regionen: British Isles. The Isle of Man, above all the south and the glens of the west coast. Isolated cases in Wales and Galloway
ersteSichtung: November 1894, Cregneash, parish of Rushen. Notebook of a song collector from Douglas: a farmer’s wife shows him her child in the cradle and says it is not hers
letzteSichtung: 22 August 2026, Noble’s Hospital near Douglas, accident and emergency. A boy with a burned hand swears at the doctor in Manx. Case open
verluste: No agents. One child, 1972, recorded as an accident at the waterfall

signatur.text: Peat smoke and wet bracken, even in a new-build flat with underfloor heating. Milk in the fridge turns sour overnight.
Among people it cries and babbles like any child. Alone in the room it talks in a deep, rough voice in Manx, a language whose last native speaker died in 1974.
It never has a fever, not even when the whole class has chickenpox. The thermometer shows 36.0 °C, every time.
In flash photos its eyes glow green-gold like a fox’s. No other child in the room does that.
Nothing measurable. The growth curve at the paediatrician’s has been almost a straight line since the exchange. Salt in a bowl beside the bed is grey in the morning.
The family dog will not enter the child’s room and has slept in the car ever since.
Nothing malfunctions. Only the baby monitor transmits a laugh at night that is too deep.
The family buys milk for three children. Iron in the house rusts where it has touched it: door handles, the poker, a horseshoe over the door that someone has bent.

probe.text: Whoever reads the index card rolls INT + Occultism, and the game master reads aloud up to the row reached. An Antiquarian gets +1 die, as does anyone who speaks Manx or Welsh. An enquiry by telephone from the field gets −1 die.

boni.wer: anyone who speaks Manx or Welsh

akte.text: Changelings do not exist. Sick children and women, superstitious families, see Tipperary 1895. The cell protects the child from the family, not the other way round.

Fair Folk of the Isle of Man. The Little People, in Manx mooinjer veggey, take an infant and lay one of their own in the cradle. Signs: hardly grows, eats for three, speaks alone in an old voice. Iron tongs over the cradle prevent the exchange. After seven years it can no longer be reversed.

Protocol Hearth Test, as of 1958: threaten the changeling with iron and fire, never seriously injure it, until its people fetch it. Unmask it first: boil water in eggshells, and it gives itself away in astonishment. Case Port St Mary 1957: in the morning the family’s own child lay in the cradle. Burn blisters on both hands, attributed to the crossing. In combat iron works double.

Case near Peel, 1972: a changeling attacks an agent and is beaten to death with an iron bar. In the morning a piece of alder wood lies in the cradle; at the foot of the Glen Maye waterfall lies the family’s own child, dead. Coroner’s report: skull fracture, the shape of a bar. Stamp below: “Unexplained. Do not pursue.”

name: The Chupacabra
zitat: “When we left, we gave the families the cockerels from the decoy coops. They all thanked us. Except the old woman.”
form: Being
rolle: Henchman, Creature, freshly hatched. Professional after the first winter
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) for whoever opens the pen in the morning
aktenfarbe: Red since August 2026. From 2006 to 2026 White, listed as closed after the kill
haeufigkeit: Rare. Reported again since August 2026, number unknown
verstand: Animal
regionen: Latin America. Chile, the Norte Chico: the goat valleys of the province of Limarí around Combarbalá and Monte Patria, Coquimbo region
ersteSichtung: 14 September 2004, Quebrada Los Litres near Combarbalá. Report by a goatherd to the Carabineros: 23 goats in one night, two holes in each neck, no blood in the pen
letzteSichtung: 3 August 2026, veterinary practice in Ovalle. X-ray of an egg that a boy found in a hen’s nest
verluste: None

signatur.text: The pen smells of iron and of a henhouse, even on farms without hens.
Around 03:00 a cockerel crows somewhere, thin and too high, like a young one still learning.
A nest in which one has hatched stays warm for days, without a hen.
In lamplight, two red dots, too far apart for an animal of that size.
Nothing measurable. Almost no blood in the dead goats, none on the ground. Salt scattered in the pen is pink in the morning.
The herding dogs do not go into the pen and do not bark. An old cockerel it has bitten no longer crows and sits like a hen during the day.
Trail cameras of the agricultural service show foxes, dogs, once a puma. And two red dots 30 cm off the ground.
Two round holes in the neck, two fingers apart. Three-toed prints as if from a large bird, with claws. In the straw, remains of shell, soft as leather, with no yolk.

boni.wer: anyone who grew up in rural Chile

akte.text: “The goat sucker.” An escaped lab creature, American, so television has said since the year 2000. A case for the Transformed. Almost always it is feral dogs.
Not a lab creature, but the Old, under a new name. An animal the size of a fox drinks the blood out of goats through two fine holes. Avoids humans. Salt in the shot and iron work.

Quebrada Los Litres, 2004 to 2006: in 14 cases tracks in the henhouse, never a dead hen. Conclusion: poultry attracts it but is not enough for it. Protocol Decoy Coop: hens and cockerels in a coop at the edge of the valley, night vision, one marksman. Four animals killed and burned, no cases since July 2006. The cockerels went to the families as compensation. File closed.

Tape transcript, November 2005, interview with an old woman in the valley, translated from Spanish: “You shoot the young and feed the old. Here no cockerel may turn seven. We used to know that.” Note: “Superstition. The cockerels are a gift.”

name: The Draugr
zitat: “Five names, and five stood up and left. No case ever ended that cleanly again.”
form: Being. A drowned man with a body, heavy as wet sand
grauen: Disturbing (2). Horrifying (3) for whoever looks into his eyes in the moonlight
aktenfarbe: Grey since February 2025. From the door court of 8 February 1997 White, listed as closed
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three cases since 1948, all in Iceland. The rest are in the sagas
verstand: Human, less so every year
regionen: Scandinavia. Iceland, the north coast of the Snæfellsnes peninsula, the harbour of Ólafsvík
ersteSichtung: 30 January 1997, fish factory at the harbour of Ólafsvík. Call from the night watchman to the police: five men in wet oilskins were sitting in the break room, men who had drowned with the boat Kría on 19 January
letzteSichtung: 18 January 2025, guesthouse in the former fish factory. A guest’s review on a booking site: “The man by the radiator in the breakfast room was wet all night and didn’t say hello.”
verluste: None. A guest from Brussels, died of pneumonia in February 2025

signatur.text: Seaweed, diesel oil and cold fish. His chair still smells of the harbour at midday.
Dripping, steady, in the empty room. In storms, footsteps on the roof, heavy as a horse’s, and the corrugated iron bends.
He always sits by the radiator. In the morning the radiator’s fins are crusted with salt.
In photos he is only a wet sheen on a chair. In the moonlight his eyes shine like fish eyes.

He is getting heavier. In 1997 a plastic chair held him; in 2025 an oak table buckled when he laid his arm on it. The puddles under him contain 3.5% salt, like the sea. No detector responds; only the wood beneath him gives way.
Dogs do not enter the building. In the morning, gulls sit outside the window of the breakfast room.
The building’s water meter runs on stormy nights, although no tap is open.
Wet prints of rubber boots, size 46, from the pier to the door, none going back. Seaweed on the door handle. Dead sheep by the road to Fróðá, their bones broken, not bitten.

akte.text: A Viking from the burial mound, as big as an ox. You wrestle with him, cut off his head and lay it against his buttocks, so the sagas say. Or you sue him. This is Iceland.

Draugr: a dead man with a body who comes for what is owed to him. The drowned come to their own funeral feast and sit down by the fire, as at the farm of Fróðá in the Eyrbyggja saga. Where they sit, the household falls ill. Heavy, strong, almost invulnerable. Salt and iron work, as against everything Old.

Case Kría: boat from Ólafsvík, sank in a storm on 19 January 1997, five men according to the crew list, two bodies recovered. From 30 January the five sat every night in the break room of the fish factory where the funeral feast had been held. Protocol Door Court, following the saga: on 8 February the owner of the building, standing at the door, charged each dead man by name and patronymic with trespass. Each stood up at the verdict and left. Rule of thumb: whoever gets no funeral feast does not come.

Transcript of an interview, 3 February 1997, the skipper’s widow, translated: “Hjörtur phoned the Pole the evening before they sailed. He was to be at the pier at five.” Question: “Which Pole?” Answer after a pause: “Nobody.” Stamp: according to the crew list, no foreigner on board.

name: The Feathered One over the Bridge
zitat: “We called in the rockets like artillery, as the file said. He came out of the cloud. Not for us on the bank, but for driftwood on the bridge.”
form: Being
grauen: Disturbing (2). Horrifying (3) for anyone he has seized
aktenfarbe: Red from May to September, in the thunderstorm season. Otherwise Grey
haeufigkeit: Rare. The Registry knows of three, all on the Danube
verstand: Animal
regionen: Eastern Europe. The Danube in the Vojvodina, the Iron Gates, the lower Danube between Bulgaria and Romania
ersteSichtung: 4 July 2006, around 22:00, Liberty Bridge in Novi Sad, Serbia. A woman’s report to the police: her husband had been “taken away upwards” on the footpath, by wings “like a wet sail”
letzteSichtung: 27 July 2026, around 22:30, the same bridge. Long exposure by a storm photographer from the quay. One cyclist missing
verluste: One agent (19 June 2014), recovered from the Danube near Sremski Karlovci three days later. Listed internally as a fall, with the police as a suicide

signatur.text: Wet iron and singed horn. After a rocket barrage, the bridge smells of spent fireworks.
High above, a crack like a wet sheet in a storm. When he lands, the stay cables groan.
Just before he lands, a cool, wet downdraught presses on the bridge.
In the sheet lightning, an outline on the tip of the pylon that is gone at the next flash. His eyes reflect no light, unlike those of any bird.
The weather radar shows a small echo in the storm cell, moving against the wind. Hailstones where he has been have a black down feather at their core.
Pigeons and gulls leave the bridge hours before the storm. Dogs on the quay lie down flat and look upwards.
Nothing malfunctions. He is an animal; in the lightning flash he appears in photos.

Black feathers, 80 cm long, hard as horn, in heaps of hail on the bank. Scratches in the concrete of the pylon tip, 4 cm deep. Dead people with fall injuries in maize fields, kilometres from the water.

akte.text: A white-tailed eagle, seen twice its size in the storm. The dead at the bridge are suicides, as at every high bridge. Not a case for O.D.I.N.

A bird with a wingspan of around 6 m, blackish brown, that hunts out of the cloud in thunderstorms. Serbian legend calls it the Ala, who brings the hail. Seizes people in the open, carries them up and drops them. Only in thunderstorms, only from May to September. Under a roof you are safe. Silver works.

Addendum 2009: for decades the state hail defence has been firing rockets with silver iodide into the storm clouds. Wherever they fly, every attack ends within minutes; in the countryside there have been hardly any deaths since the seventies. On a sighting, request a barrage through the contact at the weather service. The dead at the bridge have no connection with this.

Operation report of 19 June 2014: barrage requested. Two agents secure the riverside road, one observes from the footpath of the bridge. He is missing. Finding: fall in severe weather on a wet surface. Attached, a list from the hail station near Futog with all firing times from 2006 to 2013. Seven lines are ticked by hand. No initials, no comment.

name: The Fox Woman
zitat: “The file said the old woman was the fox. The old woman could barely hold a spoon. The daughter held the door open for me and sniffed at my neck as she did.”
form: Being. A vixen who for centuries has been able to be a woman. Registered in Hong Kong since 1962 as Wu Yuk-lan
grauen: Uncanny (1) when a dog puts its tail between its legs in front of a woman. Disturbing (2) when she goes down on all fours
aktenfarbe: Grey since 1964. Red as soon as the old woman dies
haeufigkeit: Rare. Five known fox spirits, all with Chinese families
verstand: Human. Older and more patient than any human
regionen: East Asia. Hong Kong, the housing estates of Wong Tai Sin in Kowloon. Related cases in Macau and Liverpool
ersteSichtung: 9 July 1964, Wong Tai Sin. Report by a mission doctor to the Medical and Health Department: a girl of two has never been ill, in a block with eleven cases of tuberculosis. The mother lets no doctor listen to her chest
letzteSichtung: 27 August 2026, Wong Tai Sin. Surveillance camera of a housing block: a large vixen carries a dead dog up the stairs. Case open
verluste: None. A security guard bitten in August 2026

signatur.text: Jasmine oil in the old woman’s hair. In the daughter’s stairwell, a sharp musk.
At night on the open-air walkways, light steps on four feet. Towards morning, a hoarse barking.
The daughter’s hands are hot as in a fever, though she has not had one since 1962.
On moonlit nights a figure on the roof breathes up towards the moon. In flash photos the daughter’s eyes glow green, the mother’s do not.
Nothing measurable. Salt the daughter touches turns grey. With a stethoscope you can hear something rolling like a marble beneath her heart.
Dogs have barked at the old woman since 1962. Since this spring they shrink back from the daughter with their tails between their legs.
At night the facial recognition at the entrance reports the daughter as unknown.

Red hairs on the pillow of the daughter, whose hair is grey. Dead dogs on the roof, bitten in the neck. In the mother’s handbag a photo from 1962: a young woman with an infant in front of the border hills. On the negative the woman is a fox.

akte.text: A fox spirit from the Chinese ghost stories: a beautiful woman who seduces men and sucks out their life force. Male agents are never to go to her alone.

Shapeshifter. A vixen who takes on human form after centuries of practice. Such vixens like to call themselves Wu, Hu in Mandarin, which sounds the same as the word for fox. Salt, iron and silver work. They keep their word and forget no wrong.

Wu Yuk-lan, who came across the border in May 1962 with an infant. The daughter Ka-yee is a human child on whom the vixen feeds: hence the child’s heat and the nights on the roof. Protocol Weaning, as of 1967: separate child and vixen. After nine days in the children’s home the child fell seriously ill and went back. Assessment: dependency. Separation only once the vixen is weakened.

File memo of 20 August 2026: Wu Yuk-lan is in a care home after a stroke, weaker than ever. The daughter shows signs of possession. Recommendation: carry out Protocol Weaning now, for good, with silver, in her sleep. Below it, without initials: “Who actually made whom ill in 1967?”

name: The Hungering One of the North
zitat: “We didn’t leave anyone alone. Not for a minute. That’s what the file demands.”
form: Being. First a person who is never full, then what grows out of them
grauen: Uncanny (1) while he sits at the table. Horrifying (3) when he stands upright between the spruces
aktenfarbe: Red since February 2026. Previously Grey, a case for starvation winters, “which no longer exist”
haeufigkeit: Rare. Four cases since 1927
verstand: Human. He speaks with the voice of the one he grows in, and he lies well
regionen: North America. The boreal forest in the north of Ontario and Quebec: logging camps, mines and exploration camps beyond the winter roads
ersteSichtung: 2 April 1927, Chapleau, Ontario. Report by a provincial police constable: from logging camp No. 6 on the upper Missinaibi, nine of 31 men come back
letzteSichtung: 26 February 2026, exploration camp North Ridge, 150 km beyond the end of the road at Pickle Lake. Satellite phone call from a paramedic: a man has grown 13 cm in three weeks
verluste: Two agents, February 1978, northern Quebec. According to the report, breach of protocol

signatur.text: In the forest, where no fire is burning, it smells of bacon. The host’s breath smells sweetish of acetone, like that of someone starving.
At night, behind a locked door, chewing, long and steady. In the forest, a familiar voice calling people to eat.
The host burns, 39 °C without infection. He sleeps with the window open and goes to the woodpile in his vest in February.
In photos he looks thinner than in the mirror. His lips are narrow, as if he had chewed them off.
He grows a good half centimetre a day and loses weight, no matter how much he eats. Ketones in the urine as after weeks without food. The EMF detector stays silent, the scales do not.
Dogs eat nothing he has touched. Ravens sit only on the roof above his room.
The scales in the sick bay show less every morning. The stock list is correct, the stock on the shelf is not.
Gnawed dog bones, clean as if boiled. Barefoot prints in the snow, 40 cm long, 2 m stride, blood on the toes. Wrappers under his floorboards.

boni.wer: anyone who has spoken to Martha Linklater

akte.text: An emaciated giant with antlers who howls in the blizzard and eats people. Silver bullets, then burn him. That is how he hangs as a drawing in the canteen in Montreal.

A forest being, in the stories of the Cree and the Anishinaabe a warning from starvation winters. The Registry does not write his name, at the request of the first witness. It enters people who have eaten human flesh, and takes loners: trappers, men alone in the forest.

Protocol Buddy Watch, since 1951: nobody alone, not to fetch wood, not to the latrine. Supplies under lock, a single key with the highest-ranking person. Check loners. Case 1951, Haute-Mauricie: a trapper who lived alone by the river, shot and burned, quiet afterwards. Case 1978: two agents lost because one went alone to the woodshed at night.

Statement of Samuel Linklater, Chapleau, 2 April 1927, translated by a fur trader at the railway station: “He comes to the one who is alone.” Attached, a letter from 2009, sender Martha Linklater of Timmins, the witness’s granddaughter, forwarded by the provincial police: “My grandfather taught me that sentence differently. Please call me.” Stamp: no new sighting. File away.

name: The Kappa
zitat: “I bowed, and he bowed. The water ran down his face, and he looked at me as if I’d forgiven him a debt.”
form: Being
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when he lays a drowned person on the bank and bows before them
aktenfarbe: White since 1954. In basic training, the example of how politeness is enough with the Old
haeufigkeit: Rare. According to the legends in every river in Japan; the Registry knows of three
verstand: Human. Speaks the Japanese of the 18th century and keeps every agreement literally
regionen: East Asia. Japan, the Kokai, a tributary of the Tone in the south of Ibaraki Prefecture, at the hamlet of Numabe
ersteSichtung: 21 August 1954, dyke of the Kokai near Numabe. Report by a lone agent under cover as an ethnologist with a teaching post in Tokyo, with six photos
letzteSichtung: 12 July 2026, phone video by a cyclist on the dyke, 300,000 views. Declared a mascot by the tourist office
verluste: None. Three children from Numabe, summer 1955, listed as bathing accidents

signatur.text: River mud, carp and freshly cut cucumber. His sitting stone still smells of it an hour later.
A wet slapping like hands on a board. He clears his throat before he speaks, with the voice of a child.
The water in the dish on his head is as warm as the river on an August day, even in January.
The dish reflects the moon even under an overcast sky. In every photo it is the brightest point.
Nothing measurable. Salt scattered on the bank is green as duckweed in the morning.
Horses will not be watered on this bank. Dogs go as far as the dyke and no further.
Cameras record him in sharp focus. That is why nobody believes the pictures: he looks like a costume.
Webbed handprints on the stones of the bank. Cucumber ends, laid neatly in a row, the cut faces towards the river. On the dyke, a bare ring in the grass.

akte.text: “The cucumber goblin.” A Japanese water spirit, half turtle, half monkey, the size of a child. Loves cucumbers and wrestling. Harmless. You bow, he bows back.

On his head he carries a dish of water, the source of his strength. He must return every bow. Whoever bows deeply makes the water spill, and he is helpless until he reaches the river. Tested in 1954, six photos in the archive. Drags people and horses into the water if provoked.

In early summer, Numabe writes the names of its children on the first cucumber and throws it into the Kokai so that he spares them. A custom without effect: in the summer of 1955 three children from Numabe drowned, and all three were on the cucumber. Recommendation of 1956: in the event of deaths, weaken the being by bowing and drive it off with iron; do not encourage the custom.

Letter from a woman in Numabe to the ethnologist, spring 1956, translated in 1971, when his papers came to Stockholm: “The gentleman from Sweden poured out his promise. We filled it back up for him, with water from our well. Please don’t send anyone else who bows.” Registry stamp: “Folklore. Of no relevance.”

name: The Klabautermann
zitat: “At night he nailed my cap to the bunk, drank my schnapps and plugged the leak in the forepeak. In that order.”
form: Being. A little man, barely knee-high, with a red beard, oilskins, pipe and caulking mallet. Invisible until he leaves the ship
grauen: Uncanny (1) when there is knocking in the hull at night. Disturbing (2) when he sits on the rail with his seabag
aktenfarbe: White. A training case for cadets since 1955
haeufigkeit: Common wherever old wooden ships sail. Twelve closed cases since 1954
verstand: Human, with the temper of an old bosun
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Port of Hamburg and the lower Elbe, the German and Dutch North Sea coast, the western Baltic
ersteSichtung: 3 November 1954, Hamburg. Letter from a skipper’s wife to the seamen’s mission in Altona: “A Klabautermann lives on the Tine Rüter. He drinks my husband’s schnapps and hides the boy’s exercise books in the chain locker. What helps?”
letzteSichtung: 21 September 2026, Landungsbrücken. Phone video by a tourist on the harbour launch Emma Pahl: a small man sits on the rail with a seabag and looks into the camera. Case open
verluste: None

signatur.text: Cheap shag from a pipe that nobody is smoking. Pine tar and fresh oakum in the bilge.
At night there is knocking in the hull, three times, pause, three times, as in caulking. With it a grumbling in Low German, mostly curses.
The galley is warm in the morning, although the stove was out. A remnant of porridge sticks to the pot.
Under the floorboards at night a light glimmers, as if from a small paraffin lamp.
The bilge pump never starts. Given its age and timber, the ship ought to leak like a sieve. No water comes in. The detectors show as little as the pump.
There are no rats on board, not one.
Tools disappear and are back in their place the next morning, freshly sharpened.
Wooden plugs in seams that were still leaking yesterday. Tiny footprints in the flour. Empty schnapps bottles, neatly in a crate. Passengers’ caps on the flagstaff in the morning.

akte.text: Sailors’ yarn. Whoever sees the Klabautermann will see his ship go down. Old sailors still believe it today.

A house spirit of seafaring. Small, cheeky, harmless. He knocks, drinks, hides things and sometimes mends something. In the evening he wants a bowl of porridge with butter, and no thanks. He lives only in wood. Salt and iron do not work; he has always lived among them.

Protocol Discharge, as of 1955: lay a child’s jacket or child’s boots on the hatch, without a word. He feels paid off and leaves the ship within three days. Twelve applications since 1954, all successful, an assignment for cadets. Follow-up: eight of the twelve ships were scrapped or lost within a year. Assessment: ships of that age.

Carbon copy of a list from the Hamburg maritime board: Tine Rüter, motor ewer, built 1908, sank off Heligoland on 3 February 1955, leak in the forepeak, four dead. Beside it, the card of the first case, discharge on 8 November 1954. Stamp: “Noted. No connection.”

name: The Lindworm in the Tunnel
zitat: “We had two machine guns and six thousand rounds. Every bullet that hit, he kept. He only went when I’d thrown the belt away.”
form: Being
grauen: Horrifying (3)
aktenfarbe: Black since 1987. Since the mine was closed in 1993, he has been considered asleep
haeufigkeit: Unique. The legends of Carinthia know a lindworm in almost every valley; the Registry knows this one
verstand: Animal, but old and patient
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Carinthia, the Bleiberg high valley below the Dobratsch, west of Villach
ersteSichtung: 17 February 1936, an abandoned tunnel in the Kreuth district. Report from the Bleiberg gendarmerie post to the mining authority in Klagenfurt: three unemployed miners dead while illegally picking ore, the fourth “talks about a worm”. Copy in the Registry since 1951
letzteSichtung: 29 August 2026, seismogram from the earthquake service: a swarm of tiny tremors beneath the high valley, moving since March
verluste: Two agents (14 October 1987), left in the mine. Outsiders: five miners, 1936 and 1951

signatur.text: Rotten eggs, so strong in the lower drifts that the gas detector goes off. Whoever breathes in his passages for long has a sweet taste on the tongue.
A grinding as of millstones, felt in the soles of the feet more than heard. In the houses of the valley, the glasses in the cupboard clink at night.
In his passages it is as warm as in a stable, over 20 °C, where the mountain is otherwise 8 °C.
In lamplight the walls of his passages shine grey like metal, as if someone had polished them with pencil lead.
Seismometers show swarms of tiny tremors that move slowly. Where he has been, the lead content in the spring water rises. Salt scattered in his passages turns black.
Dogs refuse every tunnel entrance in the valley. Hunting dogs whine when their master walks past a spoil heap with a full cartridge bag.
Electronics do not malfunction; they only measure what is there. Gas detectors go off; metal detectors in his passages beep without pause.
Round passages in the ore, 2 m wide, smooth as a pipe. The galena is gone; the zinc blende lies as sand on the floor. In the cemetery, sunken graves, in the coffins wood and clothes, but no bones.

akte.text: The Lindworm of Klagenfurt was a woolly rhinoceros; its skull lay in a gravel pit. The one in Bleiberg is firedamp and superstition. The file is Black so that nobody claims a holiday on the Dobratsch as an operation.

A lindworm of Carinthian legend, 20 to 30 m long, two forelegs, no wings. Lives in the mountain, eats ore, smells of sulphur. Blasting and noise wake him. He has been asleep since the closure in 1993. Iron and silver work. Do not enter the old mines.

Operation report of October 1987, extract: strike with two machine guns and assault rifles, around 6,000 rounds, numerous hits, no discernible effect, presumably armour of ore. Two losses. Recommendation for any further strike: heavy weapons and considerably more ammunition, no explosive charges, so as not to wake him.

Statement of the survivor, 1987: “He only went when I threw the belt away.” Note: panic reaction, belt empty. Attached, a slip with three dates, 1998, 2009 and 2025: sunken graves in the Bleiberg cemetery, all of miners. Behind it in pencil: “Subsidence. Referred to the mining authority.”

name: La Llorona
zitat: “We told the mothers to stop calling. It got very quiet in the streets along the canal. We thought that was a success.”
form: Being (listed among the Dead as an Apparition until 1977)
grauen: Uncanny (1) when you hear her weeping. Disturbing (2) when she holds a child by the hand and turns round
aktenfarbe: Grey. Dormant since 1978, note “Leaflet effective”
haeufigkeit: Rare. The legend knows her by every body of water in Mexico
verstand: Human. She asks children only one thing: “¿Eres mío?” Are you mine?
regionen: Latin America. The east of the Valley of Mexico, on the dry bed of the old lakes: Nezahualcóyotl on Lake Texcoco, Valle de Chalco on Lake Chalco, along the open canals
ersteSichtung: 9 March 1973, Nezahualcóyotl. Letter from a doctor at the health post to a colleague in Stockholm: in two years eleven children from her records had not come home; the mothers spoke of the Llorona
letzteSichtung: 22 October 2025, Valle de Chalco. Voice message from a nine-year-old boy to his mother, a weeping woman in the background
verluste: None. The file counts 19 children up to 1977

signatur.text: Saltpetre from the old lake bed and wet reeds, which have not grown here for decades.
A soft weeping, always the same distance away, wherever you go. In it, words in an old Spanish.
Near her the air is damp as over a lake. Glasses steam up, even in the dry season.
The canal does not reflect her but open water to the horizon.
Detectors at the canal measure nothing. Salt scattered on the bank grows wet and dissolves.
Dogs do not go to the bank; they lie across the front doors. At night herons stand in the sewage water, where there are never herons.
Phones record her weeping, not her. On recordings the weeping sounds closer than it was.
In the mud of the bank, the prints of a woman’s bare feet and beside them small shoes. Both lead into the water. No track comes back.
