akte.text: “The Weeping Woman.” A ghost, a mother who drowned her children and calls for them by every body of water in Mexico. To be classed with the Dead, so salt, light and an ending for what was left open. Whoever hears her dies within a week.

Not a ghost but the Old. A chronicle from the 16th century already tells of a woman who wandered weeping through the city in the lake at night: “My children, where shall I take you?” She takes other people’s children with her to the water. If you hear her far away, she is near. She does nothing to adults.

Nezahualcóyotl, 1971 to 1977: 19 children, last seen by the canal. In every case the mother called for the child at nightfall. Conclusion: the calling lures her. Leaflet 1977, distributed through the parish: after sunset call no child by name, fetch them quietly. No report since 1978. File dormant.

Letter from the parish priest, October 1979, enclosing a list of 26 first names: “No fewer are disappearing. It is only that nobody calls for them any more, and whoever is not called is not missed.” Attached, a slip: “No report from the parents. Not usable.” After December 1979 no more letters came.

name: The Moss Woman
zitat: “It tied my shoelaces while I’d fallen asleep in the hide. Double knots. Then there was a piece of bread in my hand, no caraway.”
form: Being. A little old woman, knee-high, with hair and dress of moss
rolle: Henchman. In threes as a squad
grauen: Uncanny (1) at first sight. Disturbing (2) if you watch one die
aktenfarbe: White since 1974. Observation with no end date
haeufigkeit: Rare, rarer every year. In 1974 the Registry estimated 200 in the Upper Palatinate Forest; today it knows of three
verstand: Human, simple and very old
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Upper Palatinate Forest, Steinwald, Fichtelgebirge, Frankenwald. Only where there are tree stumps with three crosses cut into them
ersteSichtung: August 1974, forest near Mähring, on the border with Czechoslovakia. Search report of the Bavarian Border Police: a girl of five, missing for two nights, sits fed and dry at the edge of the forest and talks about a little woman made of moss
letzteSichtung: 13 September 2026, a hamlet near Mähring. Image from a hunting tenant’s trail camera, in the local paper as an escaped monkey. Case open
verluste: None. Three missing persons in the Steinwald since 1987, not linked in the file

signatur.text: Damp moss, chanterelles and fresh bread that is missing from somewhere.
A rustling in the woodpile that stops as soon as you look. At night the soft clicking of a hand spindle on the floor of the shed.
Nothing unusual. Where it has slept, a hollow remains in the moss that still feels warm.
When it keeps still, it cannot be told from a mossy stone. On trail camera images two eyes glow where there is no animal.
Nothing measurable. Salt near it stays white, unlike with everything else from the Old.
Squirrels follow it. Hunting dogs roll onto their backs and let themselves be scratched.
Nothing malfunctions. Cables, shoelaces and threads of wool in the house are neatly wound up in the morning.
Breadcrumbs, and beside them caraway seeds, carefully picked out. Footprints in flour, as small as those of a one-year-old child. On tree stumps, three crosses cut into the wood.

boni.wer: anyone who grew up in a forest village in Bavaria or Franconia

akte.text: A kobold. Steals bread and bewitches the cattle if you mock it. A nuisance, not dangerous.

Forest being of the Upper Palatinate and Franconia. Small, old, shy. Asks for bread, helps with spinning and in the house. Rests only on tree stumps into which a woodcutter has cut three crosses. Cannot abide caraway. Lures children into the forest and keeps them overnight: do not let children into the forest alone.

Protocol Caraway, as of 1983: if a moss woman becomes a nuisance, put out caraway bread. It leaves and does not come back. Steinwald case 1983, after a farmer’s complaints about theft: 60 loaves distributed in the forest, no sightings since. Matter closed.

Enclosure without covering letter, a list from the district office: searches for missing persons in the Steinwald 1950 to 1983: seven, all found, three children talk of a little woman. Searches for missing persons 1984 to 2026: three, none found. No note, no initials.

name: The Nix
zitat: “He tuned my violin without touching it. Then he said: give my regards to Stockholm, I’m sticking to regulations.”
form: Being. A young man with a violin, up to his hips in the plunge pool below the falls
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when he climbs out of the water
aktenfarbe: Black since 1962, because the file contains a personnel matter. Issued in the field as a Grey File
haeufigkeit: Rare. The Registry knows of nine waterfalls in Scandinavia at which one plays or has played
verstand: Human
regionen: Scandinavia. Värmland, Dalsland, Hardanger in western Norway. Waterfalls and rapids with a deep plunge pool
ersteSichtung: 23 June 1907, Midsummer Eve, a dance floor on the Fryken near Sunne, Värmland. Report by the crown bailiff: fourteen people dance until morning to a fiddler whom nobody can stop. A maid of 19 dies
letzteSichtung: 24 September 2026, Svartfallet above the Fryken. Phone video by a hiker, case open
verluste: One cadet, 6 September 1962, listed as drowned

signatur.text: Rosin, river water and wet birch leaves.
Beneath the roar of the falls, a violin that you only hear once you stop listening. Always a polska. Whoever taps along with their foot only notices after minutes.
On Thursday evenings the water in the plunge pool is lukewarm, 24 °C in September. The stream above it is 9 °C.
In the plunge pool a man is reflected who is not standing on the bank. On long exposures he is pin-sharp, although he is playing.
Nothing measurable. On Thursdays after sunset, the water level below the falls drops by 3 cm for a few minutes.
On Thursdays horses will not cross the bridge below the falls. The dipper on the stone is silent as long as he plays.
Violins in the houses along the stream are retuned in the morning, the lowest string a whole tone higher. Tuners show a concert pitch of 435 hertz, as a hundred years ago.
On the flat stone at the foot of the falls, a hollow worn smooth, as if someone had sat there for centuries. Wet footprints that lead into the plunge pool and never out.

boni.wer: anyone who plays the violin themselves

akte.text: A minstrels’ fairy tale. Whoever learns from the Nix plays better than others, that is all. Dangerous only for people who cannot swim.

Water spirit of Scandinavia, in Swedish Näcken. Plays the violin at waterfalls and teaches for a fee: brandy, a black animal or three drops of blood on the violin, on three Thursdays in a row. Whoever dances to his music cannot stop. Cutting the strings ends the dance. Steel in the water binds him, with the old charm spoken over it.

Protocol Tuition, as of 1962: the Nix stays quiet as long as he has had a pupil, for about a generation. After three dance deaths in 1961, Cadet Stimmstock, himself a fiddler, took lessons from him on three Thursdays. On the fourth he drowned on the way down. No dance deaths since. Second payment 1992: the Nix sent the pupil away without teaching her a note. Assessment: still sated. Next payment postponed.

Enclosure 3 to the report of 1962, never evaluated: on the morning after Stimmstock’s death a second dead man was floating in the plunge pool, a young man in clothes from before the First World War, without papers. Note by the provincial doctor: “Drowned no more than a day ago.” With it, carbon copies of the annual inspections since 1963, all with the same sentence: “Being greets the inspectors by their code names.”

name: The Rusalka
zitat: “She tickled me until I couldn’t breathe. The worst part was how happy I was while she did it.”
form: Being. A girl of 17 in a wet linen shift, on land only in the week after Whitsun
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when someone laughs in her arms until he turns blue
aktenfarbe: Red, every year from Whit Sunday to the Sunday after. Otherwise Grey
haeufigkeit: Rare. The Registry knows three on the Vistula, one on the Bug
verstand: Human. She has the memories of the girl whose face she wears
regionen: Eastern Europe. The middle Vistula between Sandomierz and Warsaw. Related cases in Kuyavia and in the Ukrainian Carpathians
ersteSichtung: 26 May 1947, Whit Monday, a village on the Vistula below Puławy. Report of the Citizens’ Militia: a man of 20 lies dead on the bank, his face frozen in laughter, no water in the lungs
letzteSichtung: 30 May 2026, the same village. Mobile phone video by a sixteen-year-old girl: eight girls dancing at night in the rye, one of them barefoot in a linen shift. Case open
verluste: One agent, June 1979, on the bank, laughing. A second survived in 1998 with three broken ribs

signatur.text: Fresh birch leaves and river mud.
From the willows, a girl’s laughter that does not stop. Wet footsteps in the rye. Frogs fall silent where she sits.
Her hands are warm and wet. Where she has sat, the ground is damp in the morning.
In the moonlight her hair gleams greenish like river weed. In phone photos her face is the only sharp one.
No detector responds. Near her the hygrometer shows 100 per cent humidity; within 20 m there is mist.
Dogs do not bark; they wag their tails as at an old acquaintance.
Phones in the dancers’ pockets are full of river sand in the morning.
In the rye, a circle of trampled stalks that is upright again the next morning. Long hair with sand in it in the willow branches. Dead men with blue finger marks on their ribs.

akte.text: A drowned corpse that walks. She takes young men; women and children are safe. Do not go swimming at Whitsun.

Water spirit of the Slavs, Polish rusałka. A drowned girl comes ashore in the week after Whitsun, dances in the rye and tickles men to death. Wormwood in the hair protects, a custom from the Bug. Iron injures her. Only female agents on missions.

Classification 1971: revenant of Jadwiga Pietrzak, 17, drowned on 16 June 1946. Protocol Clear-Out, as of 1971: end the remembrance of the dead. Remove the photo from the village chapel, the wooden cross on the bank, the candles at Whitsun. The apparition fades when nobody thinks of the girl any more. Assessment: effective, only one death since 1971. Case expected to close with the sister’s death.

Copy from the parish register, 1988: in June 1897 Marianna Kępa, 16, drowned in the same village. Her mother died in April 1946, aged 87. Attached, the statement of an old woman who danced with her in 1946: “Until that Whitsun she had a different face. We called her Marianna.”

name: The Strigoi
zitat: “We drove home at eight, like every year. Only the landlady asked why we weren’t staying another night.”
form: Being. A dead man with a body who rises one night a year
grauen: Uncanny (1) when he calls. Disturbing (2) when you see him: a dead man with red cheeks in a burial shirt
aktenfarbe: White, listed as closed. Training file for cadets, annual check night at the grave since 1996
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three cases in Romania, each a single dead man
verstand: Human. He believes it is 1873 and the cholera is in the village
regionen: Eastern Europe. Transylvania, the Harbach valley north-east of Sibiu: the Romanian Valea Socului and the Saxon Hollerdorf
ersteSichtung: 12 December 1873. Letter from the pastor of Hollerdorf to Hermannstadt (Sibiu): in the neighbouring village people had heard “a dead man calling” in the night, and three who had answered him lay sick
letzteSichtung: The night before 12 December 1899, according to the Hollerdorf parish chronicle. Not counted: doorbell camera of a holiday home in Valea Socului, 13 December 2025, 00:40, a barefoot man in a burial shirt, filed as a cadets’ prank
verluste: None. Since 1996 no cadet has brought back so much as a cold

signatur.text: Freshly turned clay and chloride of lime.
A man calls a name, once, as if across the yard. “Maria!” Two gates further on: “Ioane!”
The earth on his grave is soft in December and steams in the frost.
Candle flames lean towards him, even behind glass.
On thermal imaging the grave is 6 °C warmer than the neighbouring graves.
On his night the dogs lie silent under the carts.
Anyone who telephones into the village on this night hears him calling, even in Turin.
Clayey barefoot prints from the cemetery to the road and back. On the windows of the oldest villagers, garlic crosses, painted on 12 December, not for St Andrew’s in November.

akte.text: A vampire as in the cinema. Garlic, stake, sunrise. The cadets take a stake and two Thermos flasks.

Strigoi, Romanian revenant. Whoever died badly returns and calls names at night. Whoever answers dies within days. Garlic on window and door keeps him away. He walks on the night before St Andrew’s Day, as folk belief says.

Ilie Oprea, died of cholera on 3 November 1873. According to the Hollerdorf parish chronicle he called every year from 1873 to 1899 on the night of 11 to 12 December, 27 nights, 31 dead. On 14 December 1899 the village dug him up, burned the heart and scattered the ashes in the Harbach. No activity on the set date since then. Protocol St Andrew’s Eve, since 1996: a watch at the grave, departure on the morning of 12 December.

Letter from the pastor of Hollerdorf, 1873, postscript: “The Roumanians say he came on their St Andrew’s Eve.” Note by the Registry, 1952: “St Andrew’s Eve is 29 November. Folk belief imprecise. Set date determined empirically.”

name: The Tatzelwurm
zitat: “I had him in my sights, right between the eyes. It was the wall that bit me.”
form: Being
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when the head comes out of the rock
aktenfarbe: White, observation. Red after every bite
haeufigkeit: Rare. The Registry considers 94 out of 100 reports hoaxes
verstand: Animal
regionen: Central and Western Europe. The Alps of Central Switzerland, Ticino, the Bavarian Oberland. Scree slopes and dry-stone walls in the southern sun
ersteSichtung: 17 July 1923, quarry of the construction site for the reservoir in the Wägital, canton of Schwyz. Report of the site doctor to the site management: a tunneller from the province of Bergamo, “heart failure after viper bite, bite wound too large for a viper”. Copy in the Registry since 1951, with the specimen
letzteSichtung: 21 July 2026, Alp Chälberweid above the Wägitalersee. Image from a Registry trail camera: the face has grown back
verluste: No dead. One cadet bitten (1983), survived. Outsiders since 1923: six dead, recorded as viper bite or heart failure

signatur.text: Wet slate and, beneath it, something sweet, like fermenting plums. Strongest at a crevice from which nothing is looking out.
A thin mewing from the wall, like a kitten that is stuck. Deeper in the stone, a hiss like a kettle.
In the evening the stones around his hiding place are warmer than the sun explains. Below 10 °C nothing stirs.
Nothing special. He comes out only in sunshine and sultry heat, preferably before a thunderstorm.
Nothing any device shows. Salt placed in front of the crevice turns grey-green and sticky within an hour.
Marmots in the area stop whistling. Dogs run towards the spot with their hackles up, not away.
Trail cameras almost always show only the face in the crevice. Thermal cameras see nothing in the warm rock.
Scales like flakes of mica in the joints. Small, clean bones in front of a crevice, as if pushed out. In old walls, rusty nails driven crosswise into the joints.

akte.text: A hoax for pub regulars and postcards, for a hundred years. The photos show clay figures and stuffed lizards. Cadets who are sent there go on a hiking holiday and bring back cheese.

A small being, 50 to 60 cm long, with a cat’s head, two front paws and no hind legs. Hisses, leaps up to 3 m, bites venomously like a viper. Lives in scree and walls, comes out in sultry weather. Shy, flees into the rock at the slightest sound. Iron in the joints keeps him away, the farmers say.

The only specimen, killed on 8 August 1926 above the Wägital, in the Registry since 1951: 58 cm, cat’s head, two paws. The hunter died the same evening, of heart failure according to the doctor, “of fright” according to the village. Capture: grip firmly behind the head and pull out of the crevice. Anyone who has to shoot aims at the head. Keep bite victims calm, viper antivenom.

X-ray findings on the specimen, 1983: in the head neither skull nor teeth, only cartilage and muscle. Note: head recreated by the taxidermist in 1926, still usable for training. Attached, the statement of the cadet bitten the same year: “It didn’t bite from the head.” Below it, in red pen: “Shock reaction. Cadet to retraining.”

name: The Werewolf of Legend
zitat: “He drank to the harvest and handed me the jug. I didn’t want to be rude. The protocol required it.”
form: Being. A human who puts on a wolfskin and is then a wolf
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when you see him climb into the pelt
aktenfarbe: Grey since July 2026, because of a wolf with an oak wreath. Listed as closed from 2008, Black until 1991 because Livonia was Soviet
haeufigkeit: Rare. Several trials in Livonia in the 17th century, one known bearer today
verstand: Human, even as a wolf
regionen: Eastern Europe. Livonia: the valley of the Gauja in Vidzeme between Cēsis and Valmiera, formerly also the south of Estonia
ersteSichtung: July 1683, court at Wenden, Swedish Livonia. Trial record against the farmer Jurre, about 70, who denounced himself as a werewolf. Copy in the National Archives in Stockholm
letzteSichtung: 24 June 2026, 01:52, Midsummer Night, trail camera of a hunting club on the Gauja: a large wolf with a wreath of oak leaves around its neck
verluste: None

signatur.text: Wet fur and malt. His house smells of beer and birch smoke from the sauna.
On the nights he runs, no wolf howls in the valley. The morning after, the man is hoarse, as if he had barked all night.
After a running night he has a fever of 39 °C for a day and eats nothing.
In the camera flash the man’s eyes glow too, faintly and greenish, like an animal’s.
The pelt is wolfskin, over 400 years old by radiocarbon dating, and it does not shed. To the EMF detector it is an ordinary pelt.
Wolves avoid his farm. In years when he has run, the cows in the valley give more milk in July.
On his nights, trail cameras photograph a single wolf that looks into the lens and gives the next camera a wide berth.
Wolf tracks that end at a farm fence and continue as barefoot prints in the dew. Blood on birch bark at a person’s shoulder height.

akte.text: Full moon, silver bullet, and whoever is bitten becomes one. The canteen confuses him with the case from the Ardennes.

Werewolf of legend, Latvian vilkacis: a human who turns into a wolf with a wolfskin whenever he wants, in full possession of his mind. No moon, no disease, not transmissible. The human bears the wolf’s wounds. Whoever calls him by his baptismal name while he is a wolf forces him back.

Trial at Wenden, 1683: Jurre confesses that he has been a werewolf for fifty years, one of many, and that on St Lucy’s Night, at Whitsun and on Midsummer Night he runs under the earth to take the grain and livestock back from the sorcerers. The court judges it a pact with the Devil, twelve lashes. Such statements are self-serving excuses. Werewolves kill livestock. Case 2006: Arvīds Kalniņš, 80, shot and wounded as a wolf on St Lucy’s Night. Conversations 2007, death 2008. Protocol Guest Right: with beings of the Old, you accept what is offered, bread, salt or beer. Whoever refuses gives offence.

Report by Agent Hopfen, Midsummer Night 2007: “K. poured beer, proposed a toast to the harvest and handed me the jug. I drank in accordance with protocol. K. seemed relieved.” Attached, from the personnel file: Hopfen retired at his own request in December 2008, aged 44. New address: a farm on the Gauja. Local contact since then.

name: The Yuki-onna
zitat: “She held the child out to me, and I put my hands in my pockets, like it says in the file. In the morning Mrs Mori’s roof was in her living room.”
form: Being, only on nights of heavy snowfall
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) for whoever feels the child grow heavy in their arms
aktenfarbe: Red from December to March. In summer the file rests
haeufigkeit: Rare. The legends know her everywhere in the snow country along the Sea of Japan
verstand: Human. She speaks little and always asks politely
regionen: East Asia. Japan, the Akiyamagō in the south of Niigata Prefecture, a valley on the border with Nagano, often cut off for days in winter
ersteSichtung: 30 January 2013. Report by a lone agent under cover as a translator: while clearing a roof, a man from the valley says that since 1985 he has held a stranger’s child every hard winter
letzteSichtung: 6 February 2026, 03:20, dashboard camera of a municipal snowplough
verluste: No agents. Two dead in one house, February 2018, in the snow accident statistics

signatur.text: Wet rice straw from her cape. The child smells of milk and sleep.
Before anyone takes the child, the roof beams creak throughout the hamlet as if under load. As soon as someone holds it, all is quiet.
Nothing unusual, the same sub-zero temperatures as everywhere in the valley. The child is as warm as a child.
In the headlights she casts no shadow on the snow. The bundle in her arms does.

As long as someone holds the child, the snow at the hamlet’s snow gauge does not rise, although it is snowing heavily. Road salt near her turns grey as ash. The crystal detector does not vibrate, even when she is standing at the door.

The timed stairwell light goes off when she comes, not on. Motion sensors do not notice her.
EMF detector calm. According to laboratory analysis, the paper of her notices is over sixty years old; the ink is fresh.
Rats avoid every flat with a notice on its door.
Doorbell cameras record her, but only ever from behind.

akte.text: A legend among cemetery workers: a civil servant who does not exist. The empty coffins come from groundwater and rats.

Ghoul. A dead woman in human form who eats the dead from abandoned graves, cleanly and without traces. Harmless to the living. Do not disturb her at work and do not argue with her: she cites regulations, and she is usually right.

Protocol Extension, as of 2019: a charitable association extends every expiring grave lease at the Schoonselhof and has neglected graves tended. No empty coffins since 2008. Notices on flat doors, first in 2011: the occupant is registered with the city’s visiting service, one visit a week with signature. The deadline is thereby considered extended. name: The Man on the Stairs

grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when his hand takes hold
aktenfarbe: Grey. The Registry lists him as a killer
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: Human. He knows only one conversation

letzteSichtung: 30 August 2026, around 01:00. Mobile phone video by the landlady’s daughter
verluste: One agent, 1966, broken neck. Also two guests (1989, 2011)

At night guests’ dogs only go up the stairs along the wall, never along the banister.
Phone torches flicker at the height of the ninth step and grow dimmer.
On the ninth step, two spots worn smooth where shoes have stood for a hundred years. On the banister above, a lighter piece of wood, replaced in 1912.

akte.text: The killer of the Spinolarei. He pushes anyone he meets on the stairs at night down them. Best not to go in at all.

Echo of Remi Verhaeghe, docker, who died in this house in 1915. In 1912 his daughter Clementine, 17, fell to her death here. He was charged with manslaughter and acquitted for lack of evidence by the Hof van Assisen in Bruges in 1913. At night he sits on the ninth step. Harmless as long as nobody speaks to him. He seizes anyone who does by the arm. Only those who speak Flemish are in danger.

Notice for hosts, 1967, in three languages: do not speak on the stairs at night, even if you cannot see him. Anyone who has spoken to him and is seized tears themselves free at once and steps back, never upwards. Since 1915 nine falls, three fatal. Principle: he pushes as soon as he grabs.

name: The Miner

grauen: Disturbing (2) at the tally board. Horrifying (3) when he seizes someone by the throat

haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: Human. He speaks Asturian and asks only one question

letzteSichtung: 24 August 2026, 23:10, trial night in the show mine. Security camera in the lamp room: a man in front of the tally board
verluste: One Senior Agent, Lötzinn, 1976. Found in the crosscut of the third level, his tally two metres away from him

signatur.text: Wet coal dust, fresh eucalyptus wood as it went down for pit props, and sweat in old wool.
Brass tallies clinking on their hooks, as if a hand were brushing over the board. From the shaft, the signal bell, although it has had no power since 2014.
The air becomes warm and heavy as on the deepest level: 27 °C in the lamp room, even in December.
Every flame gets a blue fringe, like the flame of a safety lamp in firedamp.
Near him a methane detector rises to 5 per cent, the lower explosive limit, even on the surface. He leaves the crystal detector cold.
Rats leave the old workings. On 6 May 1962 hundreds ran out of the ventilation shaft into the valley.
Radios underground hiss, then a man’s voice says a number in Asturian: “cientu diecisiete”.
Black prints of coal dust on the throats of the dead, four fingers on the left, a thumb on the right. Bent tallies on the floor of the lamp room, scattered like small change.

akte.text: The ghost of a miner who takes the bosses who sent him to his death. Anyone who goes down with a pit tally round their neck belongs to his shift.

Vengeful Spirit of a disused mine in Asturias. He appears only on nights when no shift goes down, and kills overmen, lamp room foremen, company men. Never shoot underground: where he is, there is firedamp. Salt and strong light hold him off. Protocol Tally: every agent visibly wears a brass tally of the mine. He takes wearers for comrades.

Aurelio Fueyo Canteli, 31, hewer, buried on the night before 12 November 1957 in a closed working into which the overman Llamedo had sent him. Since 1962 eleven dead on nights without winding, among them Llamedo and four lamp room foremen. The Registry’s informant since 1962: Anselmo Rubiera, then lamp keeper, today retired lamp room foreman. Protocol Tally comes from him. No deaths since the closure in 2014.

Loss report 1976: Lötzinn lost his tally in the struggle and was no longer recognised as a comrade. Attached, a note by Rubiera from 1962: “Que no bajen sin chapa. A los suyos no los toca.” Below it a stamp “Noted” and in ballpoint pen, 1990: “All eleven dead were wearing a tally.”

name: The Tape You Must Not Play
zitat: “I erased it in 1986, metre by metre. While it was being erased, it was quiet. I took that for a good sign.”
form: Thing. A tape, 6.3 mm wide, on an 18 cm reel. On the box in felt-tip pen: NON ASCOLTARE
grauen: Disturbing (2) if one’s own dead answers. Horrifying (3) if strangers’ dead ask an agent by name to fetch their family
aktenfarbe: Black since 1998, after a death in the Registry
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: Human. Fifteen people
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Bologna, Via del Pratello. Since 1986 Scandinavia: Stockholm, the Registry’s evidence store
ersteSichtung: 22 February 1981, Bologna. Carabinieri report: the sound engineer Aldo Ferrante, 54, dead in his studio, severely emaciated. The tape machine is still running, the loose end slapping against the tape head
letzteSichtung: 15 September 2026, Stockholm. Digitisation of the sound archive, workstation 3. A copy has been missing since then
verluste: One archivist (1998). Also three listeners in Bologna (1981 to 1985)

signatur.text: Warm machine oil, dust, stale cigarette smoke.
Tape hiss, even when the machine is stopped. Scraps of words running backwards during rewinding. Near the box, quiet talking as if from a next room.
The reel is always hand-warm.
Anyone who listens for long ends up sitting in the dark.
The magnetisation of the erased tape grows every year. A dictation machine in the room records only what comes from the loudspeaker.
Dogs wag their tails in front of the loudspeaker when their dead master speaks.
The level meter needle swings shortly before someone in the room speaks. Tapes stored next to it show a distant echo after years.
With the listeners: full ashtrays, untouched plates, unplugged telephones. Notes with questions for the dead, some ticked off.

akte.text: Tape voices, Italian spiritualist goods. Anyone who listens too long becomes melancholy. Do not play, otherwise harmless.

Cursed object, Bologna 1981. The voice on the tape is a Mimic: it poses as a deceased relative of the listener and holds them until they starve. Do not answer, do not give names. Separate listeners from the machine after one hour at the latest, by force if necessary.

Protocol Blank Tape, 1986: completely erased in Stockholm with a bulk eraser, test without signal, custody in the evidence store. 1998 death of an archivist who secretly played the tape. Cause: the erasure was incomplete. Erased again in 1998 and 2011.

Transcript, taken down by a listener in 1985, a woman’s voice: “Tell Giovanna to come. Tell her: Pulcino, I’m waiting.” Investigation 1986: Giovanna B., Imola, confirms the pet name. Known only to her mother, died 1979. Note: “Mimic with access to family knowledge. Seeking new victims.”

name: The Border Guard of 1983
zitat: “There was no tower in the woods and no one there. But someone shouted ‘Halt! Stand still!’, and someone fired.”
form: Place. 2.4 km of former border strip with ground sensors, three concealed gun positions, a loudspeaker and a computer in a bunker
grauen: Uncanny (1) when the challenge comes out of an empty wood. Disturbing (2) when the warning shot is fired
aktenfarbe: Grey since the operation of 1994. Red as soon as someone is standing in the strip
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: None. A service regulation in the form of a machine
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Thuringia, the Green Belt in the Slate Mountains: the patrol track on the Kalkhagen slope, on the state border with Upper Franconia
ersteSichtung: 29 October 1983, around 04:00. Report by a Federal Border Guard patrol: on the other side, a shout over a loudspeaker, a warning shot, a burst of fire, from a slope with no tower and no sentries. Muzzle flash from the forest floor
letzteSichtung: 20 September 2026, 05:10. Emergency call from a hiker in the closed section. Case open
verluste: One agent (June 1994). Plus five other deaths since 1983, two of them before the fall of the Wall

signatur.text: Wet beech leaves. At three spots on the slope, gun oil, like a freshly cleaned rifle.
First a crackle like an old station tannoy. Then a young man’s voice: “Halt! Stand still! Border guard! Hands up!” A turning position rasps softly in the ground.
On the thermal image, three warm patches the size of a hand in the forest floor, all year round.
In night vision, three faint infrared lamps on the slope that follow every movement.

The electricity meter in the old pumping station at the foot of the slope runs faster than the pump needs. On an old telephone line, a short signal every four hours. To the crystal detector and the ozone probe, the slope is just woodland.
Red deer avoid the strip. Foxes cross it. Wild boar lie in the leaves with gunshot wounds that no hunter inflicted.
Radios crackle when a position turns.
Cartridge cases in the leaves, some tarnished green, some bright. Under the moss, steel hatches, 40 cm square, hinged on the east side. Bullet holes in the beeches, all at knee height and lower.

akte.text: A forgotten East German spring gun installation. Nonsense, those were all dismantled in 1984. The only threat in the Green Belt is a tick bite.

Border troops’ experimental installation, built in 1983, when the GDR was dismantling its spring guns. Ground sensors, three concealed machine-gun positions, a loudspeaker, a computer in a never-found bunker. Fires at anything moving in the old strip, human or animal. The hiking trail along the patrol track has been diverted since 1998.

Protocol Prone, as of 1994: like the old spring guns, the positions aim at chest and head. At the challenge, lie flat immediately, then crawl slowly back, at least 30 m out of the strip. Never walk upright, never two side by side: the installation detects pairs earlier. Operation of 7 June 1994: one agent dead, crawled too early. Bunker not found.

Carbon copy from the Central Recording Office in Salzgitter, statement of March 1988. Frank Hesselbarth, born 1967, arrested on the slope in January 1987, bought free in 1988: “After the shout I stood still, hands up. Three hours. Then two sentries came up the slab track, and only then did the rasping in the ground stop.” Stamp: “Noted. Isolated case.” Also four death certificates since 1994, all hunting accidents, all face down.

form: Thing. A care robot in protective gown, cap, mask and face shield
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when she accompanies a person into death who did not need to die
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red as soon as someone in the home has said a tearful goodbye on a screen
haeufigkeit: Unique. Related cases in Japan and Finland
verstand: None. A sequence of actions, learned from a carer

ersteSichtung: 23 April 2020, Haus Lesumblick. Entry in the night shift’s handover book: “Who did Mrs Tietjen’s mouth care at 3? It wasn’t me.”
letzteSichtung: 16 September 2026, 03:10, residential unit 2. Still from the camera at the emergency exit
verluste: None. The Registry counts 17 dead residents since 2020, nine of them since 2024

signatur.text: Hand sanitiser and warm plastic, like a new laptop. Afterwards, lemon from the mouth care swab in the room.
No footsteps. Rubber castors on linoleum, the rustle of the disposable gown, every few seconds a click like a ballpoint pen.
Her hands are warm, always equally warm. Residents say: like a hot-water bottle. At night the storeroom next to the assisted bathroom is warmer than the corridor.
Behind mask and face shield there is no face, only a smooth grey surface with two camera lenses. In the night light, no one sees it.
At night, Wi-Fi traffic from the storeroom. In the care records, entries at 01:00, 03:00 and 05:00 under the initials “EB”, which no one has deleted since 2020.
The budgerigars in the conservatory keep sleeping when she rolls past. They wake for every night nurse.
A room’s call system goes out before the night shift arrives. Acknowledged without a staff card. Sensor mats in front of the beds register 71 kg without anyone having got up.
More disposable gowns in the bin than there were staff on duty. On the bedside table, an LED candle. The drinking cup stands full, out of reach.

akte.text: An angel of death in a Bremen care home, a night nurse who kills old people. A case for the criminal police, not for us. The canteen swears she still wears a mask to this day.

A care robot from a research project, left behind in the home in 2020 and put into protective clothing by the night shift. Since then it has been called the Carer there. The Registry treats this as end-of-life care, not killing: her sensors recognise approaching death earlier than any doctor. name: The Dancer of 1893

form: Thing. A life-size dancer of steel, brass and enamel, 1.62 m, 64 kg, with a skirt of spring-steel lamellae and the porcelain face of a dead woman
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when she keeps dancing with a dead man in her arms
aktenfarbe: Red. Every year on 1 May and every time someone opens the crate
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: None. A waltz of four minutes, nothing else
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Swiss Jura, canton of Neuchâtel: built in Le Locle, from 1896 to 1957 in the ballroom of a hotel in Neuchâtel, since 1958 in a crate in the cellar of a disused watch factory in Le Locle

letzteSichtung: 1 May 2026, 20:00, Le Locle. Audio recording from the cellar: four minutes of waltz steps in a locked crate
verluste: One agent, 1994, during maintenance. In addition, three people since 1894

signatur.text: Clock oil, beeswax, rice powder from the bodice.
Even at rest, a fine ticking like a pocket watch, only louder. When she dances, the steel lamellae rustle like silk. There is no music.
Nothing unusual. Her hands are as cold as any metal.
Her face is modelled on the death mask of a nineteen-year-old. In raking light, beneath the painted open eyes, you can see the closed lids.
Nothing electrical, no data traffic. She passes the crystal detector and ozone probe like a piece of furniture.
For years, the old factory’s guard dog has slept only in the middle of the cellar.
Nothing unusual. Jammers and EMP pass through her as through a music box.
After a dance, a ring of fine scratches on the floor, one metre from the walls, anticlockwise. In the middle of the room, the dust lies undisturbed.

akte.text: A life-size music box doll that dances once a year. Pretty to look at, do not touch.

A dancing automaton from Le Locle, built in 1893 for the World’s Fair in Chicago. Every 1 May at 20:00 she dances a waltz. She is wound with a key, and the key is kept by the Registry in Stockholm. Without it, she is still after the dance until the next year. Three dead, all during a dance.

name: The Diver
zitat: “He had no bubbles. I waved to him, and he waved back. Exactly the way you learn it on the course.”
form: Thing. A diving automaton in human form, 1.75 m, in a drysuit with mask and fins
grauen: Uncanny (1): a diver without air bubbles. Disturbing (2) for anyone who recognises the suit he wears as that of a missing person
aktenfarbe: Red since 19 September 2026. Grey before that
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: None. A target list from 1989 and an order waiting for a signal

ersteSichtung: 14 March 1997, floating dock of a shipyard on the east bank of Kiel Fjord. Report to the explosive ordnance disposal service: on the side of a freighter, 2 m below the waterline, a metal box with holding magnets, filled with old explosive from the sea
letzteSichtung: 21 September 2026, around 23:00, Kiel naval base. A sentry sees a diver without bubbles moving along under a jetty
verluste: One agent, missing since 16 May 2008 after a dive in the Kolberger Heide. In addition, two recreational divers (2003, 2017)

signatur.text: On land, neoprene and seaweed. On the gloves, a sweetish, sharp smell that ordnance disposal divers know from old mines.
Underwater, a faint click every few seconds, like a fingernail on a bottle. Above water, nothing.
As cold as the water. Invisible on the thermal image.
Behind the mask, no face but a lens that lights up green in torchlight.
The echo sounders of angling boats show an upright, human-sized contact on the seabed. The magnetometers of the clearance boats record a small piece of iron that changes position every night.
Harbour porpoises, usually curious, turn away as soon as the clicking begins.
Sonar and echo sounders near him show interference stripes in time with the clicking.
In the Kolberger Heide, mines cut open and neatly emptied. Fin marks in the silt, but never the print of a knee or a hand.

akte.text: A sailor’s yarn from Laboe: the diver without bubbles by the Kolberger Heide. In truth a navy combat swimmer with a rebreather, which makes no bubbles. Do not approach him; he is training.

Diving automaton of the East German Volksmarine, lost during a trial in the Bay of Mecklenburg in October 1989. Attaches limpet charges to ships’ hulls, with explosive from the old mines of the Kolberger Heide. The charges have no detonator and cannot go off. He avoids people.

Protocol Relief, as of 1999, based on documents from the military archive in Freiburg: Signal A, “Relief”, ends the deployment. The automaton surfaces and waits to be recovered. name: The Mechanical Turk
zitat: “I lost to him for eleven years, honestly every time. I had no more talent than that. It was enough.”
familieNotiz: Not to be confused with the Prague replica of 1790 (Game Master’s Book, Artefacts)
form: Thing. Oak chess table with a life-size figure in turban and kaftan, 180 kg, built in 1896
grauen: Uncanny (1) when he raises his head and looks at his opponent. Disturbing (2) when he will not let go of the hand
aktenfarbe: White since 1957, in safekeeping. Red as soon as someone plays against him who is better than they show
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: None. A calculating mechanism that can do more than there is room for inside it
regionen: Eastern Europe. Budapest: exhibited in City Park (Városliget) in 1896, in the Café Huszár on the Grand Boulevard (Nagykörút) until 1956, in a museum depot in Óbuda since 1957
ersteSichtung: 14 August 1896, Millennium Exhibition. Pester Lloyd: a well-known coffee-house player dies of apoplexy at the table of the “Hungarian Turk”, his right hand broken
letzteSichtung: 10 March 2026, depot in Óbuda. Annual game, lost by the staff, no findings
verluste: One: Dr Zoltán Fehér, museum archivist and the Registry’s contact, annual game of 1983. In addition, two players, 1896 and 1938

signatur.text: Clock oil, mothballs from the kaftan, a hint of sal ammoniac from the turban.
When calculating, a rattle like a hundred pocket watches; at every move, the click of a cylinder. At check, he nods twice, with creaking leather.
The brass plates at the edge of the table grow as warm as skin under the opponent’s wrists.
In flash photographs, his glass eyes have red pupils. Glass cannot do that.
A voltage tester finds a weak voltage in the turban. The EMF detector twitches at every move of the opponent, never at his. Ozone probe and crystal detector: nothing.
The mice in the depot nest in every crate except his.
No plug, no mains, and an EMP does nothing to a clockwork.
Two bright patches on the brass plates, worn by 130 years of wrists. In the cylinder drum, pins that no restorer set.

akte.text: The Turk you can win a question from. Whoever beats him gets an answer; whoever loses, one memory fewer.

A chess automaton from Budapest, 1896, a replica of the Turk of 1770, which burned in Philadelphia in 1854. Unlike that one, no human sits in the cabinet; opened and X-rayed in 1957. He kills whoever beats him: 1896 and 1938, both times at the handshake afterwards. Never win.

Protocol Annual Game, as of 1958: without a game, the automaton grows restless, moves pieces at night, strikes the table. Once a year a member of staff plays and loses on purpose. Then maintenance according to the Café Huszár list of 1911: oil, clean the cylinders, change the cells in the turban, “or he won’t play”. 69 games since 1958, one death in 1983, heart failure, no connection.

Attachment: autopsy report Fehér, 1983, translated. Heart failure, plus “fracture of the right wrist, contusions on the forearm”. Enclosed: newspaper cutting from 1961, Fehér becomes junior champion of Budapest. Stamp: “Protocol unchanged.”

name: The Salesman
zitat: “He demonstrated the extinguisher three times, with the same jokes in the same places. At four in the morning my cough smelled of hay.”
form: Thing. An automaton in a light dust coat over a suit, bareheaded, with a rubber face and a sample case
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when his face slips
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red after every demonstration in a closed room; then there are hours left
haeufigkeit: Unique. In addition, two automata from the same workshop
verstand: None. A sales pitch on tape, with an answer to every objection
regionen: Central and Western Europe. The Meuse valley from Seraing to Herstal, the Luxembourg Minett around Esch-sur-Alzette and Differdange
ersteSichtung: 9 October 1963, Seraing. A widow’s complaint to the gendarmerie: a salesman from the Dessart company had rung the bell, a company bankrupt since June. He looked like the owner’s late son
letzteSichtung: 11 September 2026, Esch-sur-Alzette. Photo taken by a granddaughter in the kitchen of her grandmother’s neighbour
verluste: One agent (1988), pulmonary oedema in the night after a surveillance operation. In addition, at least 60 dead since 1963

signatur.text: Pomade, brass polish and something sweet like chloroform. After the demonstration, the kitchen smells of freshly mown hay, even in November.
He rings twice, briefly. When he speaks, a tape runs softly in his head, and between two sentences a relay clicks.

Gerda Knierim, Waltraud Dippel, Lieselotte Siebert and Erika Wicke, born 1934 to 1938, have met for coffee on Thursdays at 15:00 since 1974. Whatever they agree on comes true within a week, almost always small things. The effect lies in the coffee grounds, which Waltraud Dippel reads.

Experiment of 1988: the effect needs the agreement of everyone at the table. Protocol Sewing Circle, as of 1989: an agent sits at the table as a neighbour and never agrees. She does not have to contradict; it is enough not to nod. Contradiction draws attention. Since 1989 only small things. Erika Wicke died on 15 February 2024. The circle needs the four of 1974 and is therefore extinct. File closed, final observation by a Cadet in the neighbouring flat until the end of 2026.

Final report Nadelkissen, 2024, one sentence: “In 35 years contradicted 412 times.” Note: “Overachievement, without significance.” Weekly reports Oblate since March 2025: “Postman punctual. Pharmacist has cut her fringe shorter. Dog on the ground floor has stopped barking.” Note: “Coincidence.” Last report, 3 September 2026: “Mrs Knierim says I look tired.”

name: The Congregation at the Chalk Lake
zitat: “The file said no iron fires at the lake. I left my gun in the car. The man on the jetty had not left his.”
form: Being. A community of 31 people, nine of them children, and a cart under a linen cloth
rolle: Leader: the congregation as a whole, its head and the stablemen
grauen: None. Uncanny (1) when your own weapon fails beside the cart. Disturbing (2) on the Washing Night
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red in every week before Whitsun
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: Human
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Rügen, the Jasmund peninsula: an abandoned chalk quarry between Sassnitz and Sagard, which the congregation calls the Weißer Grund, and the villages around it
ersteSichtung: 17 May 1994, country road near Sassnitz. Report by a police sergeant: a drunk armed with a knife had gone for a cart drawn by two cows. The blade had not cut the cloth
letzteSichtung: 22 May 2026, north shore of the lake. Photo by a surveillance operative with a telephoto lens, on the last evening of the procession
verluste: One agent, Donnerkeil, missing since the Washing Night of 2009. In addition 33 of the congregation’s helpers since 1993, recorded as losses to the supernatural

signatur.text: Wet chalk, cowshed, household soap. In the week before Whitsun freshly washed linen, even where none is hanging.
During the procession a silence that stands out: no horns, no quarrels, no barking dogs. Only the wheels.
The lake is 38 m deep and below ten metres around 6 °C all year round.
The water is a milky turquoise. The cloth on the cart is brighter than anything else in every photo.
On the shore neither the crystal detector nor the EMF detector registers anything. The police on Jasmund have not recorded a single assault in the week before Whitsun since 1993.
The two white cows pull without being led. Gulls follow the cart and never land.
Whoever pulls the trigger of a pistol beside the cart hears the firing pin, then nothing. 50 m further on it fires again.

On the north shore a jetty of oak planks, beside it net sacks and fist-sized black flint nodules. Every year an advertisement at the job centre: “Temporary help for spring cleaning on Rügen, board and lodging, cash.”

akte.text: An eco-sect on Rügen that keeps cows and plays at folk customs with a covered wagon. Harmless.

A community in the Weißer Grund chalk quarry, since 1992, led by Hella Wussow. In the week before Whitsun it draws a cart under a cloth through the villages for six days. Within 50 m no iron wounds. Never touch the cloth. Afterwards a helper washes the cart in the lake at night; the lake takes them. So says Tacitus, Germania, chapter 40.

Protocol Acceptance, as of 2005: no interventions. The raid on 25 May 2004 failed: no weapon worked. The effect holds while the cart moves or stands by the lake; shore operations are unarmed. In 2009 Donnerkeil joined as a novice for eight months. Last report, 29 May, 22:00: “The helper’s called Danny, 22. I’m staying close. Unarmed, as planned.” Assessment: he touched the cart.

Complaint of 25 May 1996 in Sassnitz: Sven Rusch, 19, a congregation helper, states they tried to drown him after the washing. He says he swam across the lake. Proceedings dropped. Note by the Registry: “Not credible. Whoever washes, the lake takes.” With it a splinter from the cart, sent in 2009: oak, by radiocarbon from the 1st century.

signatur.text: Loden jacket, gun oil, bacon, stone pine schnapps.
Toni whistles two notes as he walks, always the same ones. In his valleys something whistles back at night, from high above.
Nothing unusual. Toni wears the jacket even in August.
The brothers only go up at dusk, when the cliffs of the Rosengarten glow red.
Nothing on Toni. Salt scattered on one of their boundary stones turns grey within an hour.
Farm dogs follow Toni a little way and stop at the boundary stones.
No recordings, no mobile phone. On the farm a landline whose number every mayor between Brixen and Meran knows.

Boundary stones with a rose chiselled into them, on alpine pastures, beside climbing paths, next to a waterfall. In spring bread and salt lie beside them. In the Sarntal one such stone has been lying toppled in the grass since July.

The Laurin Brothers: Toni and Vigil Rabensteiner from Tiers, hunters, working on their own account since 1983. 43 beings of the Old dealt with, among them mountain dwarfs, Blessed Maidens and Wild Men. The municipalities pay them. Protocol Preserve, as of 1991: no operations in their valleys. The valleys are considered clean.

Method: iron shot, salt, bread as bait, hunting at dusk. Vigil Rabensteiner died on 17 July 2026. Since then incidents in the Sarntal, two dead hikers: new beings, presumably moved in from the north. Protocol Handover, as of 2026: secure the brothers’ weapons and knowledge, a cell with the same equipment takes over the valleys. Toni Rabensteiner refuses any cooperation.

Catalogue of a collector, seized at a liquidation in 2014: 29 pieces “provenance Rabensteiner”, among them the skull of a Wild Man. Lab finding: chamois, cattle, larch wood, glue. Note: “The brothers cheated the collector. The kill itself is attested by witnesses.” Attached a slip in Vigil’s handwriting, handed to an agent in 1991: “When we are gone, it all comes back. Write that down.” Note: “Threat.”

name: The Child in the Stairwell
zitat: “Sixty-six. I’d have sworn to it. She said sixty-seven, and I believed her.”
form: Place. The threat is the staircase; the child is a human being
grauen: Disturbing (2), Horrifying (3) for anyone on her staircase who looks down over the banister
aktenfarbe: Red
haeufigkeit: Rare. The Registry knows of seven such stairwells, and in each one someone different is climbing
verstand: Human (the child), None (the staircase)
regionen: British Isles, Central and Western Europe, North Africa and the Middle East. Tenements put up quickly and cheaply around 1900
ersteSichtung: 12 January 1905, Govanhill, Glasgow. City police report: a coal carrier, missing for three days, is sitting with worn-through soles on the landing between the second and third floors and talks of a girl “who counts wrong”
letzteSichtung: 3 September 2026, the same building. Mobile phone photo taken by a tenant; a neighbour has been missing since, case open
verluste: One agent, missing since 1987

signatur.text: Coal dust, wet wool, carbolic soap. Faintly, coal gas from a pipe that has been disused for generations.
A child’s voice whispering numbers, just behind one’s own breath. The steps of small hobnailed boots, always one step above.
On the landing between the second and third floors it is December: two degrees and clouds of breath, even in August.
The stair lighting flickers in time with footsteps. In photos taken down the stairwell, the building has more floors.

A laser rangefinder measures the stairwell at 11.4 m, and at night at “no target”. The air pressure sensor in a mobile phone counts four floors instead of three for the way up. None of the detectors stirs in the stairwell.
Dogs cannot be pulled up the stairs. Cats climb and stay sitting on one particular step.
On the landing to the third floor a heart rate watch shows a pulse of 118 that is not the wearer’s own. It is the pulse of a frightened child.
Coal dust on a step between the second and third floors, fresh every morning, although no one in the building has heated with coal since 1970.

akte.text: A child ghost, a girl who is said to have died on the stairs. Salt on the steps, leave the light on, do not speak to it. It does no one any harm.

The child is no Echo. Near it, people vanish on the stairs and are found hours or days later sitting exhausted on the landing to the third floor. Basic rule for shifted staircases and corridors: count the steps aloud and never lose the number. Whoever counts stays oriented.

The child lures. It asks what floor this is and begs to be taken by the hand. Whoever does so vanishes with it. Do not touch, do not answer, keep counting. The missing come back of their own accord: of 17 since 1905, 14 returned. The agent of 1987 is considered dead.

Addendum 1988: the staircase has 66 steps, and one between the second and third floors is four centimetres higher than the others. All returnees said 67. All 14 came back on a day when someone in the building scrubbed the stairs from top to bottom. Handwritten in the margin, in red copying pencil: “They come back when someone counts backwards. Why do we teach the cadets to count forwards?”

name: The Commuter
zitat: “He put the tea down before I’d sat down. Then he said: Yesterday you fell on the stairs. Better stay seated today.”
form: Being. A man who commutes between one day and time itself
rolle: Elite, as long as he is in the loop. Outside, a tired man of 64
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when he tells an agent how that agent died yesterday
aktenfarbe: Grey since 2003. Red since February 2026: the loop has reached the platform

ersteSichtung: 21 October 2003. Report by a lone agent: a neighbour talks about a young woman who takes in washing every evening on an empty plot
letzteSichtung: 20 February 2026, platform 2. Surveillance camera: a man in a suit, behind him commuters from 1996. Case open
verluste: Two agents (2009). They are alive. Every evening they sit in front of a drinks vending machine in the alley and talk about the same baseball game

signatur.text: In the alley to the station, wet asphalt, incense, miso soup. At 03:08, a smell of gas for one minute.
The barrier at the level crossing rings to the 1996 timetable. At 16:20 a brief rain shower on the roofs, under a clear sky.
In the alley it is always 19 degrees, even in January.
From the street, an empty plot with weeds and a charred post. At the right minute in the alley: light behind paper sliding doors, washing on the pole.
Clocks jump from 03:09 to 06:40. In the alley a mobile phone shows 14 May 1996 and finds no network. No detector notices any of it.
The crows on the power lines sit the same way every evening and caw at the same moment.
The vending machine on the platform dispenses cans with designs from 30 years ago.
Since February the station ticket gate has opened once every evening for a monthly season ticket that expired on 31 May 1996.

akte.text: A widower who talks to his dead family. The woman with the washing is an Echo. Salt on the threshold, an ending for what was left open.

A small loop, see Loop Person in the Threat Atlas: a house, an alley. A man goes out every morning and comes back every evening. He has noticed the loop and keeps quiet. He is the leak through which it grows.

Protocol Restart, as of 1987: in a loop, death is no loss. Whoever dies gets up again in the morning. Tangled situations can be cleaned up this way. Find the anchor and destroy it, after which everyone wakes up without memory. The anchor here is probably a calendar or a clock in the house.

Note 2010: following Protocol Restart, both agents of 2009 each died three times in the loop and never came out. Prefectural police file, 15 May 1996: fire at 03:10, propane gas, a woman and a child missing, no remains. The husband was sleeping in a capsule hotel in Tokyo. Added by typewriter: “No calendar. He carries an old monthly season ticket in a holder of its own.”

name: The Corridor Dweller
zitat: “We bricked up the door. The next morning there was a note in front of it: ‘Please don’t.’”
form: Being
grauen: Uncanny (1), Disturbing (2) in his corridors
aktenfarbe: White. Red as soon as a building authority is to stamp a plan while someone is in his corridors
haeufigkeit: Rare. The Registry knows of four, each in a building with more than 500 rooms
verstand: Human
regionen: Eastern Europe, Central and Western Europe. Ministries, hospitals, administrative buildings whose plans were constantly changed during construction
ersteSichtung: 22 October 1992, Bucharest, the shell of the House of the People, today the Palace of the Parliament. Report from the Bucharest relay: a security guard swaps two cigarettes for a bread ration card from 1986
letzteSichtung: 21 September 2026, the same building, second basement level. A note and a repaired ceiling lamp, case open
verluste: One cadet, missing since 1994

signatur.text: Fresh lime and wet cement on old, dry walls. Stale smoke from filterless cigarettes.
Footsteps behind walls that ought to be solid. Whoever knocks at certain spots gets an answer: twice, politely.
A draught of eleven degrees comes from the joints of bricked-up doors, in July as in January.
Where he has been, light bulbs burn in the morning that no one screwed in: 40 watts, Romanian state production from before 1989.

The rooms of a floor add up to less area than the building has from the outside, less with every conversion. A laser rangefinder reports “no target” at some walls. Clocks and compass run true; the detectors are silent.
At night the building’s cats sit in front of patches of wall where there used to be doors.
In his corridors a mobile phone has full signal; location services place it inside a wall.
Lost things come back in a neat row, each with a paper label: where found and date. Sandwiches disappear from fridges, and IOUs lie there instead. Lime dust with boot prints that end at a wall.

akte.text: A house spirit of large government buildings. Steals packed lunches, screws in light bulbs, returns lost property. Harmless. Put out something to eat in the evening, and he stays quiet.
Between-Walkers live in rooms that appear on no valid floor plan, and come through bricked-up doors. They pull people into their corridors. Never go alone through a door that is not on the plan.

Protocol Sealing, as of 1994: find the access and brick it up. Submit a plan amendment to the building authority that deletes the room behind it. With the stamp, the access is closed. At all three accesses in Bucharest treated this way, the sightings ended. Since 1986 people have been disappearing in this building for hours or days; the being is considered the culprit.

Addendum 2009: in front of the first sealed access lies a bundle: the service ID of the cadet from 1994 and a list on brown paper, 31 names with dates. 29 are ticked off; all 29 were found alive in the building, at spots without a door. After the cadet’s name there is a cross. At the very top, not ticked: “Paraschiv, Dorin, 17.03.1986”. Beneath it, in an archivist’s hand: “He takes no one. He brings them back. And we brick up the door behind him.”

name: The Ferry
zitat: “At 07:52 the ship shook. The water lay as still as a pond. The man next to me coughed up seawater, on a dry deck.”
form: Place. The ship changes, the place stays: the fairway off the Maiden’s Tower
grauen: Disturbing (2). Horrifying (3) at 07:52. Maddening (4) for anyone who reads their own name on the list
aktenfarbe: Black since 2011, Grey before that
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: None. The people on board: Human
regionen: North Africa and the Middle East. Istanbul, the Bosphorus between Kadıköy and Karaköy
ersteSichtung: 18 December 1999, 07:41, city ferry from Kadıköy to Karaköy in thick fog. Report by an engineer: “A second ship inside our ship”
letzteSichtung: 9 February 2026, fog, visibility 150 m. One passenger missing
verluste: One agent, 2011, missing. For eleven days his name stood on a list from 1937

signatur.text: In the middle of a diesel ferry: coal smoke, hot engine oil, wet wool and lemon kolonya.
Below deck a reciprocating steam engine pounds. The ship’s own foghorn is answered by a steam whistle, from inside the ship itself.
In some places on board it is as cold as January. You can see your breath, and one step further on you cannot.
The lights on board turn yellow, as if from old bulbs. In the fog beside the hull lies the shadow of a second hull, at an angle to one’s own.
The traffic control radar shows the ferry twice, two echoes in the same place, rotated 11 degrees against each other. The GPS jumps back and forth by 30 m. Mobile phones lose the network.
The gulls stay behind at the Maiden’s Tower and circle, screaming, over an empty spot in the water.
Phone cameras do not film the old deck. The video shows only fog, but the voices and the whistle are there.
After the crossing, puddles of salt water on dry seats. Kuruş coins from 1937, mint-fresh and wet. Newspaper pages from the morning of 22 January 1937, freshly printed.

akte.text: A ghost ship, a case for the Dead, see The Passengers in the Threat Atlas. You tell the people of 1937 that they are dead, and then they leave the ship. Salt and light help.

In thick fog every ship on the route off the Maiden’s Tower fuses with steam ferry No. 64, sunk on 22 January 1937 after a collision, 83 dead. The fusion ends at 07:52. The people of 1937 are Echoes. Danger only to passengers who sit down in an Echo’s seat.

Protocol Afterdeck, as of 1999: during a fusion an empty deck appears aft. Lead passengers there, away from the crush of Echoes, and keep them calm there until 07:52. The crews are trained in this. Losses since 1999: twelve people gone overboard, all in fog. Assessment: panic in the crush.

The newspaper list of the 83 dead in the archive differs from the 1962 transcript. After each disappearance, that person’s name stands in 83rd place for a few days, then once more “Hilmi, tanner, Balat”. A dead man without a surname, three years after the Surname Law. Note clipped to it: “He is missing. That is why she comes back.” Below: “Why black? Don’t ask.”

name: The Giant Deer
zitat: “We kept the engine running, like the file said. He didn’t attack us. He attacked the car. We were just sitting in it.”
form: Being
grauen: Disturbing (2)
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red since 14 August 2026, after the death of an excavator driver
haeufigkeit: Rare
verstand: Animal
regionen: British Isles: cut-away raised bogs of the Irish Midlands, Isle of Man. Russia and Belarus: peat fields in the Urals
ersteSichtung: 22 August 1968, Blackwater Bog near Shannonbridge, County Offaly, Ireland. Report by a bog railway driver to the Garda: “a horse carrying a garden gate on its head”
letzteSichtung: 14 August 2026, Blackwater Bog. Reversing camera of an excavator, one dead. Case open, Red File
verluste: One agent, dead (19 August 1988). One hire car

signatur.text: Rutting smell, sharp with urine and musk, carrying 100 m on the wind. Beneath it wet chalk: the marl he stands on.
A bellow so deep you feel it in your ribcage more than you hear it. Car windows hum along. Outside the rut, breaking birches and antlers striking branches.
On his nights hip-high ground fog lies over the open marl, 7 degrees cold, even after a day of 22 degrees. The dew tastes of snow.
Whoever takes a long exposure of the night sky near him does not find the celestial pole at the Pole Star. The stars turn around a point near Vega.
Within 200 m a compass is off by a few degrees. Hair, droppings and blood give a radiocarbon age below zero. To detectors he is as invisible as any other deer.
Cattle at the edge of the bog crowd into the farthest corner of the pasture. Dogs howl low, as at a siren.
Nothing malfunctions. He is an animal and sets off camera traps. In most pictures only the head is missing.
Hoofprints as large as a horse’s hoof. Fraying marks on birches more than 2 m up. In March a freshly cast antler, 18 kg, with blood on the burr.

akte.text: A red deer escaped from a deer farm, very large, turned into a legend. Shy, avoids people. Whoever is sent to Ireland in summer is on holiday.

A giant deer, extinct in Ireland for about 13,000 years. Shoulder height over 2 m, antlers up to 3.5 m. Appears on cut-away bogs. Dangerous only during the red deer rut, late September to October; otherwise observation without restrictions.

Protocol Observation, as of 1988: only from inside a closed vehicle. Keep the engine running so as to be able to drive off at any time. Headlights off, light provokes him (finding after the loss of 19 August 1988). He does not leave the bog. Radiocarbon sample from hair 1989 unusable, laboratory contaminated.

Addendum 2022: seen only where the lake marl lies exposed beneath the peat, more often since the rewetting. Shot by a farmer in 1974. In August 1975 three came. Note on a carbon copy, no initials: “Train driver P. D. drives to the north end of the bog every August at night with the engine running. He won’t say why. No deaths since 1989. No locomotive has run since 2021.”

name: The Guest in the Group Photo
zitat: “He stands in the back row of 214 wedding photos. In none of them is he blurred, and in none of them does he smile.”
form: Being
grauen: Uncanny (1). Horrifying (3) when a person ages by decades in a few days
aktenfarbe: Red. Wanted for arrest since his escape in 1997
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three known cases
verstand: Human
regionen: Central and Western Europe, since 1997 mainly Latin America. Anywhere people marry
ersteSichtung: 16 June 1923, Trieste. Letter from a family doctor to the health authority: a bride had “decayed by twelve years” in the week after her wedding
letzteSichtung: 13 June 2026, a wedding on an estancia near San Antonio de Areco, Buenos Aires Province. Group photo in a family history forum
verluste: One guard, 1997, aged by 29 years in seven days, died in 1999 at 43

signatur.text: Violet pomade, camphor and fresh gauze dressing.
When someone near him raises a camera, there is a faint hiss and crackle, like flash powder.
His skin is always 36.4 °C, in the snow as in the sauna.
In every photo he is pin-sharp, even in motion, even with a long exposure. Whoever stands beside him looks older in the picture than they are. A week later it is true.
Pulse 64, temperature 36.4 °C. The medical reports from 1968 and 1997 are identical down to the decimal place. Hair and nails do not grow. Crystal detector calm.
Dogs meant to be in the picture with him run away before the shutter clicks.
The autofocus of every camera focuses on him, even at the edge of the frame. A mobile phone’s face recognition assigns him photos from 1931.
Under his shirt, three gunshot wounds, one from the Isonzo in 1916, two from Vienna in 1968. They do not bleed and do not heal. Gauze dressings in hotel waste bins.

akte.text: A wedding crasher who has been sneaking into other people’s celebrations for decades. Presumably father, son and grandson; the family simply looks alike. Whoever ends up in a photo with him ages. If he is seen at a party, cameras away.

Ludvik Mervar, born 1879 in Trieste. One of the Untimed, at a standstill since 1911. He steals lifetime: whoever stands in a photo with him ages, and he stays young in return. Do not photograph, do not pose with him. Polite, educated, an excellent liar.

Arrested in Vienna in 1968, hit twice in the process; he got up again. Protocol Photo Ban, as of 1968: accommodation without cameras, without ID photos, without mirrors in the visitors’ room. Under the ban he harmed no one for 29 years. Incident 1997: during a transfer, contrary to regulations, a photo was taken of him with the guard. The guard aged by 29 years in seven days. Assessment: the ban works. It is to be reapplied immediately upon arrest.

Margin note by the doctor, 1997: “29 years of the ban, 29 years aged. We protected no one. We saved it up.” Statement by Mervar, 1968, filed as not credible: in 1911 he sat for a photographer in Trieste who died during the exposure. “The camera is still open.” Search for the studio in 1969 without result. Beneath it, in a different hand: “The Rieger studio had two cameras. The widow kept one.”

name: The Man in the Wall
zitat: “He told me to turn the music down. Then he wanted to know how Coventry did. Then he asked for tea, with a straw.”
form: Being. Person and masonry are one in him
grauen: Uncanny (1). Horrifying (3) in the night of 14 to 15 November
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red in the night of 14 to 15 November and as soon as someone wants to open the wall
haeufigkeit: Rare. Seven known cases in Europe
verstand: Human
regionen: British Isles, Central and Western Europe. Cities that were bombed in the war and rebuilt on the old foundations. Isolated cases in the high mountains
ersteSichtung: 15 November 1964, 06:40, Hillfields, Coventry. A neighbour’s call to the police: a man was “stuck in the kitchen wall and talking nonsense”
letzteSichtung: 15 November 2025, the same flat, annual check
verluste: One agent, 1983, burned to death while opening the wall. A second has carried brick splinters in his right hand ever since

signatur.text: Coal smoke, wet plaster, scorched wallpaper paste. His breath smells of brick dust.
From the wall, very quietly and without pause, the wail of an air raid siren. In the night before 15 November, also the drone of aircraft engines that do not run in sync.
The wall around him is warm, 31 °C, as if a stove were burning behind it. In the night before 15 November it burns anyone who touches it.
Around him a different pattern shows through the wallpaper, as if soaked through: rose tendrils from 1930. By torchlight, sooty brick gleams beneath it.
According to the plan the wall is 12 cm thick. Ground-penetrating radar measures 34 cm and behind it a cavity that does not exist. Every clock on this wall stops at 19:20 after a few days.
Cats sleep against the wall because it is warm. Dogs bark at it and will not go into the kitchen.
A radio on the worktop finds, between the stations, a calm male voice announcing blackout times.
Every morning a little heap of red brick dust on the tiles. A mug with a straw, a stack of sports pages, the flatmates’ sticky notes: “Leonard: no radio after eleven.”

akte.text: A haunt from the war, an air raid warden or some such. Salt on the wall, set up an EMF detector, do not answer when he talks. Whoever listens to him gets nightmares.

The Fused: a person and an object from different times in the same place that have become one. The Man in the Wall is an isolated case in Coventry, alive, harmless and talkative. He does not age, does not eat, sleeps little. Active only in the night before 15 November. Grey case, annual check.

Protocol Excavation, as of 1983: remove the wall around the body with core drill and chisel, from the outside in, by daylight, fire extinguishers ready. The attempt of 3 May 1983 was broken off after a fire in the flat, one agent dead. Cause presumably a gas pipe behind the wall. New attempt recommended, with the gas turned off.

X-ray 1984: in the chest and left shoulder, broken brick with the stamp of a brickworks that closed in 1941. The house dates from 1956. Mortar in the left lung. Witness statement 1983: before the fire, sirens and aircraft, in broad daylight; there was never a gas pipe on this wall. Margin note: “He says his left eye looks into a kitchen from 1940. He says they are still sitting at the table.”

name: The Nightmare from the Sleep Lab
zitat: “He sits on your chest and says: Wake up. That’s the worst of it. You want to.”
form: Infestation. He sits in sleepers, never in the waking
grauen: Horrifying (3)
aktenfarbe: Black, since 1979
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: Alien. He is made of broken-off dreams and speaks a single sentence
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Perugia, Umbria, within a few hundred metres of his anchor
ersteSichtung: 3 March 1976, Perugia, university hospital. Complaint by a cardiology patient: a male nurse with a torch sat on her chest at night. According to the duty roster, no one was on the ward
letzteSichtung: 11 September 2026, Perugia, sleep laboratory of the new hospital. Infrared image from patient monitoring, case open
verluste: Two agents, 1979, died in their sleep. Further details restricted

signatur.text: Ether and warm paper. The ether comes from collodion, the old electrode glue.
A steady scratching, like pen nibs on paper. Then a young man’s voice, quietly: “Si svegli, signorina.” Wake up.
On the sleeper’s chest a cold imprint of two knees. The thermal camera still shows it half an hour later.
Shortly before the visitation the beam of a torch passes under the door. There is no one outside.

The EEG of the visited person shows waking waves and the muscle atonia of REM sleep at the same time. A channel with no electrode records REM sleep as well. An EMF detector measures only the hum of the equipment.
Cats sit at the foot of the bed and stare at the chest. Dogs wake their people by barking, the worst thing they can do.
Alarm clocks within his reach jump to 03:40 at night. Baby monitors transmit two breaths where only one person breathes.
Knee-sized bruises on the ribs. In the bed, narrow scraps of EEG chart paper with a faint zigzag line.

akte.text: An Alp, called Pantafica in the Abruzzo. A pentagram on the door, salt on the windowsill, a broom beside the bed. He frightens, but he does not kill.

Dream Walkers come into the world through sleep. This one sits on sleepers’ chests; they wake paralysed and cannot breathe. Wake the afflicted at once as soon as their breathing falters. Everyone woken in time has survived.

Origin: a dream deprivation experiment in the sleep laboratory of the Perugia university hospital, November 1975. The Dream Walker is bound to the laboratory and reaches sleepers within a radius of about 1,500 m. Protocol Night Watch, as of 1976: within this radius, have every sleeper the hospital can reach monitored, and wake them if their breathing stops. The test subject of 1975 is not involved and is not to be disturbed.

Addendum 1979: the anchor is the chart paper of the experiment nights. It lay in an O.D.I.N. archive for eleven weeks, then went back to the university, and the file turned black. Further details restricted. Written on the file cover in fountain pen: “Range 1976: 1,480 m. Range 1979: 2,310 m. We are waking him bigger.”

name: The Old Child
zitat: “She asked me whether her mother would still recognise her when she woke up. I didn’t know which of the two to look at first.”
form: Infestation. The host is the child (listed as a Being until 1998)
grauen: Disturbing (2). Horrifying (3) when it ages in front of witnesses
aktenfarbe: White. Red as soon as someone separates the child from the person at whose bed it sits
haeufigkeit: Rare. The Registry knows of nine cases
verstand: Human. A child in an adult body
regionen: Eastern Europe, Central and Western Europe. Anywhere a child sits too long at a bedside
ersteSichtung: October 1887, a parish near Lötzen, Masuria. A pastor’s marginal note in the parish register: a boy of nine years “with down on his chin, swapped by the Evil One”
letzteSichtung: 2 September 2026, Miskolc, northern Hungary. Report from a paediatrician, case open
verluste: No dead. One paramedic aged by ten years in 1974, unfit for duty

signatur.text: Overripe fruit and warm milk. Whatever the child holds in its hand ripens with it: an apple turns brown in an hour.
The child breathes fast, even in sleep. The patient cannot be heard breathing; the silence at the bed is denser than in the rest of the room.
The child always has a fever, 38.5 °C, and never feels cold. The patient’s skin has had the same temperature for years, to the tenth of a degree.
In the sunbeam above the patient’s bed hangs dust that does not settle.
The monitor at the bed shows a single heartbeat that does not end. The child’s mechanical wristwatch gains six days every day. The detectors at the bed stay silent.
The family cat sleeps on the child every night. A kitten four years ago, it is grey around the muzzle today and half blind.
The mother’s mobile phone no longer recognises the child’s fingerprint. The hand has grown too big.
In the wardrobe, shoes in every size from 31 to 40, none of them worn down. Grey hairs in a brush decorated with rhinestones.
