akte.text: A changeling, it is already recorded as such in the parish registers. Actually belongs to the Old. Iron at the bed, salt on the threshold, do not call the child by its name. Age is contagious: touch only with gloves.

The Untimed: people whose time does not run in step with the world. An old child ages about seven years in one year. No known cure, fatal within a few years. White File: accompany, document, shield the family, keep the press away.

In every case a relative lies nearby whose condition does not change: coma, wasting illness. The Registry rates the child as a time sink. It draws time from its surroundings, first from the patient. Protocol Separation, as of 1974: move the child to a distant facility. Klagenfurt case, 1974: the child died of old age in the first night, the mother woke from her coma four days later. Assessment: the separation saved the mother.

Addendum 1998, countersigned: series of measurements by the paramedic of 1974. As long as she held the child’s hand in the vehicle, it aged half as fast, and she aged with it. In the parish register near Lötzen, grandfather and grandson died on the same evening in 1890. The classification as a Being is revoked. Handwritten note on the back, no initials: “It is not the child that dies of the mother. Ask the child whom it is holding on to. It knows.”

name: The One Opposite
zitat: “At the barber’s you see yourself from behind for the first time. Some people see someone else as well.”
form: Apparition, as long as it is behind the glass. Being, as soon as it is out
grauen: Uncanny (1), Disturbing (2) for anyone who knew the swapped person before
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red from the swap onwards, because from then on it is a matter of weeks
haeufigkeit: Rare. Three pairs of mirrors still hang, O.D.I.N. has smashed two
verstand: Human
regionen: Latin America, Central and Western Europe, Eastern Europe. Anywhere two old mirrors have hung facing each other for decades: barbershops, cafés, lifts, dance halls
ersteSichtung: 18 November 1946, Buenos Aires. Medical record of the Hospital Rawson: a journeyman barber dies of scurvy although he eats oranges every day. His heart is on the right. On an X-ray from 1943 it was on the left
letzteSichtung: 17 August 2026, Madrid, a barbershop in Malasaña. Polaroid taken by the barber, case open
verluste: One agent, 1971. Buried twice

signatur.text: Shaving soap and bay rum. Beneath it vinegar and newspaper, as with freshly cleaned glass.
Between the mirrors every word comes back the blink of an eye later. Sometimes it is a different word.
At one spot at eye level the glass is as warm as skin, 34 °C, even at night.
The corridor of reflections grows greener and greener, because glass swallows red. Only the seventh has its proper colours again.
A laser rangefinder held at right angles to the glass measures several metres, a few centimetres more every day. In front of the glass an EMF detector measures nothing unusual.
Dogs growl at the seventh reflection. The budgerigar in the shop no longer talks to its mirror.
Mobile phone cameras between the mirrors will not focus. For the swapped person, the face recognition of their phone fails, because the face is reversed.

When the glass mists up, something is written on it from the inside, in mirror writing. Fingerprints are not on the glass but behind it, in the silver. On the swapped person, parting, moles and scars are on the other side, and the button placket of his shirt is the wrong way round.

akte.text: A ghost in the mirror. Whoever looks into it too long loses their soul. Cover the mirrors, as is done in houses of mourning, and there will be peace.

Mirror Beings dwell between two mirrors that hang facing each other. Whoever looks deep into the corridor of reflections may encounter one. Afterwards the person seems changed and cool. They eat a lot and still lose weight, and after six to ten weeks they die. The being consumes them.

Protocol Blind Glass, as of 1972: find the pair of mirrors and smash one of the panes, from the back. After that the cases end. The affected person cannot be saved; keep them under surveillance until they die, autopsy only by our own pathologists. Findings in all cases: scurvy, emaciation, internal organs reversed. The being reshapes its victims.

Addendum 1989: a letter from Buenos Aires, postmarked May 1987, to a cover address of the Registry, in mirror writing. Signature: the codename of the agent who died in 1971. He gives the name of the customer whose face he wears and asks that no one be autopsied before he has been asked. The sender died of scurvy in July 1987. Under the letter, typewritten: “We are autopsying the reflection. Where is the person?”

name: The Other
zitat: “In 1988 I shot a man in his kitchen. The report says it was the right thing to do. I just don’t remember why any more.”
form: Being. Two people, one life
grauen: Disturbing (2), Horrifying (3) when a person vanishes from a photo
aktenfarbe: Red. Usually reported as a Grey File, as a family quarrel or an impostor case
haeufigkeit: Rare
verstand: Human
regionen: Central and Western Europe, Eastern Europe. Anywhere people leave: emigrant villages in Asturias, northern Portugal, Podlachia, fishing towns on the North Sea
ersteSichtung: 6 October 1913, Llanes, Asturias. A notary’s file: two men with the same name, face and baptismal certificate dispute a house. One comes from Havana. Copied by the Registry in 1957
letzteSichtung: 4 February 2026, a village near Hajnówka, Podlachia. Photo on a social network: two fathers at the breakfast table. Case open
verluste: None. The file lists five purges (1962 to 1988) and five dead, none of them an agent

signatur.text: The hall smells of two men: of cowshed and diesel, and of a washing powder that is not sold here.
At night a step creaks on the stairs, one the man of the house tore out years ago.
Between the two men there is a cool draught, as from an open door. Candle flames on the table lean towards the new arrival.
In photos from the house, one of the two is always blurred. Which one changes from night to night.
The GPS of a mobile phone jumps between two points in the house, twelve metres apart. In the other version, the barn stood at the second one.
The farm dog answers to two names. Neither man knows the name the other one calls.
The mobile phone of the man of the house unlocks with the new arrival’s face. Not the other way round.
Things from the other version turn up and vanish: a foreign coin in the sugar bowl. In the snow in front of the front door, a track that ends at the door and begins three metres before it.

boni.wer: a call from a house in which two identical men are quarrelling

akte.text: Doppelgänger. Whoever meets their own dies within a year. The Other casts no shadow. Do not speak with him, do not eat with him.

A man comes home and finds himself already there. The new arrival is the original; the Other has nested in. The Other knows the original’s life but gets details wrong: different scars, different memories. Do not listen to the family; they side with him.

Protocol Purge, as of 1962: after 21 nights the Other can no longer be separated from the original. Before that, get the family out of the house, take the original into protection, neutralise the Other. He is often armed. In five out of five cases no double was left afterwards.

Addendum 1989: none of the five reports states where the original went afterwards. The line is empty, in five different handwritings. The dead were buried by their families as husband, father and son. Protocol suspended, not revoked. Added by typewriter: “In 1988 I put him in the car myself, the one we saved. I don’t remember what he looked like.”

name: The Prompter
zitat: “I hear thoughts just before they’re spoken. Hers I hear before they’re thought.”
form: Apparition. She is one breath ahead of the world
grauen: Disturbing (2). Horrifying (3) for anyone who hears their own next sentence from her mouth
aktenfarbe: Black, since 1998. Why is not in the file
haeufigkeit: Unique
verstand: Human
regionen: Central and Western Europe, Eastern Europe. Vienna, isolated sightings in Prague and Budapest. Always in halls where text is spoken
ersteSichtung: 12 March 1945, Vienna State Opera, the evening after the bomb hit. Report by a fireman: in the burning prompter’s box a woman prompted him with what he was about to shout. Found in a deceased person’s papers in 1962
letzteSichtung: 8 December 2021, Schottenring, Vienna. Surveillance camera in the stairwell of the Vienna police headquarters, which stands on the site of the Ringtheater. A single frame. Case open
verluste: Unknown. At least nine, documented by expense claims without names, ammunition issues without recipients and a double room on the Ring, paid for in 1998, for no one

signatur.text: Sweetish coal gas that no longer flows in any pipe. Beneath it velvet dust and scenery glue.
A whisper before every sentence: whoever speaks hears their words first softly, then from their own mouth.
Where she is about to stand it is warmer, as in front of gaslit footlights.
Never in photos. In videos one frame too early, exactly where another person steps in the next.
In recordings the sound runs one breath ahead of the picture. Two clocks always differ by the same fraction. Crystal detector and ozone probe stay silent, even when she whispers.
Dogs bark just before someone enters and look at an empty spot.
Telephones ring one breath before the call. Dictaphones record every sentence twice, once whispered.
In duty rosters and guest books a neatly kept empty line. In front of the first row a trace of soot that belongs to no fire.

akte.text: Theatre ghost. A dead woman from the Ringtheater fire; every old house has one. Salt and light drive her off. She only wants applause.

One of the Forgotten, the strongest known. She stands in halls where people speak. Whoever looks at her forgets her on looking away. As with all the Forgotten: ask her name, write it down, say it aloud, and she is back in the world and stops.

Protocol Quiet, as of 1966: stay silent in her presence, communicate only in writing. Anyone who says a sentence before they meant to say it is withdrawn at once. After three such sentences the Registry can no longer hold on to them. She appears at premieres and anniversaries, above all on 8 December.

She was the prompter of the Ringtheater on the evening of the fire. The prompt book of that performance is considered burned. A transcript lies in a Viennese archive, restricted since 1998. Margin note in ink: “I asked her for her name. She prompted me with mine, and I wrote it down.” The handwriting cannot be matched to any member of staff.

name: The Sister Next Door
zitat: “White File, they said, for practice. The sister brought us cake. On the fourth day the mother asked me who the woman in our car was. She meant her daughter.”
form: Infestation. The host is the person who would not exist without the addendum’s death
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) for the host when a photo changes while she is looking at it
aktenfarbe: White, since 1983. The Registry considers addenda harmless
haeufigkeit: Rare. The Registry knows of eleven cases
verstand: Human
regionen: British Isles, Central and Western Europe, Scandinavia. Only where someone who died early has a stone with their name, almost always a child
ersteSichtung: 4 May 1974, Charleroi, Belgium. Complaint by a woman to the gendarmerie: a stranger is passing herself off as her sister. The gendarmerie finds a baptismal certificate, school reports and wedding photos and files the complaint as a family quarrel
letzteSichtung: 31 August 2026, Treorchy, Rhondda, Wales. A GP’s psychiatric referral, intercepted by a contact. Case open
verluste: No agents. Seven women who went to a spa clinic under Protocol Distance and did not come back (1983 to 2004)

signatur.text: Both houses smell of the same fabric softener. The host has never bought it.
At night, through the shared wall, someone hums the host’s favourite song, and sings off-key at the same place she does.
The wall between the houses is warm, even when no one next door has the heating on.
In old photos the host is a touch too bright, as if someone had lightened her afterwards. More so every week. The sister never.
A kinship test comes out as sisters. Every week the match gets higher; after six weeks a laboratory would take them for identical twins. The cell’s detectors find no trace of it.
Since the first day the host’s cat has slept next door and no longer comes back.
The sister knows the host’s PIN, her passwords, the name of her first rabbit. The voice control in the host’s car now obeys only the sister.

Baptismal registers, school reports and wedding albums name the sister, in old ink. In the cemetery above the town a small stone with her name and a single date. No one in the family knows whose grave it is, and someone brings flowers every week.

akte.text: A case for the psychologist, not for the Registry. The reporting person takes her sister for a stranger, a known delusion, Capgras syndrome. Stay friendly, wait for the referral.

Addendum: a person everyone remembers, except one. Papers, photos and school reports are genuine. The addendum is friendly and does not know what it is. The reporting person is in no danger; she is the only one with the correct memory. She needs support, not protection.

Protocol Distance, as of 1983: the addendum feeds on closeness to the reporting person. Get the reporting person out of the area, spa clinic or hospital, at least 50 km. After two to three weeks the reports end in every case. Never take the addendum to the cemetery.

Note 2005: in every case there was a dead child, a stillbirth, a twin who never breathed. In seven cases the reporting person did not come home after the spa stay, and the clinics recorded no admission. No more spa stays since then, reason not given. Margin note: “Charleroi 1974, visit 2004. There are five places set at the Sunday table. The family is four. No one knows who the fifth is for, but they set it every week.”

name: The Thylacine in the Harz
zitat: “Every cadet counts the stripes on the photo. There are seventeen. Since 1994 I’ve been counting something else: the nights when the ditch runs full.”
form: Being
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) on the ditch path when the lights are in the wrong place
aktenfarbe: White, training file for basic training. Grey as soon as someone goes missing at the ditch
haeufigkeit: Unique. One spot, at least four animals
verstand: Animal
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Only at the Rehberger Graben near Sankt Andreasberg, Upper Harz
ersteSichtung: 27 September 1936, Rehberger Graben. Photo by a summer visitor, printed in 1937 in a Harz local history magazine as the “Harz tiger”. Three weeks earlier the last known thylacine had died in Hobart
letzteSichtung: 4 June 2026, Rehberger Graben. Camera trap of the lynx monitoring: a thylacine, one minute later a man with a dog lead. Case open
verluste: One cadet (1994), listed as drowned. No body

signatur.text: Pungent musk, sweeter than fox. On rainy nights wood smoke where no house stands.
A dull, coughing bark when it hunts. On rainy nights the rushing of the ditch sounds doubled.
Cooler than a fox on the thermal imaging camera, around 35 degrees, like all marsupials.
On rainy nights the lights of the Grabenhaus burn in two places, about 40 m apart.
A GPS device on the ditch path jumps between two positions, 40 m apart. Nothing else registers.
On rainy nights dogs lie down on the path and stay down.
Camera traps trigger with nothing in the picture. Mobile phones on the path sometimes find a second network that no provider runs.
Paw prints with broad, three-lobed pads. The trail ends in the middle of the path. Roe fawns with skulls bitten through, barely eaten.

akte.text: A Tasmanian tiger in the Harz, although the species died out in 1936, presumably the descendant of an escaped zoo animal. Shy, nocturnal, kills sheep and drinks their blood. Harmless to humans. Training file: photograph, do not feed.
Not a survivor, but an animal from another time, presumably from before 1936, when Berlin Zoo kept thylacines. Appears only at the Rehberger Graben and only after heavy rain.

Protocol Hide, as of 1971: if the ditch runs brim-full after heavy rain, take up position directly on the ditch path, the animal’s run. Lamp off. In 1994 a cadet had an accident during the exercise, presumably washed into the underground watercourse. Institute, 2014: the tissue matches no thylacine in any museum collection.

Addendum 2025: a trained animal, answers to “Tasso”. On its collar a dog licence tag from the town of Zellerfeld, year 2025. Zellerfeld has been merged with Clausthal since 1924. If the Fehlschlag below the Grabenhaus is opened, the sightings end that same night. Margin note in pencil, initials B.: “In 1994 the thermos flask and rucksack stood neatly side by side on the path. People who drown don’t put their flask down first.”

name: The Time Castaway
zitat: “He asked me the date. I told him it was Tuesday.”
form: Being (listed as an Apparition until 1979)
grauen: Uncanny (1), Horrifying (3) when time catches up with him
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red as soon as the anchor has been separated from the castaway or someone has told him the date
haeufigkeit: Rare
verstand: Human
regionen: Europe. Frequent in old front-line areas, on coasts and wherever things lie in the ground for a long time
ersteSichtung: 3 May 1951, harbour of Slite, Gotland. Report by a rural police officer: a fisherman asks about his boat and gives the year as 1861
letzteSichtung: 14 July 2026, forest near Kallbrück, Nordeifel. Image from a trail camera, case open
verluste: Two agents, missing (1979, 2016). No bodies

signatur.text: Like a wardrobe that has been shut for a long time: plain soap, wet wool, coal smoke. No ozone, no wet stone.
In the silence, near him, sounds of his time at the edge of hearing: an engine no one builds any more, the hum of valves, distant rumbling.
Around him is the weather of his day. In July his breath is visible if he comes from a November.
In photos and videos he looks yellowed, like a picture from an album. Everything else in the picture has the right colours.

Two clocks near him drift apart, a few minutes a day. Radio-controlled clocks find no signal. A Geiger counter against his skin reads lower than against any other person in the room. Crystal detector, ozone probe and EMF detector stay quiet.
Dogs greet him every time as if he had only just arrived. Even for the tenth time in a day.
A mobile phone in his hand finds no network. A radio near him finds music between the stations that no one has played for decades.
Where the anchor was found, a hole in the earth that is rimed with frost in the morning, even in summer. Footprints that begin at one spot and come from nowhere.

akte.text: Persons from earlier decades, disoriented, physically unharmed. Do not confuse with haunts: Time Castaways eat, sleep and bleed. Treat like a confused witness. Disarm armed cases calmly. No press, no police.

Every case hangs on an object from the castaway’s time, here called the anchor. The anchor was found, bought or dug up shortly before the appearance. Do not separate anchor and castaway. The castaway ages quickly in our time, about one year per day. A case is closed after three weeks at most.

Protocol Return, as of 1963: calmly tell the castaway today’s date, with evidence, such as a newspaper. In all documented cases the person dissolved within minutes. Residue: clothing, dust. The Registry assesses this as a return to their own time.

Addendum 1979: if the anchor is put back where it was found, in the same position and depth, the castaway disappears without residue. Do not touch him while doing so (one agent missing). One case from 1971 in which the anchor was destroyed: the castaway stayed. Further details restricted. Margin note in pencil, no initials: “Residue of 1963 weighed. In the clothing a set of teeth, worn like an old man’s. Who returned here?”

name: The Chain Letter
zitat: “We read every message sent to the Collection Point. In October 2024 there were 41,000. I know every child who fell in them, by name and class.”
form: Thing. A message: letter, postcard, fax, phone message. Since 2024 also a girl in the black screen
rolle: Henchman. Professional from a thousand believing readers upwards
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when someone stands behind you in the black screen
aktenfarbe: Grey. Red from October to December 2024
haeufigkeit: Common. Almost all chains remain harmless
verstand: None. It does what the text says
regionen: Scandinavia. Gothenburg, above all Kortedala. Central and Western Europe, wherever the message travels
ersteSichtung: March 1926, Helsingborg. A copied good-luck letter, supposedly from Flanders, came into the archive from an estate in 1958
letzteSichtung: 18 September 2026, Gothenburg. Sixth version, six names, at three schools
verluste: None. Twelve outsiders since 1926, most recently a Gothenburg teacher in 2024

signatur.text: Nothing with letters. In Gothenburg since October 2024 chlorine, as in an indoor pool.
On stairs, wet trainers squeak behind the named person.
Nothing measurable. Named people complain of a wet back that is dry.
In the black phone screen a girl with wet hair stands behind the viewer. There is no one behind them. Never in mirrors.
Crystal detector and ozone probe stay silent. Children from twelve schools saw the same girl, each as described in their own version.
None. Animals do not read messages.
Whoever deletes the message finds it in the morning as a screenshot in the gallery. The version says: “Deleting won’t help.”
On named people, grazed heels, on the back of the shoe the print of a small wet toecap, chlorine on the jacket.

probe.text: Whoever reads the index card rolls INT + Occultism, and the game master reads aloud up to the row reached. A Journalist or Cryptanalyst gets +1 die.

akte.text: Chain letters. Superstition, playground quarrels, sometimes bullying. A matter for the school.

Thoughtform, kept with the Dead as a cursed document until 1987. Whoever breaks the chain suffers a misfortune within nine days, on a phone within three. The better known the message, the worse. Do not leave those affected alone on stairs or at stops.

Protocol Collection Point, since 1956: those affected send their ten copies to ten O.D.I.N. post office boxes, since 2019 to ten mobile numbers; there the chain ends. Forward unchanged: in 1958 a woman in Eskilstuna struck out the threat and fell from a hayloft nine days later. Since then no one who wrote to the Collection Point has died. Every message is read.
Deaths since 1926: twelve, all previously named as an example in a copy of the chain. Assessment: inserted afterwards to frighten. Stamp on the back: “Distribution: ten offices”.

name: The Hitchhiker
zitat: “I didn’t turn round. I only looked in the mirror and asked what her name was. She said: ‘Same as the girl from the baker’s.’”
form: Apparition. A girl on the verge of the country road who gets in and vanishes from the back seat
grauen: Uncanny (1) when the back seat is empty. Disturbing (2) when you recognise a face you know in the mirror
aktenfarbe: Black since June 1988. Decision of the Council: no more investigation, no more reports
haeufigkeit: Rare. A few sightings a year, more in autumn
verstand: None. She says what the story gives her to say
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Burgenland, the Seewinkel, the country road from Andau to Tadten
ersteSichtung: 2 December 1977, Tadten gendarmerie post. A cattle dealer reports a girl in a light dress who vanished from his moving car. He recognises her on the memorial card of Theresia Unger
letzteSichtung: 4 September 2026, 02:47. Interior camera of a taxi from Neusiedl am See: a girl in a hoodie on the back seat, two seconds later the empty seat
verluste: None. One lorry driver, 1994, in the ditch

signatur.text: Until 2024 lily of the valley, a cheap perfume from the seventies. Since 2025 a sweet coconut shower gel. Always a hint of fresh bread.
No footsteps, no door handle. Only the slam of the rear door and the creak of the upholstery.
Nothing during the drive. Afterwards the back seat is warm, as if someone had sat on it for an hour.
In the headlights she casts a shadow on the tarmac. In the car’s interior light she has none.

In the car the crystal detector and ozone probe measure nothing. All drivers describe the same girl, the way she is being told at the moment: until 2024 a light dress, bare arms, a plait. Since 2025 a hoodie, white trainers, short hair and a different face.
The farm dogs in Tadten bark at every strange car, except this one. The Ungers’ dog wags its tail.
New cars report a fastened seatbelt in the back. Interior cameras show her for one to two seconds.
On the back seat grit and dry blades of grass from the verge. In the morning the same grit lies in the daughter’s bed in the house with the green gate.

akte.text: The vanishing hitchhiker, a legend told from California to Carinthia. Harmless. Whoever sees her has had too little sleep.

Theresia Unger, 19, baker’s daughter from Tadten, died in the night before 13 October 1977. She stands at night on the verge outside the village and wants to go home to the house with the green gate. She names only her destination. Look ahead, do not turn round: in 1994 a lorry driver lay dead in the ditch; he had turned round.

Protocol Homeward, as of 1979, from procedures for the Dead: an agent picks her up and drives her to the gate. A relative opens and says: “She is dead. Go to sleep.” The apparition dissolves, then years of quiet. Carried out in 1979 and 1986 with the mother. Kept as a thoughtform since 1987.

Reclassification Black, June 1988: no investigation, no reports, so that the story is forgotten. Protocol Homeward remains valid. Attached: carbon copy of a gendarmerie record from Andau of 7 November 1974. A vegetable driver reports a girl in a light dress who vanished from his vehicle. Beside it, in ballpoint, a question mark.

name: The Imaginary Friend
zitat: “For seven years we explained to her that he was a part of her. She believed us.”
form: Apparition. Solid enough to push, as long as his creator is thinking of him
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when you recognise her face in his
aktenfarbe: Red since 3 August 2026, until a death is cleared up. Grey from 2016, under Protocol Consulting Hours from 2019
haeufigkeit: Unique. Tulpas are rare, and almost always come from children
verstand: Human. That of a boy of ten, as a six-year-old girl imagines him
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Utrecht, the Oudegracht and its wharf cellars. Since September 2026 Nijmegen, the Waalkade
ersteSichtung: 19 January 2016, Oudegracht, Utrecht. Note by a neighbourhood officer of the Politie: a nine-year-old and two passers-by describe the same boy, who is said to have pushed the nine-year-old off the wharf into the water. No such boy is reported missing anywhere
letzteSichtung: 21 September 2026, Waalkade, Nijmegen. A student in the Waal, rescued. Two witnesses, one description
verluste: No agents. A contract psychologist, drowned on 3 August 2026, according to the file an accident

signatur.text: Brackish canal water and wet rubber, like a raincoat that has hung in the hallway too long.
The squeak of wet children’s boots on cobbles, even when no one is walking. Very close, a child’s voice quietly counting to ten, as in hide-and-seek.
Nothing measurable. Whoever gives him their hand holds a small hand that is not cold, only wet.
His yellow jacket is too yellow in any light, as if drawn in wax crayon.

No detector of the Registry has ever registered him. Witnesses who have never met one another see the same boy: ten years old, yellow raincoat, soaked to the skin. Since 2024 they add: “He looked like her, like a little brother.”
Ducks on the canal swim towards him as if he had bread.
Cameras only capture him when Noor is also in the picture.
Wet prints of children’s boots, size 34, that begin at the edge of a wharf. On Noor’s windowsill yellow wax crayon, always freshly broken off.

akte.text: An imaginary friend who frightens the neighbours’ children. Child’s play. He disappears with puberty, like all of them.

Tulpa: a thoughtform arising from the belief of a single person, usually a child. It is what its creator believes of it, and it fades when they no longer believe in it. A tulpa protects its creator. Never tell the child that their friend is dangerous.

Noor Hendriks, born 2007. Joep since 2012. His rules come from a picture book she drew at six: “Joep is ten. Joep lives under our house. Joep can’t drown. Joep mustn’t go over the bridge. Joep pushes bad people into the canal. Joep always stays.” Protocol Consulting Hours since September 2019: one session a week with a contract psychologist. Noor learns to see Joep as part of herself. Sightings 2019: eleven, 2022: two. Since 2024 he resembles her. Assessment: integration is progressing, dissolution expected before 2027.

3 August 2026, around 23:00: Dr Marleen Hoogland, 61, the psychologist, dead in the Oudegracht, 0.9 per mille blood alcohol. The Politie conclude it was an accident. Protocol Consulting Hours will continue from 12 October in Nijmegen with a successor. Attached a copy of her last session note: “N. very angry today. Says I’m taking everything away from her. Good. The anger has to come out.”

name: The Man in the Hat
zitat: “I said goodnight to him, the way it says on my own leaflet. He raised his hat, very politely. I was too tired to look. That’s why I’m alive.”
form: Apparition. A tall man in a coat and hat at the foot of the bed, only for people who lie awake and cannot move
grauen: Uncanny (1). Horrifying (3) when he raises his hat
aktenfarbe: White since 2009. Note: “Controlled by counter-story”
haeufigkeit: Common. Thousands of reports a year worldwide, almost all without consequences
verstand: None. He does what the story says
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Lisbon, Graça and Alfama. And anywhere people read about him
ersteSichtung: 19 October 2004, Lisbon. Post in a forum for insomniacs: “O homem do chapéu”. By 2008 more than 1,900 replies from three continents
letzteSichtung: 11 September 2026, 04:05, Graça. Mobile phone video by a woman, filmed from her pillow
verluste: None

signatur.text: Stale cigarette smoke and wet felt. The smoke has only existed since 2011, since a forum member drew him with a cigarette.
The clock in the room can no longer be heard. Then the floor at the foot of the bed creaks once, as if someone were shifting their weight.
The thermometer stays where it was. In the morning the duvet at the foot of the bed is warm, as if someone had stood there for a long time.

The light of the street lamp falls through the shutters onto him and does not make him any brighter. If someone turns on a light, a coat and hat hang on the door, even in flats where nobody owns a hat.

No measuring device registers what stands in the bedroom. Instead, witnesses in Lisbon, Recife and Oslo describe the same details, always those of the version being told at the moment. Since December 2020 they all mention the face under the hat.
No reaction. A dog sleeping at the foot of the bed sleeps on, right in the middle of him.
Phone cameras show him only to those who know the story. Others see a dark door in the same video.
Since 2011 a little ash on the floor at the foot of the bed. On the dead, pressure marks on both ankles, as if from fingers in leather gloves.

akte.text: Sleep paralysis. Whoever is paralysed on waking often sees a figure, very often a man in a hat. Medically explained, not a case for O.D.I.N.

Thoughtform, arising in 2004 in a Lisbon forum, now told worldwide. He stands at the foot of the bed and watches. He touches no one. Whoever sees him stays paralysed until he leaves at dawn. If someone turns on a light, he is a coat on the door.

Counter-story 2008: an agent posts the rule “Say Boa noite to him, then he raises his hat and leaves” in the forum under the name of an elderly lady. By the end of 2009 in nine out of ten reports worldwide. Protocol Goodnight: leaflet in 14 languages for sleep clinics and a patients’ association. File colour White.

Older cases lay with the Dead as the “Shadow Guest”, 41 reports between 1971 and 1986. Enquiry from Lisbon in 2021: three dead in their sleep with pressure marks on the ankles. Assessment: coincidence, no connection. Stamp: “Filed. No action required. 12/03/2021”.

name: The Saint of the Wayside Cross
zitat: “He brought me home in 1994. Since then I’ve taught every Cadet the call.”
form: Apparition. A barefoot shepherd boy with a stable lantern, only in fog and driving snow
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when he leads someone to the edge
aktenfarbe: Grey. Mostly reported as a mountain rescue missing person case, almost always with a good outcome
haeufigkeit: Unique. Beings of Belief are rare and tied to one place
verstand: Human. That of a shepherd boy, as people on the pass tell of him
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Oberallgäu, the old mule track over the Oberjoch to Tyrol, between the Hirtenkreuz and the Hirtenwand
ersteSichtung: January 1844. Interrogation record of the Bavarian border guard: a muleteer, caught smuggling, states that a boy with a lantern led him down from the pass in a snowstorm
letzteSichtung: 2 February 2024. Statement by a farmer, 71, to mountain rescue: he lost the path in fog and was led to the chapel by the Cross Shepherd
verluste: One Cadet, fell below the Hirtenwand in fog on 9 October 2025, recorded as a mountain accident. One agent rescued, 1994

signatur.text: Candle wax and wet loden.
Bare children’s feet on stone. The squeak of a lantern handle.
Nothing measurable. The hand he offers is warm and rough, a child’s hand with calluses.
A candle lantern whose glow does not reach two metres in the fog and yet can be seen from 500 m.

None of the devices measures anything at the wayside cross. People rescued over five decades describe him the same way: twelve years old, barefoot, loden jacket, a face like the one on the devotional picture of 1911. Since 2021 some say: “He called my name.” On the devotional picture he does not. In a podcast he does.
Cows on the alpine pasture have drops of wax in their coats on the morning after a sighting.
Head torches and phone lights reach only one metre near him. The GPS shows the right path, but you do not believe it.
Small bare footprints in fresh snow that end at the chapel door or at the edge of the Hirtenwand. Fresh wax at the cross, although no one lights candles there any more.

akte.text: A mountain saint the old people in the Allgäu believe in. Whoever gets lost sees a light. Harmless, a matter for local heritage evenings.

Being of Belief: a thoughtform arising from the belief of many people in a saint whom no church has ever canonised. The Registry does not judge religion; it records only what happens at this cross. The Cross Shepherd is the belief in Xaver Rietzler, a shepherd boy who in 1843 led travellers down from the pass in a snowstorm and died doing so. He leads the lost home. Not dangerous.

File since 1983, kept with the Dead until 1987. Fourteen rescues documented, 1983 to 2024, among them an agent on an operation in 1994. Protocol Shepherd’s Call since 1989: whoever gets into difficulty in the mountains in the area calls out loudly “Cross Shepherd, lead me home”. The leaflet is attached to every file in the Oberallgäu.

9 October 2025: a Cadet, 23, fell below the Hirtenwand in fog. According to the radio log she did not use the Shepherd’s Call; last transmission: “I can see a light, I’m going to it.” Stamp from September 2026: “Leaflet reissued. Shepherd’s Call mandatory from 1 January 2027.”

name: The Spirit of the Company
zitat: “In the adverts he always came before it happened. In the building he comes when everyone else has gone.”
form: Apparition. A friendly gentleman in a light trench coat who appeared in television adverts for 28 years
grauen: Uncanny (1). Disturbing (2) when a child works under his hand
aktenfarbe: White since 2022, recorded as fading. Red from 1995 to 2001, then Grey under Protocol Closing Time
haeufigkeit: Unique. Egregores are common, almost all of them weak
verstand: Human. Friendly, diligent, tireless. He thinks like a company
regionen: Central and Western Europe. Frankfurt am Main, the Mainfeste building in the Westend. Since 2020 the whole Rhine-Main area
ersteSichtung: 12 December 1995, around 22:00. Porter’s log: on the 17th floor Mr Ahrend from the adverts is sitting next to a clerk and watching her work. The actor, 67, was in a hospital in Wiesbaden that evening
letzteSichtung: 16 September 2026, Offenbach am Main. Report by a primary school teacher: a pupil does her homework at night “because the gentleman likes it”
verluste: None. In addition four Mainfeste employees, 1996 to 2000, all in the building

signatur.text: Filter coffee that has stood too long on the hotplate, and freshly printed paper.
A ballpoint pen clicked in and out. Quiet typing from a room where no one is sitting.
Office warmth around him, 22 °C, however warm or cold the room was before.
Fluorescent light, even where there are no fluorescent tubes. Under a kitchen lamp his face looks bluish, as if under an office ceiling.

In the office the detectors register only photocopiers and fluorescent tubes. Witnesses all see the same man: mid-fifties, light trench coat, moustache, a document folder under his arm. That is Mr Ahrend from the adverts of the eighties. Anyone who only knows the adverts from the seventies describes him as younger.
Employees’ dogs lie down in front of the desk at night and do not get up until the laptop is shut.
In video conferences after 22:00 a tile with no picture: “H. Ahrend”. It is in no invitation.
On completed files a small tick in green felt-tip that nobody made. Under kitchen tables, lost Mainfeste lapel pins, which are only given out for service anniversaries.

akte.text: The ghost of the company founder, who walks through his building at night. Harmless, as long as you go home at five.

Egregore: a thoughtform arising from the shared belief of a group, here the workforce of Mainfeste Versicherungen AG, founded 1927. His face is Mr Ahrend, the advertising figure of the years 1971 to 1999 (“Mr Ahrend comes before it happens”). He appears to employees who work late and alone and lays his hand on their shoulder. Do not work alone in the building at night. He takes no notice of outsiders.

Four dead in the building from 1996 to 2000, all heart failure at the desk, at night or at the weekend. Protocol Closing Time since 2001: after an inspection by the Hessian occupational safety authority the building closes at 20:00, and entirely at weekends, plus time recording. Sightings in the building 1996 to 2000: 41. From 2002 to 2019: nine. Since 2020, 2,600 of the 5,200 employees have worked mainly from home: one sighting. Assessment: fading.

Stamp “White”, March 2022. Carbon copy of a letter from the company doctor to the Registry, 2025: since 2020 five deaths among employees working from home, heart failure, at night, at the kitchen table. Note by the Registry: “Outside the building. Cannot be attributed.” Enclosed: two children’s drawings, a man in a light coat at a kitchen table.
